第六节 学处与罪

如果比库违犯了此227条学处，将依不同的违犯程度而构成七种罪。此七种罪从重至轻依次为：
rú guǒ bǐ kù wéi fàn le cǐ 227 tiáo xué chù， jiāng yī bù tóng de wéi fàn chéng dù ér gòu chéng qī zhǒng zuì。 cǐ qī zhǒng zuì cóng zhòng zhì qīng yī cì wèi：
If Biku violates this section of Article 227, he will be guilty of seven offences, depending on the degree of violation.
1. 巴拉基格(pārājika)；
1. bā lā jī gé (pārājika)；
1. Barakig (pārājika);
2. 桑喀地谢思(saṅghādisesa)；
2. sāng kā dì xiè sī (saṅghādisesa)；
2. Sankadisha (saghādisesa);
3. 土喇吒亚(thullaccaya, 粗罪)；
3. tǔ lǎ zhā yà (thullaccaya, cū zuì )；
3. thullaccaya, gross crime;
4. 巴吉帝亚(pācittiya)；
4. bā jí dì yà (pācittiya)；
4. Bagitia (pācittiya);
5. 应悔过(pāṭidesanīya)；
5. yīng huǐ guò (pāṭidesanīya)；
5. Repent (pédidesanbeya);
6. 恶作(dukkaṭa)，即不好的行为；
6. è zuò (dukkaṭa)， jí bù hǎo de xíng wéi；
6. Misdemeanour (dukka a), i.e. bad behaviour;
7. 恶说(dubbhāsita, 不好的言语) 。
7. è shuō (dubbhāsita, bù hǎo de yán yǔ )。
7. Naughty (dubbhāsita, bad words).
当知学处(sikkhāpada)与罪(āpatti)是有所不同的。“学处”相当于戒条，皆为佛陀所制定，是每一位弟子都应当持守的。“罪”则是由于持戒者有意或无意违犯了学处而构成的过错。
dāng zhī xué chù (sikkhāpada) yǔ zuì (āpatti) shì yǒu suǒ bù tóng de。“ xué chù ” xiāng dāng yú jiè tiáo， jiē wèi fó tuó suǒ zhì dìng， shì měi yī wèi dì zǐ dōu yīng dāng chí shǒu de。“ zuì ” zé shì yóu yú chí jiè zhě yǒu yì huò wú yì wéi fàn le xué chù ér gòu chéng de guò cuò。
The Sikkhāpada is different from the crime (āpatti). “Study” is the same as the dogma, set by Buddha, and should be observed by every student.
例如巴拉基格学处的第二条为“不与取”，假如比库企图偷取他人的贵重物品，碰触到即犯恶作，移动犯土喇吒亚，物品离开原处即犯巴拉基格。
lì rú bā lā jī gé xué chù de dì èr tiáo wèi “ bù yǔ qǔ ”， jiǎ rú bǐ kù qǐ tú tōu qǔ tā rén de guì zhòng wù pǐn， pèng chù dào jí fàn è zuò， yí dòng fàn tǔ lǎ zhā yà， wù pǐn lí kāi yuán chù jí fàn bā lā jī gé。
For example, the second article of the Barakig School is “incompetence” and, if Biku tries to steal valuables from others, to touch them, to carry them out, to move them out of their place of origin, and to do so, to do so.
第三条为“故意杀人”，假如比库企图杀人，在为杀人做准备工作时犯恶作，当受害者感到痛苦时犯土喇吒亚，若受害者因此死亡即犯巴拉基格。
dì sān tiáo wèi “ gù yì shā rén ”， jiǎ rú bǐ kù qǐ tú shā rén， zài wèi shā rén zuò zhǔn bèi gōng zuò shí fàn è zuò， dāng shòu hài zhě gǎn dào tòng kǔ shí fàn tǔ lǎ zhā yà， ruò shòu hài zhě yīn cǐ sǐ wáng jí fàn bā lā jī gé。
Article 3 refers to “intentional killing” if Biku attempted to kill, committed a heinous act in preparation for the murder, committed a crime in the course of suffering to the victim, and committed a crime in the event of the death of the victim, Barakig.
又如巴吉帝亚第四十条学处“吃未授与的食物”，假如比库为了吃未经授与的食物而拿取者，犯恶作；每吞咽一口，皆犯一巴吉帝亚。
yòu rú bā jí dì yà dì sì shí tiáo xué chù “ chī wèi shòu yǔ de shí wù ”， jiǎ rú bǐ kù wèi le chī wèi jīng shòu yǔ de shí wù ér ná qǔ zhě， fàn è zuò； měi tūn yàn yī kǒu， jiē fàn yī bā jí dì yà。
The same is true of article 40 of the Bajitia School, which “eats unlicensed food” if Biku takes it for unlicensed food, commits an evil act; and for every swallow, a Bagitia is committed.
因此，对于同一条学处，将会根据不同程度的违犯而构成轻重不同的罪过。对于四条巴拉基格学处，只有在具足所有违犯条件的情况下才构成巴拉基格罪，而且最高的罪行即是巴拉基格；若缺少一两项条件，则可能犯较轻的罪，甚至不犯。对于桑喀地谢思罪、尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚罪、巴吉帝亚罪、应悔过罪等也依此类推。不过，对于应学法，故意违犯任何一条学处皆只构成恶作罪。
yīn cǐ， duì yú tóng yī tiáo xué chù， jiāng huì gēn jù bù tóng chéng dù de wéi fàn ér gòu chéng qīng zhòng bù tóng de zuì guò。 duì yú sì tiáo bā lā jī gé xué chù， zhǐ yǒu zài jù zú suǒ yǒu wéi fàn tiáo jiàn de qíng kuàng xià cái gòu chéng bā lā jī gé zuì， ér qiě zuì gāo de zuì xíng jí shì bā lā jī gé； ruò quē shǎo yī liǎng xiàng tiáo jiàn， zé kě néng fàn jiào qīng de zuì， shèn zhì bù fàn。 duì yú sāng kā dì xiè sī zuì、 ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà zuì、 bā jí dì yà zuì、 yīng huǐ guò zuì děng yě yī cǐ lèi tuī。 bù guò， duì yú yīng xué fǎ， gù yì wéi fàn rèn hé yī tiáo xué chù jiē zhǐ gòu chéng è zuò zuì。
Thus, the same section would constitute a different offence depending on the degree of violation. For the four Barakigs, the crime would only be committed if all the conditions for violation were met, and the highest offence would be Barakig; if one or two conditions were lacking, the less serious offence would be committed, if not the less serious one. The same would apply to the Sankatiya crimes, Nisapya Bagitia, Bagitia, Repentation.
对于比库违犯跋葛瓦所制定的学处，依其罪过的种类又可分为以下几种：
duì yú bǐ kù wéi fàn bá gé wǎ suǒ zhì dìng de xué chù， yī qí zuì guò de zhǒng lèi yòu kě fēn wéi yǐ xià jǐ zhǒng：
In the case of Biku, the establishments set up by Gwa in violation of the law can be divided into the following categories according to the type of offence committed:
一、重罪与轻罪
yī、 zhòng zuì yǔ qīng zuì
I. SETTLEMENTS AND DISAPPEARANCES
1.重罪(garukāpatti)有两种，即：
1. zhòng zuì (garukāpatti) yǒu liǎng zhǒng， jí：
There are two types of felonies (garukāpatti), namely:
⑴巴拉基格：不可忏之罪(atekicchā)；
⑴ bā lā jī gé： bù kě chàn zhī zuì (atekicchā)；
(1) Barakig: Independable (atekicchā);
⑵桑喀地谢思：可忏之罪(satekicchā)，违犯此罪者先须坦白其罪，并经僧团的一系列处分後才能恢复清净。
⑵ sāng kā dì xiè sī： kě chàn zhī zuì (satekicchā)， wéi fàn cǐ zuì zhě xiān xū tǎn bái qí zuì， bìng jīng sēng tuán de yī xì liè chǔ fèn hòu cái néng huī fù qīng jìng。
(2) Sankadesh: a confessionable crime (satekicchā), the perpetrator of which must confess his or her guilt before he or she can recover his or her innocence after a series of punishments by the monks.
2.轻罪(lahukāpatti)有五种，属于可忏之罪，即：
2. qīng zuì (lahukāpatti) yǒu wǔ zhǒng， shǔ yú kě chàn zhī zuì， jí：
2. There are five types of misdemeanour (lahukāpatti) which are punishable by confession, namely:
⑴土喇吒亚；
⑴ tǔ lǎ zhā yà；
(i) Tulanya;
⑵巴吉帝亚；
⑵ bā jí dì yà；
(2) Bagitia;
⑶应悔过；
⑶ yīng huǐ guò；
(3) Repent;
⑷恶作；
⑷ è zuò；
(iv) Misdemeanours;
⑸恶说。
⑸ è shuō。
(5) Naughty.
违犯这五种轻罪的比库，只需向另一位比库坦白其罪，然後进行忏悔即可恢复清净。
wéi fàn zhè wǔ zhǒng qīng zuì de bǐ kù， zhǐ xū xiàng lìng yī wèi bǐ kù tǎn bái qí zuì， rán hòu jìn xíng chàn huǐ jí kě huī fù qīng jìng。
If the bhikkhu had violated the five misdemeanours, he would have to confess his guilt to another bhikkhu and then repent.
二、有心罪与无心罪
èr、 yǒu xīn zuì yǔ wú xīn zuì
II. CRIMINAL AND INCIDENTAL CRIME
1.有心罪(sacittaka)：通过故意（有心）违犯学处才构成的罪过。有些学处必须通过故意违犯才构成罪过，若非故意则不犯。如故意杀人犯巴拉基格，故意杀害生命犯巴吉帝亚等。
1. yǒu xīn zuì (sacittaka)： tōng guò gù yì （yǒu xīn） wéi fàn xué chù cái gòu chéng de zuì guò。 yǒu xiē xué chù bì xū tōng guò gù yì wéi fàn cái gòu chéng zuì guò， ruò fēi gù yì zé bù fàn。 rú gù yì shā rén fàn bā lā jī gé， gù yì shā hài shēng mìng fàn bā jí dì yà děng。
1. Sacitttaka: A crime committed with intent (intentional) in violation of the school system. Some schools must commit an offence by wilful violation or, if they fail to do so, do not commit such an offence.
2.无心罪(acittaka)：无意违犯之罪。有些学处即使无意违犯，只要符合违犯的条件也会构成罪。如施主将金钱装进袋中供养比库，比库误认为是如法物品而接受，也构成违犯尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
2. wú xīn zuì (acittaka)： wú yì wéi fàn zhī zuì。 yǒu xiē xué chù jí shǐ wú yì wéi fàn， zhǐ yào fú hé wéi fàn de tiáo jiàn yě huì gòu chéng zuì。 rú shī zhǔ jiàng jīn qián zhuāng jìn dài zhōng gòng yǎng bǐ kù， bǐ kù wù rèn wèi shì rú fǎ wù pǐn ér jiē shòu， yě gòu chéng wéi fàn ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
2. Unintentional (acittaka): Unintentional offences. Some schools, even if they do not intend to violate them, will be guilty if they meet the conditions for violation. If the money is placed in a bag to provide for the piècean, it will also constitute a violation of Nisadia Bagitia if it is erroneously accepted as an item of law.
三、由想得脱与非由想得脱
sān、 yóu xiǎng dé tuō yǔ fēi yóu xiǎng dé tuō
iii. I can't help but think.
1.由想得脱之罪(saññāvimokkhā)：由于没有违犯学处之想而得以逃脱的罪过。这种罪是指无意违犯有心罪而言。
1. yóu xiǎng dé tuō zhī zuì (saññāvimokkhā)： yóu yú méi yǒu wéi fàn xué chù zhī xiǎng ér dé yǐ táo tuō de zuì guò。 zhè zhǒng zuì shì zhǐ wú yì wéi fàn yǒu xīn zuì ér yán。
1. The crime of escape (sañāvimokkhā): a crime that has been escaped without violating the wishes of the School. This crime is defined as an offence of intent.
2.非由想得脱之罪(nosaññāvimokkhā)：不管有没有违犯学处之想，只要符合违犯的条件都不能逃脱的罪过。这种罪过是指故意违犯有心罪和违犯无心罪而言。
2. fēi yóu xiǎng dé tuō zhī zuì (nosaññāvimokkhā)： bù guǎn yǒu méi yǒu wéi fàn xué chù zhī xiǎng， zhǐ yào fú hé wéi fàn de tiáo jiàn dōu bù néng táo tuō de zuì guò。 zhè zhǒng zuì guò shì zhǐ gù yì wéi fàn yǒu xīn zuì hé wéi fàn wú xīn zuì ér yán。
2. Nosañāvimokkhā: a crime that cannot be escaped, regardless of whether or not it is in violation of the educational system, provided that the conditions for the violation are met. Such a crime means a deliberate offence and a misdemeanour.
四、世间罪与制定罪
sì、 shì jiān zuì yǔ zhì dìng zuì
IV. UNIVERSAL CRIME AND CRIMINAL CRIME
1.世间罪(lokavajja)：生起不善心故意违犯的行为，或者社会上普遍认为是不合乎道德的行为。有些行为不仅对比库、比库尼而言是不能做的，即使对世俗普通人来说也是不道德的行为。如故意杀人、不与取、说虚妄语等。
1. shì jiān zuì (lokavajja)： shēng qǐ bù shàn xīn gù yì wéi fàn de xíng wéi， huò zhě shè huì shàng pǔ biàn rèn wéi shì bù hé hū dào dé de xíng wéi。 yǒu xiē xíng wéi bù jǐn duì bǐ kù、 bǐ kù ní ér yán shì bù néng zuò de， jí shǐ duì shì sú pǔ tōng rén lái shuō yě shì bù dào dé de xíng wéi。 rú gù yì shā rén、 bù yǔ qǔ、 shuō xū wàng yǔ děng。
1. The crime of the world (lokavajja): Some acts are not only unconscionable, but also immoral, even for secular ordinary people. They are intentional killings, incompetences, falsehoods, etc.
2.制定罪(paṇṇattivajja)：由跋葛瓦所制定、只是针对比库、比库尼违犯才构成的罪过。有些学处只是规定比库、比库尼才不能违越，但是世俗普通人造作并不会构成罪过。如接受金钱、从事买卖、挖掘土地等。
2. zhì dìng zuì (paṇṇattivajja)： yóu bá gé wǎ suǒ zhì dìng、 zhǐ shì zhēn duì bǐ kù、 bǐ kù ní wéi fàn cái gòu chéng de zuì guò。 yǒu xiē xué chù zhǐ shì guī dìng bǐ kù、 bǐ kù ní cái bù néng wéi yuè， dàn shì shì sú pǔ tōng rén zào zuò bìng bú huì gòu chéng zuì guò。 rú jiē shòu jīn qián、 cóng shì mǎi mài、 wā jué tǔ dì děng。
2. Prosecuting (pa attivajja): A crime committed by the Gowa and committed only against bhikkhu and Bikuni. Some schools provide for Biku and Bikuni only, but ordinary man-made acts of secularism do not constitute a crime, such as accepting money, trading and excavating land.
五、身业、语业与身语业
wǔ、 shēn yè、 yǔ yè yǔ shēn yǔ yè
V. PROFESSIONAL, LANGUAGE AND LANGUAGE
1.身业罪(kāyakamma)：通过身体行为违犯的罪过。如从事淫欲法、故意出精、触摸女人等。
1. shēn yè zuì (kāyakamma)： tōng guò shēn tǐ xíng wéi wéi fàn de zuì guò。 rú cóng shì yín yù fǎ、 gù yì chū jīng、 chù mō nǚ rén děng。
1. The offence of profligacy (kāyakama): an offence committed by means of a physical act, such as the practice of lewdness, the deliberate depredation, the touching of a woman.
2.语业罪(vacīkamma)：通过语言违犯的罪过。如和未达上者同句诵法、对女人说法过限等。
2. yǔ yè zuì (vacīkamma)： tōng guò yǔ yán wéi fàn de zuì guò。 rú hé wèi dá shàng zhě tóng jù sòng fǎ、 duì nǚ rén shuō fǎ guò xiàn děng。
2. Language offences (vacbekamma): offences committed through language.
3.身业和语业罪(kāyakammaṃ vacīkammañca)：能通过身体行为和语言两者违犯的罪过。如不与取、故意杀人、说虚妄的上人法等。
3. shēn yè hé yǔ yè zuì (kāyakammaṃ vacīkammañca)： néng tōng guò shēn tǐ xíng wéi hé yǔ yán liǎng zhě wéi fàn de zuì guò。 rú bù yǔ qǔ、 gù yì shā rén、 shuō xū wàng de shàng rén fǎ děng。
3. The crime of proficient and speech (kāyakama vacbekammañca): offences that can be violated by both physical conduct and language, such as lack of connection, wilful homicide, false pretences, etc.
须知并没有纯粹由意门（心念）构成的犯戒。
xū zhī bìng méi yǒu chún cuì yóu yì mén （xīn niàn） gòu chéng de fàn jiè。
There is no simple (intentional) punishment.

第七节 伍波思特的起源

佛教僧团有每隔半个月念诵《巴帝摩卡》戒经的传统。因此，僧团诵戒称为“伍波思特”。
fó jiào sēng tuán yǒu měi gé bàn gè yuè niàn sòng 《 bā dì mó kǎ》 jiè jīng de chuán tǒng。 yīn cǐ， sēng tuán sòng jiè chēng wéi “ wǔ bō sī tè ”。
The Buddhist monks have a tradition of reading the Book of Batiamoka every half month. Thus, the monks are called “Wubost”.
伍波思特，巴利语uposatha的音译。该词源于梵语upavasatha。若依音义法来解释，upavasatha 由 upa(近，随) + vas(住) + atha组成，直译为“近住”，即在特定的日子里持斋戒的意思。
wǔ bō sī tè， bā lì yǔ uposatha de yīn yì。 gāi cí yuán yú fàn yǔ upavasatha。 ruò yī yīn yì fǎ lái jiě shì，upavasatha yóu upa( jìn， suí ) + vas( zhù ) + atha zǔ chéng， zhí yì wèi “ jìn zhù ”， jí zài tè dìng de rì zi lǐ chí zhāi jiè de yì si。
Woodburn, uposatha. The word is derived from the Sanskrit languageupavasatha. If interpreted in a symphony way,upavasatha consists of upa (near, with) + vas (near) + atha, which is translated directly into "near living" meaning fasting on a given day.
义註中如此解释“伍波思特”：
yì zhù zhōng rú cǐ jiě shì “ wǔ bō sī tè ”：
This is the explanation in the note for Woodbird:
“‘于此日近住’为伍波思特。近住是以持戒或禁食作为具足而住之意。在此举出一些意思：‘来，贤友咖比那，我们去伍波思特吧’等为诵巴帝摩卡的伍波思特。‘维萨卡，如此以八支具足而住于伍波思特’(增5.43)等为戒。‘二月确实常清净，伍波思特常清净’(M.1. 79)等为持戒。‘龙王名叫伍波思特’(D.2.246)等是名称。‘诸比库，不得在伍波思特当天从有比库的住处[前往无比库的住处]’(V.3.181)等为应近住之日；这才是这里的意思。由于它可分为八日、十四日、十五日三种，所以排除了其馀两种而说在十五日。由此而说:‘于此日近住’为伍波思特。”(D.A.1.150; M.A.3.85)
“‘ yú cǐ rì jìn zhù ’ wéi wǔ bō sī tè。 jìn zhù shì yǐ chí jiè huò jìn shí zuò wéi jù zú ér zhù zhī yì。 zài cǐ jǔ chū yī xiē yì si：‘ lái， xián yǒu kā bǐ nà， wǒ men qù wǔ bō sī tè ba ’ děng wèi sòng bā dì mó kǎ de wǔ bō sī tè。‘ wéi sà kǎ， rú cǐ yǐ bā zhī jù zú ér zhù yú wǔ bō sī tè ’( zēng 5.43) děng wèi jiè。‘ èr yuè què shí cháng qīng jìng， wǔ bō sī tè cháng qīng jìng ’(M.1. 79) děng wèi chí jiè。‘ lóng wáng míng jiào wǔ bō sī tè ’(D.2.246) děng shì míng chēng。‘ zhū bǐ kù， bù dé zài wǔ bō sī tè dàng tiān cóng yǒu bǐ kù de zhù chù [ qián wǎng wú bǐ kù de zhù chù ]’(V.3.181) děng wèi yīng jìn zhù zhī rì； zhè cái shì zhè lǐ de yì si。 yóu yú tā kě fēn wéi bā rì、 shí sì rì、 shí wǔ rì sān zhǒng， suǒ yǐ pái chú le qí yú liǎng zhǒng ér shuō zài shí wǔ rì。 yóu cǐ ér shuō :‘ yú cǐ rì jìn zhù ’ wéi wǔ bō sī tè。”(D.A.1.150; M.A.3.85)
“Being close on this day is Woopostste.” Nearness is meant to be a good watch or a fasting. Here are some of the meanings: `Come, friend Quadina, let's go to Wuboste to recite Batimoca. `Visaca, so long as eight are sufficient to live in Wooboste' (up 5.43), etc. `It is true that in February it is always clean, Woodhouse is clean' (M.1.79), etc. `Loon's name is `D.2.246', and `The Queen's name is `D. 2.246, and `The Queen Queen Quay Quay, may not live near Quay' on that day from Quil [to the non-Bicca residence]' (V.3.181), etc. `This is what it means. It can be divided into eight days, fourteen days and fifteen days, so it is said: `D.246. `D. 150.A.85.
综合上述义註的解释，伍波思特有三种意思：
zōng hé shàng shù yì zhù de jiě shì， wǔ bō sī tè yǒu sān zhǒng yì si：
In combination with the above-mentioned interpretation, Woodstone has three meanings:
1. 一个月当中特定的日期——斋戒日
1. yí gè yuè dāng zhōng tè dìng de rì qī —— zhāi jiè rì
Specific dates in one month — Ramadan Day
古印度的历法属于太阴历，一年分十二个月，月份按月亮绕地球运转的周期推算。推算方法是从每个月圆日的第二天明相出现(aruṇuggamana,黎明)时开始算起，到下一个月圆日的第二天明相出现为至结束，约三十天（小月为二十九天）的时间为一个月。如此，每个月又可分为两个半月：从月圆日翌日开始到月黑日为“黑月”，从月黑日翌日开始到月圆日为“白月”。其中，月黑日和月圆日两天皆称为“十五日”(paṇṇarasika)。若遇小月，月黑日也可以在十四日。于是，在每半个月中，第八日、第十四和第十五日皆称为“伍波思特日”或“斋戒日”(uposatha-divasa)。斋戒日的日期约相当于中国农历的初八、十四、十五、二十三、廿九和三十日。
gǔ yìn dù de lì fǎ shǔ yú tài yīn lì， yī nián fèn shí èr gè yuè， yuè fèn àn yuè liàng rào dì qiú yùn zhuàn de zhōu qī tuī suàn。 tuī suàn fāng fǎ shì cóng měi gè yuè yuán rì de dì èr tiān míng xiāng chū xiàn (aruṇuggamana, lí míng ) shí kāi shǐ suàn qǐ， dào xià yí gè yuè yuán rì de dì èr tiān míng xiāng chū xiàn wèi zhì jié shù， yuē sān shí tiān （xiǎo yuè wèi èr shí jiǔ tiān） de shí jiān wèi yí gè yuè。 rú cǐ， měi gè yuè yòu kě fēn wéi liǎng gè bàn yuè： cóng yuè yuán rì yì rì kāi shǐ dào yuè hēi rì wèi “ hēi yuè ”， cóng yuè hēi rì yì rì kāi shǐ dào yuè yuán rì wèi “ bái yuè ”。 qí zhōng， yuè hēi rì hé yuè yuán rì liǎng tiān jiē chēng wéi “ shí wǔ rì ”(paṇṇarasika)。 ruò yù xiǎo yuè， yuè hēi rì yě kě yǐ zài shí sì rì。 yú shì， zài měi bàn gè yuè zhōng， dì bā rì、 dì shí sì hé dì shí wǔ rì jiē chēng wéi “ wǔ bō sī tè rì ” huò “ zhāi jiè rì ”(uposatha-divasa)。 zhāi jiè rì de rì qī yuē xiāng dāng yú zhōng guó nóng lì de chū bā、 shí sì、 shí wǔ、 èr shí sān、 niàn jiǔ hé sān shí rì。
The ancient Indian calendar is a lunar calendar of 12 months a year, calculated by the cycle of the moon around the Earth. The method of calculation begins on the day after each full month (aru uggmana, dawn) and ends on the day after the next full month, and ends on the day after the next full month (about 30 days (29 days in small months). Thus, each month can be divided into two and a half months: from the day after the first day of the month to the day of the month “Black Moon”, from the day after the day of the month to the day of the moon until the day of the full moon. Of these, the dates for the day of the fasting are known as “Fifteen days” (pa arasika). In the event of a small month, the month can also end in 14 days.
2. 在家居士所持守的学处之一 ——八戒
2. zài jiā jū shì suǒ chí shǒu de xué chù zhī yī —— bā jiè
One of the schools held by the homeowners - the Eight Rings
自从佛陀跋葛瓦在世时开始，在家居士就有于每个月的斋日来到塔寺，亲近僧团，听闻佛法，受持八戒的传统。由于八戒多数是在“伍波思特日”受持的，所以称为“具足八支(条)的伍波思特戒法”(aṭṭhaṅga samannāgata uposatha-sīla dhamma)。
zì cóng fó tuó bá gé wǎ zài shì shí kāi shǐ， zài jiā jū shì jiù yǒu yú měi gè yuè de zhāi rì lái dào tǎ sì， qīn jìn sēng tuán， tīng wén fó fǎ， shòu chí bā jiè de chuán tǒng。 yóu yú bā jiè duō shù shì zài “ wǔ bō sī tè rì ” shòu chí de， suǒ yǐ chēng wéi “ jù zú bā zhī ( tiáo ) de wǔ bō sī tè jiè fǎ ”(aṭṭhaṅga samannāgata uposatha-sīla dhamma)。
Since the time of the life of the Buddha's Guevah, family members have come to the Temple on Ramadan every month, close to the monks, to hear the Buddha's law and to be held in a tradition of eight. As most of the VIIIs are held on Woodbash Day, they are called the “Wordbeth Revival Act” (a ha ga samannāgata uposa-sbela dhamma).
3. 僧团举行的甘马之一 ——诵戒
3. sēng tuán jǔ xíng de gān mǎ zhī yī —— sòng jiè
One of the Ganmars held by the monasteries — a recitation
佛陀跋葛瓦规定：比库僧应在每个月的月圆日和月黑日两天举行伍波思特。在这一天，共住同一界内的所有比库僧应齐集界场，举行伍波思特甘马(uposathakamma)，念诵戒经《比库巴帝摩卡》(pātimokkhuddesa)。
fó tuó bá gé wǎ guī dìng： bǐ kù sēng yīng zài měi gè yuè de yuè yuán rì hé yuè hēi rì liǎng tiān jǔ xíng wǔ bō sī tè。 zài zhè yī tiān， gòng zhù tóng yī jiè nèi de suǒ yǒu bǐ kù sēng yīng qí jí jiè chǎng， jǔ xíng wǔ bō sī tè gān mǎ (uposathakamma)， niàn sòng jiè jīng 《 bǐ kù bā dì mó kǎ》(pātimokkhuddesa)。
The Buddha district Gwa stipulates that the Biku Monks shall meet in Wuboste two days each month at the full moon and on the dark of the moon. On that day, all Biku Monks shall meet in the same border, where uposathakamma will be held and the Bikumokkhuddesa will be recited.
由于“伍波思特”含有上述多种意思，以“多义不翻”故，一般情况多采用音译，在特定意义时则采用意译。
yóu yú “ wǔ bō sī tè ” hán yǒu shàng shù duō zhǒng yì si， yǐ “ duō yì bù fān ” gù， yì bān qíng kuàng duō cǎi yòng yīn yì， zài tè dìng yì yì shí zé cǎi yòng yì yì。
Because of the many meanings described above, “Wubost” is used more generally than in the case of “multiple meanings” or, in the case of particular meanings, in the case of translation.
伍波思特源于古印度吠陀以来的祭法。佛陀在世时，其他外道团体有于每半个月的八日、十四日、十五日举行集会的习惯。佛陀跋葛瓦接受马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王(Rājā māgadha seniya Bimbisāra)的建议，规定比库僧团应于斋日集会，向信徒们说法，後来又规定于每半月的十五日或十四日齐集诵《巴帝摩卡》。佛教僧团于每半月举行伍波思特诵戒的制度由此而来。
wǔ bō sī tè yuán yú gǔ yìn dù fèi tuó yǐ lái de jì fǎ。 fó tuó zài shì shí， qí tā wài dào tuán tǐ yǒu yú měi bàn gè yuè de bā rì、 shí sì rì、 shí wǔ rì jǔ xíng jí huì de xí guàn。 fó tuó bá gé wǎ jiē shòu mǎ gé tè guó xiè ní yà · bīn bǐ sà lēi wáng (Rājā māgadha seniya Bimbisāra) de jiàn yì， guī dìng bǐ kù sēng tuán yīng yú zhāi rì jí huì， xiàng xìn tú men shuō fǎ， hòu lái yòu guī dìng yú měi bàn yuè de shí wǔ rì huò shí sì rì qí jí sòng 《 bā dì mó kǎ》。 fó jiào sēng tuán yú měi bàn yuè jǔ xíng wǔ bō sī tè sòng jiè de zhì dù yóu cǐ ér lái。
Woodburn comes from the rituals of ancient Indian Vedas. Buddha's other foreign-world groups are accustomed to meeting every half month on 8th, 14th, and 15th. Buddha's Guwa accepted the advice of Rājāmāgadha seniya Bimbisāra of the State of Margot, which stipulates that the bhikkhu monks should meet on Ramadan and speak to the faithful, and then provide for a reading of the Batiamaka every half month on 15th or 14th days. The Buddhist monks meet every half month with a system of Wuboth readings.
在《律藏·诵戒篇》中说：
zài 《 lǜ cáng · sòng jiè piān》 zhōng shuō：
In The Book of the Book of the Book:
“当时，佛陀跋葛瓦住在王舍城鹫峰山。那个时候，外道游方僧们在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会说法，人们前往该处闻法。他们对外道游方僧获得喜爱、获得信心，外道游方僧们获得了信徒。
“ dāng shí， fó tuó bá gé wǎ zhù zài wáng shě chéng jiù fēng shān。 nà ge shí hòu， wài dào yóu fāng sēng men zài bàn yuè de shí sì rì、 shí wǔ rì jí bā rì jí huì shuō fǎ， rén men qián wǎng gāi chù wén fǎ。 tā men duì wài dào yóu fāng sēng huò dé xǐ ài、 huò dé xìn xīn， wài dào yóu fāng sēng men huò dé le xìn tú。
“At that time, the Buddha's Gowa lived in Wang Shek Mountain. At that time, the monks of the outer lanes met on the 14th, 15th and 8th of the month, and people went to hear it. They were loved, confident, and followers of the outside world.
当时，马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王在僻静地独处，心生如此想法:‘现在外道游方僧们在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会说法，人们为闻法前往该处。他们对外道游方僧获得喜爱、获得信心，外道游方僧们获得了信徒。就让诸聖尊们也可在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会。’
dāng shí， mǎ gé tè guó xiè ní yà · bīn bǐ sà lēi wáng zài pì jìng dì dú chǔ， xīn shēng rú cǐ xiǎng fǎ :‘ xiàn zài wài dào yóu fāng sēng men zài bàn yuè de shí sì rì、 shí wǔ rì jí bā rì jí huì shuō fǎ， rén men wèi wén fǎ qián wǎng gāi chù。 tā men duì wài dào yóu fāng sēng huò dé xǐ ài、 huò dé xìn xīn， wài dào yóu fāng sēng men huò dé le xìn tú。 jiù ràng zhū shèng zūn men yě kě zài bàn yuè de shí sì rì、 shí wǔ rì jí bā rì jí huì。’
At the time, King Xenia Binbisler of Magogte was alone in the middle of nowhere, thinking: "Now, the stories of the excursors meeting on the 14th, 15th and 8th of the month, and people go there to hear it. They get love and confidence from the excursors, and they get believers from the excursors. Then they can meet on the 14th, 15th and 8th of the month.
于是，马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王来到跋葛瓦之处。来到之後，顶礼跋葛瓦，坐在一边。坐在一边的马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王对跋葛瓦这样说：
yú shì， mǎ gé tè guó xiè ní yà · bīn bǐ sà lēi wáng lái dào bá gé wǎ zhī chù。 lái dào zhī hòu， dǐng lǐ bá gé wǎ， zuò zài yī biān。 zuò zài yī biān de mǎ gé tè guó xiè ní yà · bīn bǐ sà lēi wáng duì bá gé wǎ zhè yàng shuō：
So King Xenia Binbisal of Magogte came to the part of Gwa. Then he came to the top of Gwa, sitting side by side. King Xenia Binbisal of Magogte, sitting side by side, said to Gwa:
‘尊者，于此，我在僻静地独处，心生如此想法：现在外道游方僧们在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会说法，人们为闻法前往该处。他们对外道游方僧获得喜爱、获得信心，外道游方僧们获得信徒。就让诸聖尊们也可在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会。萨度！尊者，诸聖尊们也可在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会。’
‘ zūn zhě， yú cǐ， wǒ zài pì jìng dì dú chǔ， xīn shēng rú cǐ xiǎng fǎ： xiàn zài wài dào yóu fāng sēng men zài bàn yuè de shí sì rì、 shí wǔ rì jí bā rì jí huì shuō fǎ， rén men wèi wén fǎ qián wǎng gāi chù。 tā men duì wài dào yóu fāng sēng huò dé xǐ ài、 huò dé xìn xīn， wài dào yóu fāng sēng men huò dé xìn tú。 jiù ràng zhū shèng zūn men yě kě zài bàn yuè de shí sì rì、 shí wǔ rì jí bā rì jí huì。 sà dù！ zūn zhě， zhū shèng zūn men yě kě zài bàn yuè de shí sì rì、 shí wǔ rì jí bā rì jí huì。’
‘So, I am alone in the middle of the month, and I think so: now the monks of the outside world meet in the 14th, 15th and 8th days of the month, and the people travel there in their ears. They are loved, confident, and the monks of the outside world receive their followers. Let the saints also meet in the 14th, 15th and 8th days of the month. And the lords of the Shadu, may meet in the 14th, 15th and 8th days of the month.’
于是，跋葛瓦向马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王以法之论开示、劝导、鼓励、令喜悦。当时，马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王受跋葛瓦以法之论开示、劝导、鼓励而喜悦，从座而起，顶礼跋葛瓦，右绕之後离开。
yú shì， bá gé wǎ xiàng mǎ gé tè guó xiè ní yà · bīn bǐ sà lēi wáng yǐ fǎ zhī lùn kāi shì、 quàn dǎo、 gǔ lì、 lìng xǐ yuè。 dāng shí， mǎ gé tè guó xiè ní yà · bīn bǐ sà lēi wáng shòu bá gé wǎ yǐ fǎ zhī lùn kāi shì、 quàn dǎo、 gǔ lì ér xǐ yuè， cóng zuò ér qǐ， dǐng lǐ bá gé wǎ， yòu rào zhī hòu lí kāi。
As a result, Guevah inspired, persuaded, encouraged, and pleased King Xenia Binbissal of Magogte by the concept of the law. At that time, King Xenia Binbissal of Magogte was inspired, persuaded, encouraged and pleased by the idea of the law of the District, from the seat, from the top, from the top to the right, and then to the right.
于是，跋葛瓦于此因缘、于此机会说法而告诉比库们说：
yú shì， bá gé wǎ yú cǐ yīn yuán、 yú cǐ jī huì shuō fǎ ér gào sù bǐ kù men shuō：
As a result of this opportunity, Biku was told that:
‘诸比库，我允许在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会。’”(V.3.132)
‘ zhū bǐ kù， wǒ yǔn xǔ zài bàn yuè de shí sì rì、 shí wǔ rì jí bā rì jí huì。’”(V.3.132)
`The Zhubyku, I allow the meeting to take place on the 14th, 15th and 8th of the month.' (V.3.132)
“当时，跋葛瓦在僻静地独处，心生如此想法:‘现在我为比库们所制定的学处，应允许他们诵该巴帝摩卡，他们将以此为伍波思特甘马。’
“ dāng shí， bá gé wǎ zài pì jìng dì dú chǔ， xīn shēng rú cǐ xiǎng fǎ :‘ xiàn zài wǒ wèi bǐ kù men suǒ zhì dìng de xué chù， yīng yǔn xǔ tā men sòng gāi bā dì mó kǎ， tā men jiāng yǐ cǐ wéi wǔ bō sī tè gān mǎ。’
“At that time, Gwa was alone in a quiet place, and thought so: `Now, the place I have set up for Bikus, should allow them to recite the Batiamocca, which they will use as a Woo-Bothtganma.'
于是，跋葛瓦在傍晚时分禅坐起来後，于此因缘、于此机会说法而告诉比库们说：
yú shì， bá gé wǎ zài bàng wǎn shí fēn chán zuò qǐ lái hòu， yú cǐ yīn yuán、 yú cǐ jī huì shuō fǎ ér gào sù bǐ kù men shuō：
As a result, after Gwa had sat down at nightfall, he told Bikus, by reason of this opportunity,:
‘诸比库，于此，我在僻静地独处，心生如此想法：‘我为比库们所制定的学处，应允许他们诵该巴帝摩卡，他们将以此为伍波思特甘马。诸比库，我允许诵巴帝摩卡。’”(V.3.133)
‘ zhū bǐ kù， yú cǐ， wǒ zài pì jìng dì dú chǔ， xīn shēng rú cǐ xiǎng fǎ：‘ wǒ wèi bǐ kù men suǒ zhì dìng de xué chù， yīng yǔn xǔ tā men sòng gāi bā dì mó kǎ， tā men jiāng yǐ cǐ wéi wǔ bō sī tè gān mǎ。 zhū bǐ kù， wǒ yǔn xǔ sòng bā dì mó kǎ。’”(V.3.133)
‘And here, I am alone in the shadows, and I am thinking, ‘The place I have set for Bikus should allow them to recite the Batiamocca, which they will use as Woopostegama.’ ‘Zhubicou, I allow the Batiamocca.’” (V.3.133)
“那个时候，比库们以跋葛瓦允许伍波思特日诵巴帝摩卡，在半个月中诵了三次巴帝摩卡——在半月的十四日、十五日及八日。跋葛瓦因此宣告：
“ nà ge shí hòu， bǐ kù men yǐ bá gé wǎ yǔn xǔ wǔ bō sī tè rì sòng bā dì mó kǎ， zài bàn gè yuè zhōng sòng le sān cì bā dì mó kǎ —— zài bàn yuè de shí sì rì、 shí wǔ rì jí bā rì。 bá gé wǎ yīn cǐ xuān gào：
“At that time, Bikus allowed the Whoboste Day to recite Batiamocca, three times in six months — on the 14th, 15th, and 8th of the month. And so Gowa declared:
‘诸比库，不应半个月诵三次巴帝摩卡。若诵者，犯恶作。诸比库，我允许每半个月一次——在十四日或十五日——诵巴帝摩卡。’”(V.3.136)
‘ zhū bǐ kù， bù yīng bàn gè yuè sòng sān cì bā dì mó kǎ。 ruò sòng zhě， fàn è zuò。 zhū bǐ kù， wǒ yǔn xǔ měi bàn gè yuè yī cì —— zài shí sì rì huò shí wǔ rì —— sòng bā dì mó kǎ。’”(V.3.136)
'The Chumpicos should not recite Badimoca three times a month.' If the Recitation does evil, We allow it to be recited every half month - on 14 or 15 days.' (V.3.136).

第八节 诵巴帝摩卡的时间和地点

既然佛陀跋葛瓦规定比库们于每半个月诵一次巴帝摩卡，即在第十四日或第十五日。具体在十四或十五日，则应视历法而定。
jì rán fó tuó bá gé wǎ guī dìng bǐ kù men yú měi bàn gè yuè sòng yī cì bā dì mó kǎ， jí zài dì shí sì rì huò dì shí wǔ rì。 jù tǐ zài shí sì huò shí wǔ rì， zé yīng shì lì fǎ ér dìng。
If the Buddha region Gwa requires bhikkhu to recite the Batiamocca every half month, i.e. on the fourteenth or fifteenth day.
在律註中说：
zài lǜ zhù zhōng shuō：
It says:
“Cātuddase vā pannarase vā'ti ekassa utuno tatiye ca sattame ca pakkhe dvikkhattuṃ cātuddase, avasese chakkhattuṃ pannarase.”
“在十四日或十五日是指在一个季节中的第三个和第七个半月两次[诵戒]在十四日，其馀六次在十五日。”(V.A.3.136)
“ zài shí sì rì huò shí wǔ rì shì zhǐ zài yí gè jì jié zhōng de dì sān gè hé dì qī gè bàn yuè liǎng cì [ sòng jiè ] zài shí sì rì， qí yú liù cì zài shí wǔ rì。”(V.A.3.136)
“On 14 or 15 days means the third and seventh half-month [recitation] in one season and the sixth in 15 days on 14 days.” (V.A.3.136)
根据古印度的历法，一年分为3个季节：热季(gimhāna)、雨季(vassāna)和凉季(hemanta)，每个季节有4个月，共12个月。如此，一个季节有8个诵戒日，每月有2个，即黑月的十五日（月黑日）和白月的十五日（月圆日）。由于每个季节皆由黑月开始，因此逢单数的诵戒日为月黑日，逢双数的诵戒日为月圆日。在每个季节中，第1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8个半月有15天(paṇṇarasa)，而第3和第7个半月只有14天(catuddasa)。也即是说：在每个季节的第3个和第7个月黑日为“十四日”，其馀的皆为“十五日”。
gēn jù gǔ yìn dù de lì fǎ， yī nián fèn wèi 3 gè jì jié： rè jì (gimhāna)、 yǔ jì (vassāna) hé liáng jì (hemanta)， měi gè jì jié yǒu 4 gè yuè， gòng 12 gè yuè。 rú cǐ， yí gè jì jié yǒu 8 gè sòng jiè rì， měi yuè yǒu 2 gè， jí hēi yuè de shí wǔ rì （yuè hēi rì） hé bái yuè de shí wǔ rì （yuè yuán rì）。 yóu yú měi gè jì jié jiē yóu hēi yuè kāi shǐ， yīn cǐ féng dān shù de sòng jiè rì wèi yuè hēi rì， féng shuāng shù de sòng jiè rì wèi yuè yuán rì。 zài měi gè jì jié zhōng， dì 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8 gè bàn yuè yǒu 15 tiān (paṇṇarasa)， ér dì 3 hé dì 7 gè bàn yuè zhǐ yǒu 14 tiān (catuddasa)。 yě jí shì shuō： zài měi gè jì jié de dì 3 gè hé dì 7 gè yuè hēi rì wèi “ shí sì rì ”， qí yú de jiē wèi “ shí wǔ rì ”。
According to the ancient Indian calendar, each year is divided into three seasons: the hot season (gimhāna), the rainy season (vassāna) and the cool season (hemanta), each of which is four months and a total of 12 months. Thus, there are eight days for each season, two days for each month, 15 days for the black month (on the black of the month) and 15 days for the white month (on the round of the moon).
所以，僧团安排诵巴帝摩卡的日期，在每个季节的第三次和第七次诵戒在“十四日”，其馀的六次都在“十五日”。这是僧团举行诵戒的日期。
suǒ yǐ， sēng tuán ān pái sòng bā dì mó kǎ de rì qī， zài měi gè jì jié de dì sān cì hé dì qī cì sòng jiè zài “ shí sì rì ”， qí yú de liù cì dōu zài “ shí wǔ rì ”。 zhè shì sēng tuán jǔ xíng sòng jiè de rì qī。
Thus, the monks set the dates for the reading of Batiamoka, the third and seventh readings of each season in “fourteen days” and the sixth readings in “thirteen days”. This is the date on which the monks hold the readings.
至于在诵戒日的什么时候举行伍波思特，则可由各个僧团自行决定。现在许多僧团会选择在下午或傍晚举行。
zhì yú zài sòng jiè rì de shén me shí hòu jǔ xíng wǔ bō sī tè， zé kě yóu gè gè sēng tuán zì xíng jué dìng。 xiàn zài xǔ duō sēng tuán huì xuǎn zé zài xià wǔ huò bàng wǎn jǔ xíng。
It is up to the monasteries to decide when to hold Woodburn on the Day of Recitation. Many monks now choose to hold it in the afternoon or evening.
由于伍波思特甘马是僧团中比较重要的集会，所以《律藏》中对诵戒的场所有详细的规定：
yóu yú wǔ bō sī tè gān mǎ shì sēng tuán zhōng bǐ jiào zhòng yào de jí huì， suǒ yǐ 《 lǜ cáng》 zhōng duì sòng jiè de chǎng suǒ yǒu xiáng xì de guī dìng：
Since Woodboshtganma is a more important gathering in the monks, all the details of the recitation field in the Collection are as follows:
“当时，比库们这样想：‘跋葛瓦制定：依和合而为一住处。那怎样才是一住处呢？’此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]‘诸比库，我允许共结界。诸比库，应如此共结：首先应宣告[界]相——山相、石相、林相、树相、道路相、蚁垤相、河相、水相。”(V.3.138)
“ dāng shí， bǐ kù men zhè yàng xiǎng：‘ bá gé wǎ zhì dìng： yī hé hé ér wèi yī zhù chù。 nà zěn yàng cái shì yī zhù chù ne？’ cǐ shì bào gào bá gé wǎ，[ bá gé wǎ shuō :]‘ zhū bǐ kù， wǒ yǔn xǔ gòng jié jiè。 zhū bǐ kù， yīng rú cǐ gòng jié： shǒu xiān yīng xuān gào [ jiè ] xiāng —— shān xiāng、 shí xiāng、 lín xiāng、 shù xiāng、 dào lù xiāng、 yǐ dié xiāng、 hé xiāng、 shuǐ xiāng。”(V.3.138)
“At the time, Bikus thought, `The `Zone Gwa was set up as a residence.' What would be a place of residence?' The Zone Gwa was reported, [The Zone Gwa said] `The Zhu Gwa, I allow the Zhugwa to be bound together. `The Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu, Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu, Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu, Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Z
也即是说：住在同一区域的所有比库僧众必须集合在一起举行伍波思特甘马。凡举行甘马的地方，必须经由僧团共同认定范围，称为“结界”(sīmā sammuti)。在结界前，先须设立界相(sīmā nimitta)，即范围的标记。律中允许八种界相：以山为界相、以石为界相、以林为界相、以树为界相、以道路为界相、以蚁垤为界相、以河流为界相和以水为界相。现在的做法多数是以石为界相。
yě jí shì shuō： zhù zài tóng yī qū yù de suǒ yǒu bǐ kù sēng zhòng bì xū jí hé zài yì qǐ jǔ xíng wǔ bō sī tè gān mǎ。 fán jǔ xíng gān mǎ de dì fāng， bì xū jīng yóu sēng tuán gòng tóng rèn dìng fàn wéi， chēng wéi “ jié jiè ”(sīmā sammuti)。 zài jié jiè qián， xiān xū shè lì jiè xiāng (sīmā nimitta)， jí fàn wéi de biāo jì。 lǜ zhōng yǔn xǔ bā zhǒng jiè xiāng： yǐ shān wèi jiè xiāng、 yǐ shí wèi jiè xiāng、 yǐ lín wèi jiè xiāng、 yǐ shù wèi jiè xiāng、 yǐ dào lù wèi jiè xiāng、 yǐ yǐ dié wèi jiè xiāng、 yǐ hé liú wèi jiè xiāng hé yǐ shuǐ wèi jiè xiāng。 xiàn zài de zuò fǎ duō shù shì yǐ shí wèi jiè xiāng。
That is to say, all Biku monks who live in the same area must gather together to hold Woodbashtgama. Where Ganma is held, it must be determined by the monks, known as the "Sbelmā sammuti." Before the border is closed, the boundary must be marked by a boundary (sbelmā nimitta), which is the range. The law permits eight boundaries: mountain, stone, forest, tree, road, ant, river and water. Most of the ways now are stone.
在律註《疑惑度脱》中提到，界可以分为“已结之界”(baddhasīmā)和“未结之界”(abaddhasīmā)两类。其中，已结之界又可分为划定界、共住界和不离衣界三种；未结之界又可分为村界、七阿邦答勒界和泼水界三种。
zài lǜ zhù 《 yí huò dù tuō》 zhōng tí dào， jiè kě yǐ fēn wéi “ yǐ jié zhī jiè ”(baddhasīmā) hé “ wèi jié zhī jiè ”(abaddhasīmā) liǎng lèi。 qí zhōng， yǐ jié zhī jiè yòu kě fēn wéi huà dìng jiè、 gòng zhù jiè hé bù lí yī jiè sān zhǒng； wèi jié zhī jiè yòu kě fēn wéi cūn jiè、 qī ā bāng dá lēi jiè hé pō shuǐ jiè sān zhǒng。
In the commentary, "Suspension of Disquiet", it is mentioned that the boundary can be divided into "baddhasbemā" and "baddhasbemā" (Baddhasbemā). In addition, the boundary can be divided into "delineation" and "cohabitation" and "no separation"; the boundary can be divided into "village", "seven Abantal" and "water pouring."
在此将通过“以石为界相”来简单地说明结界的程序：先划定“界”范围。根据律制，界的范围最大不得超过三由旬，最小必须能够容纳二十一位比库坐下。划定界的范围後，再找来十六块大小相当的石块（范围较小者，八块也可以），分别放置于界的东南西北方和四个角落，每处各放两块，并把里面的那块作为“石相”(pāsāṇanimitta)。
zài cǐ jiāng tōng guò “ yǐ shí wèi jiè xiāng ” lái jiǎn dān dì shuō míng jié jiè de chéng xù： xiān huà dìng “ jiè ” fàn wéi。 gēn jù lǜ zhì， jiè de fàn wéi zuì dà bù dé chāo guò sān yóu xún， zuì xiǎo bì xū néng gòu róng nà èr shí yī wèi bǐ kù zuò xià。 huà dìng jiè de fàn wéi hòu， zài zhǎo lái shí liù kuài dà xiǎo xiāng dāng de shí kuài （fàn wéi jiào xiǎo zhě， bā kuài yě kě yǐ）， fēn bié fàng zhì yú jiè de dōng nán xī běi fāng hé sì gè jiǎo luò， měi chù gè fàng liǎng kuài， bìng bǎ lǐ miàn de nà kuài zuò wéi “ shí xiāng ”(pāsāṇanimitta)。
The process of bordering is briefly described here by “stone-to-stone”: first, the “boundary” is delimited. According to the law, the boundary is not to be more than three quarters long, but must at least be able to accommodate twenty-one bicoons. When the boundary is delimited, 16 more stones (smaller, eight can be) of a similar size will be found, located in the north-west south-west and four corners of the boundary, with two blocks each, and the one inside as a “boul phase” (pās animitta).
举行结界甘马前，先安排八位比库或未达上者分别站在界外的石相後边，然後再安排一位比库依次走到每个石相前，问道：“在东方是什么[界]相？”“石，尊者！”“这石是[界]相。”“是的，尊者！”……问完八方的界相後，再走到东方重复问一次，如是使所有界相皆能成为一连结。
jǔ xíng jié jiè gān mǎ qián， xiān ān pái bā wèi bǐ kù huò wèi dá shàng zhě fēn bié zhàn zài jiè wài de shí xiāng hòu biān， rán hòu zài ān pái yī wèi bǐ kù yī cì zǒu dào měi gè shí xiāng qián， wèn dào：“ zài dōng fāng shì shén me [ jiè ] xiāng？”“ shí， zūn zhě！”“ zhè shí shì [ jiè ] xiāng。”“ shì de， zūn zhě！”…… wèn wán bā fāng de jiè xiāng hòu， zài zǒu dào dōng fāng chóng fù wèn yī cì， rú shì shǐ suǒ yǒu jiè xiāng jiē néng chéng wéi yī lián jié。
Before holding the Gama of the borderline, arrange for eight pictories or unreached to stand behind each other, and then arrange for one by Biku to go to each of the rocks, and ask, “What is the [boundary] in the East?” “The Stone, the Lord!” “The Stone is the [boundary] in the East.” “Yes, the Lord!” After having asked the eight sides of the border, come to the East again and ask again, if all of them are bound together.
问完界相後，所有比库齐集于伸手所及的范围内，宣讲甘马文，共同认定此界为“共住、同一伍波思特界”(samānasaṃvāsa ekuposatha sīmā)。认定了“共住界”之後，再认定“不离衣界”(avippavāsa sīmā)。于是，在这个被划定的范围内所结之界，称为“划定界”(khaṇḍasīmā)。
wèn wán jiè xiāng hòu， suǒ yǒu bǐ kù qí jí yú shēn shǒu suǒ jí de fàn wéi nèi， xuān jiǎng gān mǎ wén， gòng tóng rèn dìng cǐ jiè wèi “ gòng zhù、 tóng yī wǔ bō sī tè jiè ”(samānasaṃvāsa ekuposatha sīmā)。 rèn dìng le “ gòng zhù jiè ” zhī hòu， zài rèn dìng “ bù lí yī jiè ”(avippavāsa sīmā)。 yú shì， zài zhè ge bèi huà dìng de fàn wéi nèi suǒ jié zhī jiè， chēng wéi “ huà dìng jiè ”(khaṇḍasīmā)。
After the interview, all Bikuchi gathered within the reach of his hand to speak of the Ganmarin community, which he identified as the “co-inhabited, and the same Wubosa” (samānasa vāsa ekuposatha sbemā). After identifying the “co-inhabited border”, he identified the “inhabited border” (avippavāsa sbemā).
佛陀又规定，如果在一个地方原先曾经如法地结过界，此後在该处所结之界皆为无效。为此，佛陀允许先解除原来所结之界(sīmāsamūhanana)，然後再结新界。如果想在一个新的地方结界，但又不清楚古代是否曾经结过界，为了使日後的甘马皆成为有效，为了保险起见，在结新界之前通常会先解除旧界。由于解界的甘马颇为复杂，于此不作详论。
fó tuó yòu guī dìng， rú guǒ zài yí gè dì fāng yuán xiān céng jīng rú fǎ dì jié guò jiè， cǐ hòu zài gāi chù suǒ jié zhī jiè jiē wèi wú xiào。 wèi cǐ， fó tuó yǔn xǔ xiān jiě chú yuán lái suǒ jié zhī jiè (sīmāsamūhanana)， rán hòu zài jié xīn jiè。 rú guǒ xiǎng zài yí gè xīn de dì fāng jié jiè， dàn yòu bù qīng chǔ gǔ dài shì fǒu céng jīng jié guò jiè， wèi le shǐ rì hòu de gān mǎ jiē chéng wéi yǒu xiào， wèi le bǎo xiǎn qǐ jiàn， zài jié xīn jiè zhī qián tōng cháng huì xiān jiě chú jiù jiè。 yóu yú jiě jiè de gān mǎ pǒ wèi fù zá， yú cǐ bù zuò xiáng lùn。
Buddha has also ruled that if a border had previously been established in a place, then it would not be valid. To that end, Buddha has allowed the original boundary to be removed and then the new border to be closed. If it is to be closed in a new place, it is not clear whether the ancients did, and in order to make the day-to-day Mamas effective, it will normally be dissolved before the new border is closed, for insurance reasons.
等结界甘马圆满之後，可把石相分别埋于界场的四方四隅，每处埋两块，里面的石块为界相，其外再预留出中间地带，称为“界隔”(sīmantarika)，以避免和其它的“界”相重叠。埋石相时，石块的上半部可以露出地面，形成明显的标记，使人们能清楚地辨认出界相。
děng jié jiè gān mǎ yuán mǎn zhī hòu， kě bǎ shí xiāng fēn bié mái yú jiè chǎng de sì fāng sì yú， měi chù mái liǎng kuài， lǐ miàn de shí kuài wèi jiè xiāng， qí wài zài yù liú chū zhōng jiān dì dài， chēng wéi “ jiè gé ”(sīmantarika)， yǐ bì miǎn hé qí tā de “ jiè ” xiāng chóng dié。 mái shí xiāng shí， shí kuài de shàng bàn bù kě yǐ lù chū dì miàn， xíng chéng míng xiǎn de biāo jì， shǐ rén men néng qīng chǔ dì biàn rèn chū jiè xiāng。
When the boundary is filled with mares, the rocks can be buried in four squares, each of which is two blocks, each of which is a boundary, and the middle is set aside, called the Sbermantarika, to avoid overlap with the other “frontiers.” When the rocks are buried, the first half of the rock can be exposed to the ground and form a clear mark that allows for a clear identification of the boundary.
在《律藏》中又提到“未结之界”的三种情况：
zài 《 lǜ cáng》 zhōng yòu tí dào “ wèi jié zhī jiè ” de sān zhǒng qíng kuàng：
There are three more cases of “unfinished boundaries” mentioned in the Collection:
“诸比库，在无结界或未设置处，若依止村庄或城镇而住，则以该村庄为村界，以城镇为镇界，为该处的共住、同一伍波思特[界]。
“ zhū bǐ kù， zài wú jié jiè huò wèi shè zhì chù， ruò yī zhǐ cūn zhuāng huò chéng zhèn ér zhù， zé yǐ gāi cūn zhuāng wèi cūn jiè， yǐ chéng zhèn wèi zhèn jiè， wèi gāi chù de gòng zhù、 tóng yī wǔ bō sī tè [ jiè ]。
“The village shall be used as the boundary of the village, and the town shall be the boundary of the town and the co-occupancy of the village and of the Wuboth [frontier], if the village or town is located on the unsolved or unincorporated border.
诸比库，如果在非村的林野，则周围以七个阿邦答勒为该处的共住、同一伍波思特[界]。
zhū bǐ kù， rú guǒ zài fēi cūn de lín yě， zé zhōu wéi yǐ qī gè ā bāng dá lēi wèi gāi chù de gòng zhù、 tóng yī wǔ bō sī tè [ jiè ]。
In the non-village woodfields, the Nhubiku are surrounded by seven Abontals, co-located with the same Wubost [boundary].
诸比库，一切河非界，一切海非界，一切自然湖非界。诸比库，若在河、海或自然湖中，则以中等[身材的]男子向周围泼水处为该处的共住、同一伍波思特[界]。”(V.3.147)
zhū bǐ kù， yī qiè hé fēi jiè， yī qiè hǎi fēi jiè， yī qiè zì rán hú fēi jiè。 zhū bǐ kù， ruò zài hé、 hǎi huò zì rán hú zhōng， zé yǐ zhōng děng [ shēn cái de ] nán zi xiàng zhōu wéi pō shuǐ chù wèi gāi chù de gòng zhù、 tóng yī wǔ bō sī tè [ jiè ]。”(V.3.147)
Dhubyku, all rivers, all seas, all lakes, all natural lakes, and in rivers, seas, or natural lakes, medium-sized [heavy] men pour water around them as co-habitants and the same Wuboste [boundary].” (V.3.147).
也即是说，如果比库去到边远的地方（例如欧洲、美洲）或没有界场的地方，可以当地政府设置的最小行政区域的范围作为村界(gāmasīmā)或镇界(nigamasīmā)。到了诵戒日，只要在该区域内的所有比库皆齐集并超过四位，则可举行诵戒。
yě jí shì shuō， rú guǒ bǐ kù qù dào biān yuǎn de dì fāng （lì rú ōu zhōu、 měi zhōu） huò méi yǒu jiè chǎng de dì fāng， kě yǐ dāng dì zhèng fǔ shè zhì de zuì xiǎo xíng zhèng qū yù de fàn wéi zuò wéi cūn jiè (gāmasīmā) huò zhèn jiè (nigamasīmā)。 dào le sòng jiè rì， zhǐ yào zài gāi qū yù nèi de suǒ yǒu bǐ kù jiē qí jí bìng chāo guò sì wèi， zé kě jǔ xíng sòng jiè。
This means that, if bhikkhu goes to a remote location (e.g. Europe, America) or to a place where there are no boundaries, the smallest administrative area set up by the local government can be the village (gāmasbemā) or the town (nigamasbemā).
在森林、郊野等处，则以人站在中央算起，四周各以七个阿邦德勒(sattabbhantarā)的范围为界，称为“七阿邦德勒界”(sattabbhantarasīmā)。这里，一个阿邦德勒等于28肘、56拃手的长度。
zài sēn lín、 jiāo yě děng chù， zé yǐ rén zhàn zài zhōng yāng suàn qǐ， sì zhōu gè yǐ qī gè ā bāng dé lēi (sattabbhantarā) de fàn wéi wèi jiè， chēng wéi “ qī ā bāng dé lēi jiè ”(sattabbhantarasīmā)。 zhè lǐ， yí gè ā bāng dé lēi děng yú 28 zhǒu、56 zhǎ shǒu de cháng dù。
In forests, suburbs, etc., people stand in the center, each of which is defined by the seven sattabbhantarās, called the “sattabbhandaras bemā”. Here, one Abondler is equal to 28 elbows, and 56 hand lengths.
如果是在河流、海洋或天然湖泊中央，则以一个中等身材的男子向四周尽力泼水，水所洒落的范围称为“泼水界”(udakukkhepasīmā)。
rú guǒ shì zài hé liú、 hǎi yáng huò tiān rán hú pō zhōng yāng， zé yǐ yí gè zhōng děng shēn cái de nán zi xiàng sì zhōu jìn lì pō shuǐ， shuǐ suǒ sǎ luò de fàn wéi chēng wéi “ pō shuǐ jiè ”(udakukkhepasīmā)。
In the middle of a river, ocean or natural lake, water is poured around the surrounding area by a medium-sized man, the extent of which is referred to as the udakukkhepasbemā.
比库僧团可在这三种已结之界和三种未结之界内举行伍波思特甘马，诵巴帝摩卡。
bǐ kù sēng tuán kě zài zhè sān zhǒng yǐ jié zhī jiè hé sān zhǒng wèi jié zhī jiè nèi jǔ xíng wǔ bō sī tè gān mǎ， sòng bā dì mó kǎ。
The Biku Monks can hold Wuboste Ganma in these three closed and three unsolved bounds to recite Batiamoka.

第九节 诵巴帝摩卡的基本程序

念诵巴帝摩卡可以分为略诵和广诵两种。除非是在发生危难的时候可以略诵，在正常情况下僧团皆须广诵。
niàn sòng bā dì mó kǎ kě yǐ fēn wéi lüè sòng hé guǎng sòng liǎng zhǒng。 chú fēi shì zài fā shēng wēi nàn de shí hòu kě yǐ lüè sòng， zài zhèng cháng qíng kuàng xià sēng tuán jiē xū guǎng sòng。
The recitation of Batiamoka can be divided into a short reading and a broad reading. Except in times of distress, the monks must read it out in normal circumstances.
在《律藏》中说：
zài 《 lǜ cáng》 zhōng shuō：
In the book, it says:
“当时，比库们这样想：‘有多少种诵巴帝摩卡?’
“ dāng shí， bǐ kù men zhè yàng xiǎng：‘ yǒu duō shǎo zhǒng sòng bā dì mó kǎ ?’
"And at that time, more than Cocos thought, "How many of them recited Badimoca?"
此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]
cǐ shì bào gào bá gé wǎ，[ bá gé wǎ shuō :]
This is reported to Gowa.
‘诸比库，有五种诵巴帝摩卡：
‘ zhū bǐ kù， yǒu wǔ zhǒng sòng bā dì mó kǎ：
"The Zhubykus, five of the different scriptures of Batiamoca:
诵完序後，可宣告其馀的已听闻；这是第一种诵巴帝摩卡。
sòng wán xù hòu， kě xuān gào qí yú de yǐ tīng wén； zhè shì dì yī zhǒng sòng bā dì mó kǎ。
And after that it shall be declared as hearing. This is the first of the recitations of Badi Mocca.
诵完序、诵完四巴拉基格後，可宣告其馀的已听闻；这是第二种诵巴帝摩卡。
sòng wán xù、 sòng wán sì bā lā jī gé hòu， kě xuān gào qí yú de yǐ tīng wén； zhè shì dì èr zhǒng sòng bā dì mó kǎ。
And after the reading of the four barakigs, it shall be declared that which is heard; this is the second reading of Batiamuka.
诵完序、诵完四巴拉基格、诵完十三僧始终後，可宣告其馀的已听闻；这是第三种诵巴帝摩卡。
sòng wán xù、 sòng wán sì bā lā jī gé、 sòng wán shí sān sēng shǐ zhōng hòu， kě xuān gào qí yú de yǐ tīng wén； zhè shì dì sān zhǒng sòng bā dì mó kǎ。
And after the prayer, and after the recitation of the Four Barakig, and the Thirteen Monks, declare what they have heard; and this is the third recitation of Batiamoka.
诵完序、诵四巴拉基格、诵完十三僧始终、诵完二不定後，可宣告其馀的已听闻；这是第四种诵巴帝摩卡。
sòng wán xù、 sòng sì bā lā jī gé、 sòng wán shí sān sēng shǐ zhōng、 sòng wán èr bù dìng hòu， kě xuān gào qí yú de yǐ tīng wén； zhè shì dì sì zhǒng sòng bā dì mó kǎ。
After the precitation, after the recitation of the four Barakigs, and after the reading of the thirteen monks, after the reading of the thirteen monks, and after the reading of the undeclared, they shall be able to declare what they have heard, and this is the fourth recitation of the Badi Mocca.
第五为广诵。
dì wǔ wèi guǎng sòng。
Fifthly, it's widely read.
诸比库，有这五种诵巴帝摩卡。’
zhū bǐ kù， yǒu zhè wǔ zhǒng sòng bā dì mó kǎ。’
Zhubyku, there's five of these quotes from Batiamoka.'
那个时候，比库们以跋葛瓦允许略诵巴帝摩卡，在一切时皆略诵巴帝摩卡。此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]
nà ge shí hòu， bǐ kù men yǐ bá gé wǎ yǔn xǔ lüè sòng bā dì mó kǎ， zài yī qiè shí jiē lüè sòng bā dì mó kǎ。 cǐ shì bào gào bá gé wǎ，[ bá gé wǎ shuō :]
At that time, Bikus allowed Batiamuka to be recited to the district of Gwa, and at all times to be recited to Batiamuka.
‘诸比库，不得略诵巴帝摩卡！若略诵者，犯恶作。’
‘ zhū bǐ kù， bù dé lüè sòng bā dì mó kǎ！ ruò lüè sòng zhě， fàn è zuò。’
‘Piku, not to recite Batiamuka! If you recite, do evil.’
那个时候，高沙喇国的一个住处在伍波思特当天发生了蛮族动乱，比库们不能广诵巴帝摩卡。此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]
nà ge shí hòu， gāo shā lǎ guó de yí gè zhù chù zài wǔ bō sī tè dàng tiān fā shēng le mán zú dòng luàn， bǐ kù men bù néng guǎng sòng bā dì mó kǎ。 cǐ shì bào gào bá gé wǎ，[ bá gé wǎ shuō :]
At that time, a house in the Gosa Lama was in the middle of the day of a riot of barbarians in Wooposte, and Bikus were unable to read more about Batiamoka.
‘诸比库，我允许在有危难时略诵巴帝摩卡。’
‘ zhū bǐ kù， wǒ yǔn xǔ zài yǒu wēi nàn shí lüè sòng bā dì mó kǎ。’
"Phicoku, I will allow a little recitation of Batiamoka in times of distress."
那个时候，六众比库在无危难时略诵巴帝摩卡。此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]
nà ge shí hòu， liù zhòng bǐ kù zài wú wēi nàn shí lüè sòng bā dì mó kǎ。 cǐ shì bào gào bá gé wǎ，[ bá gé wǎ shuō :]
At that time, the six bicoons recited Badimoca in the absence of distress.
‘诸比库，不得在无危难时略诵巴帝摩卡！若诵者，犯恶作。诸比库，我允许在有危难时略诵巴帝摩卡。在此的危难是：王难、贼难、火灾、水灾、人难、非人难、猛兽难、蛇难、命难和梵行难。诸比库，我允许在像这些危难[发生]时略诵巴帝摩卡，无危难时则广诵。’”(V.3.150)
‘ zhū bǐ kù， bù dé zài wú wēi nàn shí lüè sòng bā dì mó kǎ！ ruò sòng zhě， fàn è zuò。 zhū bǐ kù， wǒ yǔn xǔ zài yǒu wēi nàn shí lüè sòng bā dì mó kǎ。 zài cǐ de wēi nàn shì： wáng nán、 zéi nán、 huǒ zāi、 shuǐ zāi、 rén nán、 fēi rén nán、 měng shòu nán、 shé nán、 mìng nán hé fàn xíng nán。 zhū bǐ kù， wǒ yǔn xǔ zài xiàng zhè xiē wēi nàn [ fā shēng ] shí lüè sòng bā dì mó kǎ， wú wēi nàn shí zé guǎng sòng。’”(V.3.150)
‘The Pickus shall not recite Badimuka in the absence of distress! If the reciter does evil, I will allow the recitation of Badimuka in the event of distress. Here are the distresses: kings, thieves, fire, floods, humans, inhumans, beasts, snakes, fates, and vandals.’ ‘Pikus, I will allow the recitation of Badimuka in the event of [the occurrence of] these distresses, and when there is no distress, I will read it widely.’” (V.3.150)
到了诵戒日，僧团通常会出通知，提醒僧众们今天是诵戒日，并写明诵戒的时间和地点。
dào le sòng jiè rì， sēng tuán tōng cháng huì chū tōng zhī， tí xǐng sēng zhòng men jīn tiān shì sòng jiè rì， bìng xiě míng sòng jiè de shí jiān hé dì diǎn。
On the day of the recitation, the monks usually give notice to remind the monks that today is the day of the recitation and to state the time and place of the recitation.
诵巴帝摩卡一般可分为四个程序：
sòng bā dì mó kǎ yì bān kě fēn wéi sì gè chéng xù：
The reading of Batiamoka is usually divided into four procedures:
1.准备工作
1. zhǔn bèi gōng zuò
Preparatory work
2.宣告事前工作等
2. xuān gào shì qián gōng zuò děng
2. Declaration of pre-service, etc.
3.正诵
3. zhèng sòng
3. Recitation
4.回向
4. huí xiàng
4. Retroactivity
一、准备工作
yī、 zhǔn bèi gōng zuò
I. Preparatory work
准备工作又可分为事前任务和事前工作两种。
zhǔn bèi gōng zuò yòu kě fēn wéi shì qián rèn wù hé shì qián gōng zuò liǎng zhǒng。
The preparatory work can be divided into ex ante tasks and ex ante work.
1.事前任务包括打扫卫生、点灯、准备饮用水和洗用水、铺设座位四项。这四项工作必须在僧团齐集界场之前由下座比库或沙马内勒等完成。
1. shì qián rèn wù bāo kuò dǎ sǎo wèi shēng、 diǎn dēng、 zhǔn bèi yǐn yòng shuǐ hé xǐ yòng shuǐ、 pū shè zuò wèi sì xiàng。 zhè sì xiàng gōng zuò bì xū zài sēng tuán qí jí jiè chǎng zhī qián yóu xià zuò bǐ kù huò shā mǎ nèi lēi děng wán chéng。
1. The pre-mission tasks include cleaning, lighting, preparation of potable water and washing of water, and the laying of four seats. The four tasks must be performed by the next seat, the Piku or Shamanel, before the Monk meets the boundary.
2.事前工作包括带来有事比库的意欲（chanda，请假）和清净(pārisuddhi)、计算季节和诵戒的次数、计算参加诵戒比库的人数、教诲比库尼等四项。
2. shì qián gōng zuò bāo kuò dài lái yǒu shì bǐ kù de yì yù （chanda， qǐng jià） hé qīng jìng (pārisuddhi)、 jì suàn jì jié hé sòng jiè de cì shù、 jì suàn cān jiā sòng jiè bǐ kù de rén shù、 jiào huì bǐ kù ní děng sì xiàng。
Prior work consists of bringing about a situation involving the desire (chanda, leave) and clean (pārisuddhi), the calculation of seasons and the number of readings, the calculation of the number of participants in the reading of the book, and the teaching of Bikuni.
由于跋葛瓦规定犯戒的比库不能参加诵戒，所以，知道自己犯戒的比库在诵戒之前应该到另外一位比库面前坦白并忏悔自己所犯之罪。如果该比库所犯的都是轻罪，则在忏罪之後即回复清净。如果合格的比库达到四位或以上，则可开始举行伍波思特。
yóu yú bá gé wǎ guī dìng fàn jiè de bǐ kù bù néng cān jiā sòng jiè， suǒ yǐ， zhī dào zì jǐ fàn jiè de bǐ kù zài sòng jiè zhī qián yīng gāi dào lìng wài yī wèi bǐ kù miàn qián tǎn bái bìng chàn huǐ zì jǐ suǒ fàn zhī zuì。 rú guǒ gāi bǐ kù suǒ fàn de dōu shì qīng zuì， zé zài chàn zuì zhī hòu jí huí fù qīng jìng。 rú guǒ hé gé de bǐ kù dá dào sì wèi huò yǐ shàng， zé kě kāi shǐ jǔ xíng wǔ bō sī tè。
Since bhikkhu, who is charged with his or her crime, is not allowed to take part in the recitation, he or she should come to another bhikkhu to confess and confess to his or her crime before he or she reads it. If he or she is guilty of a misdemeanour, he or she will be released after the confession.
僧团在举行所有甘马时，处在同一界内的比库皆须齐集一处，并且不得分离于手臂之距离。也即是说，所有参加甘马的比库皆应挨近在一起共坐，两位比库之间的距离不能超过伸手所及的距离。
sēng tuán zài jǔ xíng suǒ yǒu gān mǎ shí， chù zài tóng yī jiè nèi de bǐ kù jiē xū qí jí yī chù， bìng qiě bù dé fēn lí yú shǒu bì zhī jù lí。 yě jí shì shuō， suǒ yǒu cān jiā gān mǎ de bǐ kù jiē yīng āi jìn zài yì qǐ gòng zuò， liǎng wèi bǐ kù zhī jiān de jù lí bù néng chāo guò shēn shǒu suǒ jí de jù lí。
The monks must be gathered together in the Bico within the same boundary and must not be separated from their arms. That is to say, all the Bicos who participate in the Kamma should sit together, and the distance between the two Bicos must not exceed the distance reached by the hand.
同时，在此比库聚中，除了比库之外，其他的所有人，包括比库尼、沙马内勒、在家人等皆不得内进，应远离到至少一个伸手所及的距离之外。
tóng shí， zài cǐ bǐ kù jù zhōng， chú le bǐ kù zhī wài， qí tā de suǒ yǒu rén， bāo kuò bǐ kù ní、 shā mǎ nèi lēi、 zài jiā rén děng jiē bù dé nèi jìn， yīng yuǎn lí dào zhì shǎo yí gè shēn shǒu suǒ jí de jù lí zhī wài。
At the same time, in this gathering, all but Biku, including Bikuni, Shamanele, family members, etc., are not allowed inside and should be kept away from at least one reach.
二、宣告事前工作等
èr、 xuān gào shì qián gōng zuò děng
II. Declaration of pre-service, etc.
在开始诵巴帝摩卡之前，僧团长老会选两位比库作为问律者和答律者，以问答的方式告知僧团伍波思特的各项准备工作做得如何、僧团是否达到诵戒的条件等。 宣告通常使用巴利语，但有些派别只由一位比库诵完宣告的内容，甚至是用当地的语言来宣告（如缅甸的善法派）。
zài kāi shǐ sòng bā dì mó kǎ zhī qián， sēng tuán zhǎng lǎo huì xuǎn liǎng wèi bǐ kù zuò wéi wèn lǜ zhě hé dá lǜ zhě， yǐ wèn dá de fāng shì gào zhī sēng tuán wǔ bō sī tè de gè xiàng zhǔn bèi gōng zuò zuò dé rú hé、 sēng tuán shì fǒu dá dào sòng jiè de tiáo jiàn děng。 xuān gào tōng cháng shǐ yòng bā lì yǔ， dàn yǒu xiē pài bié zhǐ yóu yī wèi bǐ kù sòng wán xuān gào de nèi róng， shèn zhì shì yòng dāng dì de yǔ yán lái xuān gào （rú miǎn diān de shàn fǎ pài）。
Before beginning the reading of Pātimokkha, the Monk Chief will choose two Bikus as law-and-answerers to inform the monks in question and answer questions about the manner in which Woodbowst's preparations were carried out, whether the monks met the terms of the recitation, etc. The proclamations are usually in the Pāḷi language, but some of the factions have only one Biku to finish the announcement, even in the local language (e.g. Myanmar's good law sect).
三、正诵
sān、 zhèng sòng
III. RELEVANT
当一切准备就绪後，僧团中的长老会指派一位比库诵巴帝摩卡（通常会事先通知）。于是，这位比库以巴利语背诵《比库巴帝摩卡》。
dāng yī qiè zhǔn bèi jiù xù hòu， sēng tuán zhōng de zhǎng lǎo huì zhǐ pài yī wèi bǐ kù sòng bā dì mó kǎ （tōng cháng huì shì xiān tōng zhī）。 yú shì， zhè wèi bǐ kù yǐ bā lì yǔ bèi sòng 《 bǐ kù bā dì mó kǎ》。
When everything was ready, the Presbyterian Church of the Monarchs appointed a Biku-Badimoca (usually with prior notice). The Biku-Pāḷi recited Biku-Pāḷi.
完整地背诵巴帝摩卡一般需要35-50分钟的时间，如果诵得稍慢一点，则需要一个小时或以上。在背诵的过程中，如果这位比库有些忘记或诵错的地方，旁边的比库往往会提醒他，使他能流利地、准确无误地背诵下去。
wán zhěng dì bèi sòng bā dì mó kǎ yì bān xū yào 35-50 fēn zhōng de shí jiān， rú guǒ sòng dé shāo màn yì diǎn， zé xū yào yí gè xiǎo shí huò yǐ shàng。 zài bèi sòng de guò chéng zhōng， rú guǒ zhè wèi bǐ kù yǒu xiē wàng jì huò sòng cuò de dì fāng， páng biān de bǐ kù wǎng wǎng huì tí xǐng tā， shǐ tā néng liú lì dì、 zhǔn què wú wù dì bèi sòng xià qù。
It usually takes 35 to 50 minutes to recite Badimoca in its entirety, and it takes an hour or more if it is to be recited a little slower. In the rereading process, if this Biku has forgotten or was wrong, the next one will often remind him that he can recite it in a fluent and accurate manner.
四、回向
sì、 huí xiàng
IV. RETURN
僧团在诵完巴帝摩卡後通常会做回向，回向的内容由各僧团（或派别）决定。斯里兰卡和缅甸的僧团多数以念诵《护卫经》或散播慈爱等为主，泰国僧团则多数会念些偈颂。做完回向之後，僧团长老通常还会利用僧众集会的因缘给予教诫。
sēng tuán zài sòng wán bā dì mó kǎ hòu tōng cháng huì zuò huí xiàng， huí xiàng de nèi róng yóu gè sēng tuán （huò pài bié） jué dìng。 sī lǐ lán kǎ hé miǎn diān de sēng tuán duō shù yǐ niàn sòng 《 hù wèi jīng》 huò sàn bō cí ài děng wéi zhǔ， tài guó sēng tuán zé duō shù huì niàn xiē jì sòng。 zuò wán huí xiàng zhī hòu， sēng tuán zhǎng lǎo tōng cháng hái huì lì yòng sēng zhòng jí huì de yīn yuán jǐ yǔ jiào jiè。
The monks usually turn back when they finish the Pātimokkha, and what they turn back is decided by the monks (or sects). Most monks in Sri Lanka and Myanmar are mainly concerned with the reading of the Guardian or the spread of mercy, while most monks in Thailand recite hymns.
如果同住在一个界内的合格比库达到四位或四位以上，到诵戒日则应举行诵巴帝摩卡，因为四位比库即组成一个僧团(saṅgha)。如果只有两、三位比库共住，属于小众(gaṇa)，不用诵巴帝摩卡，只需作“清净伍波思特”(pārisuddhi-uposatha)。若只有一位比库独住，属于个人(puggala)，到了诵戒日只需作“决意伍波思特”(adhiṭṭhāna-uposatha)即可。具体的做法见本书 p.340-341。(V.3.168)
rú guǒ tóng zhù zài yí gè jiè nèi de hé gé bǐ kù dá dào sì wèi huò sì wèi yǐ shàng， dào sòng jiè rì zé yìng jǔ xíng sòng bā dì mó kǎ， yīn wèi sì wèi bǐ kù jí zǔ chéng yí gè sēng tuán (saṅgha)。 rú guǒ zhǐ yǒu liǎng、 sān wèi bǐ kù gòng zhù， shǔ yú xiǎo zhòng (gaṇa)， bù yòng sòng bā dì mó kǎ， zhǐ xū zuò “ qīng jìng wǔ bō sī tè ”(pārisuddhi-uposatha)。 ruò zhǐ yǒu yī wèi bǐ kù dú zhù， shǔ yú gè rén (puggala)， dào le sòng jiè rì zhǐ xū zuò “ jué yì wǔ bō sī tè ”(adhiṭṭhāna-uposatha) jí kě。 jù tǐ de zuò fǎ jiàn běn shū p.340-341。(V.3.168)
If you are living with a qualified Biku in a community of four or more, you should recite Batiamuka on the day of the recitation, because the four Bicus form a monks (sa gha). If only two or three Bicus live together, they belong to a small group (ga a) and do not read Batiamuka, but only “Pārisuddhi-uposatha.” If only one person lives alone and belongs to a person (puggala), only “decisively” Wubosta (adhi hāna-uposatha) is required on the day of the recitation.

1. ruò bǐ kù dé dào bǐ kù men zhī xué hé shēng huó guī zé， wèi shě qì xué， méi biǎo míng léi ruò ér cóng shì yín yù fǎ zhě， nǎi zhì hé chù sheng， yě shì bā lā jī gé， bù gòng zhù。
If a monk, after taking on the monks’ training and way of life, without first renouncing the training and revealing his weakness, has sexual intercourse, even with a female animal, he is expelled and excluded from the community.
2. Yo pana bhikkhu gāmā vā araññā vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyya, yathārūpe adinnādāne rājāno coraṃ gahetvā haneyyuṃ vā bandheyyuṃ vā pabbājeyyuṃ vā corosi bālosi mūḷhosi thenosīti, tathārūpaṃ bhikkhu adinnaṃ ādiyamāno ayampi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
2.若比库从村落或林野，以偷盗之心不与而取，因如何般不与取，诸王抓住盗贼後会打杀、捆缚或驱逐:“你是小偷、愚者、痴者、盗贼。”如此般不与而取的这比库也是巴拉基格，不共住。
2. ruò bǐ kù cóng cūn luò huò lín yě， yǐ tōu dào zhī xīn bù yǔ ér qǔ， yīn rú hé bān bù yǔ qǔ， zhū wáng zhuā zhù dào zéi hòu huì dǎ shā、 kǔn fù huò qū zhú :“ nǐ shì xiǎo tōu、 yú zhě、 chī zhě、 dào zéi。” rú cǐ bān bù yǔ ér qǔ de zhè bǐ kù yě shì bā lā jī gé， bù gòng zhù。
3. They do not have [violations] of the same crimes as non-current foods.
3. Yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, satthahārakaṃ vāssa pariyeseyya, maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya “ambho purisa kiṃ tuyhiminā pāpakena dujjīvitena, matante jīvitā seyyo”ti, iti cittamano cittasaṅkappo anekapariyāyena maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya, ayampi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
3.若比库故意夺取人命，或为其寻找可取[命]的杀具，或赞叹死亡的美好，或劝勉死:“喂，男子！你为何以此悲惨地痛苦活着？你死了比活着更好!”如是心意、心思惟，用各种方法赞叹死亡的美好，或劝勉死，这也是巴拉基格，不共住。
3. ruò bǐ kù gù yì duó qǔ rén mìng， huò wèi qí xún zhǎo kě qǔ [ mìng ] de shā jù， huò zàn tàn sǐ wáng de měi hǎo， huò quàn miǎn sǐ :“ wèi， nán zi！ nǐ wèi hé yǐ cǐ bēi cǎn dì tòng kǔ huó zhe？ nǐ sǐ le bǐ huó zhe gèng hǎo !” rú shì xīn yì、 xīn sī wéi， yòng gè zhǒng fāng fǎ zàn tàn sǐ wáng de měi hǎo， huò quàn miǎn sǐ， zhè yě shì bā lā jī gé， bù gòng zhù。
4. There shall be no person within their reach who shall be removed out of their reach.
4. Yo pana bhikkhu anabhijānaṃ uttarimanussa- dhammaṃ attūpanāyikaṃ alamariyañāṇadassanaṃ
4.若比库声称关于自己未证知的、能为聖智见
4. ruò bǐ kù shēng chēng guān yú zì jǐ wèi zhèng zhī de、 néng wèi shèng zhì jiàn
In this way, Woopstegama (invited to Ganma) is composed of four particulars, known as “the time has come” and fit to do something.
samudācareyya “iti jānāmi, iti passāmī”ti, tato aparena samayena samanuggāhiyamāno vā asamanuggāhiyamāno vā āpanno visuddhāpekkho evaṃ vadeyya “ajānamevaṃ āvuso avacaṃ jānāmi, apassaṃ passāmi, tucchaṃ musā vilapin”ti, aññatra adhimānā, ayampi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
的上人法:“我如是知，我如是见。”从那之後的时间，[无论]被检问或没被检问，已犯罪却希望清净而如此说：“诸贤友，不知如此而言‘我知’，不见[而言]‘我见’，说了空无的虚妄语。”除了增上慢外，这也是巴拉基格，不共住。
de shàng rén fǎ :“ wǒ rú shì zhī， wǒ rú shì jiàn。” cóng nà zhī hòu de shí jiān，[ wú lùn ] bèi jiǎn wèn huò méi bèi jiǎn wèn， yǐ fàn zuì què xī wàng qīng jìng ér rú cǐ shuō：“ zhū xián yǒu， bù zhī rú cǐ ér yán ‘ wǒ zhī ’， bú jiàn [ ér yán ]‘ wǒ jiàn ’， shuō le kōng wú de xū wàng yǔ。” chú le zēng shàng màn wài， zhè yě shì bā lā jī gé， bù gòng zhù。
Knowing that the time has come for the Whobothtgama, it should be clear that the monks are now in Whoboth (and that the monks are now in the process of being invited).
Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto cattāro pārājikā dhammā. Yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā na labhati bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ yathā pure, tathā pacchā, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
诸具寿，已诵出四巴拉基格法。若比库犯了其中任何一种，则不得和比库们一起共住，以後就像先前那样，是巴拉基格，不共住。
zhū jù shòu， yǐ sòng chū sì bā lā jī gé fǎ。 ruò bǐ kù fàn le qí zhōng rèn hé yī zhǒng， zé bù dé hé bǐ kù men yì qǐ gòng zhù， yǐ hòu jiù xiàng xiān qián nà yàng， shì bā lā jī gé， bù gòng zhù。
"Sado, the Lord"
Tatthāyasmante pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
对此我问具寿们是否清净？
duì cǐ wǒ wèn jù shòu men shì fǒu qīng jìng？
In regard to this I ask you, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Dutiyampi pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
第二次我再问是否清净？
dì èr cì wǒ zài wèn shì fǒu qīng jìng？
A second time I ask, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Tatiyampi pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
第三次我再问是否清净？
dì sān cì wǒ zài wèn shì fǒu qīng jìng？
A third time I ask, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Parisuddhetthāyasmanto, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmi.
具寿们对此是清净的，因此沉默。此事我如是持。
jù shòu men duì cǐ shì qīng jìng de， yīn cǐ chén mò。 cǐ shì wǒ rú shì chí。
You are pure in this and therefore silent. I will remember it thus.
Pārājikuddeso dutiyo.
——巴拉基格诵第二——
—— bā lā jī gé sòng dì èr ——
Salute the area of Gwa, Arahan, the conscious!

桑喀地谢思诵

Ime kho panāyasmanto terasa saṅghādisesā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
诸具寿，诵出此十三桑喀地谢思法来。
zhū jù shòu， sòng chū cǐ shí sān sāng kā dì xiè sī fǎ lái。
Venerables, these thirteen rules on suspension come up for recitation.
1. Sañcetanikā sukkavisaṭṭhi aññatra supinantā saṅghādiseso.
1.故意出精，除了梦中外，桑喀地谢思。
1. gù yì chū jīng， chú le mèng zhōng wài， sāng kā dì xiè sī。
Intentional emission of semen, except while dreaming, is an offense entailing suspension.
2. Yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmena saddhiṃ kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjeyya hatthagāhaṃ vā veṇigāhaṃ vā aññatarassa vā aññatarassa vā aṅgassa parāmasanaṃ, saṅghādiseso.
2.若比库以贪染、变易之心和女人发生身体相接触，或捉手，或捉发，或摩触任何部分者，桑喀地谢思。
2. ruò bǐ kù yǐ tān rǎn、 biàn yì zhī xīn hé nǚ rén fā shēng shēn tǐ xiāng jiē chù， huò zhuō shǒu， huò zhuō fā， huò mó chù rèn hé bù fèn zhě， sāng kā dì xiè sī。
If a monk, overcome by lust and with a distorted mind, makes physical contact with a woman—holding her hand or hair, or touching any part of her body—he commits an offense entailing suspension.
3. Yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāseyya yathā taṃ yuvā yuvatiṃ methūnupasaṃhitāhi, saṅghādiseso.
3.若比库以贪染、变易之心对女人说粗俗语，犹如少男对少女[说]和淫欲相关者一样，桑喀地谢思。
3. ruò bǐ kù yǐ tān rǎn、 biàn yì zhī xīn duì nǚ rén shuō cū sú yǔ， yóu rú shào nán duì shào nǚ [ shuō ] hé yín yù xiāng guān zhě yī yàng， sāng kā dì xiè sī。
If a monk, overcome by lust and with a distorted mind, speaks indecent words to a woman, as a young man might to a young woman and referring to sexual intercourse, he commits an offense entailing suspension.
4. Yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmassa santike attakāmapāricariyāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya “etadaggaṃ bhagini pāricariyānaṃ yā mādisaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ brahmacāriṃ etena dhammena paricareyyā”ti methūnupasaṃhitena, saṅghādiseso.
4.若比库以贪染、变易之心在女人面前，赞叹以欲侍奉自己:“姐妹，若用此法来侍奉像我这样的持戒者、善法者、梵行者，这是诸侍奉中最高的。”和淫欲相关者，桑喀地谢思。
4. ruò bǐ kù yǐ tān rǎn、 biàn yì zhī xīn zài nǚ rén miàn qián， zàn tàn yǐ yù shì fèng zì jǐ :“ jiě mèi， ruò yòng cǐ fǎ lái shì fèng xiàng wǒ zhè yàng de chí jiè zhě、 shàn fǎ zhě、 fàn xíng zhě， zhè shì zhū shì fèng zhōng zuì gāo de。” hé yín yù xiāng guān zhě， sāng kā dì xiè sī。
The nobles ask the monks to listen to me [saying] that today is the fifteenth day of Wooboth. And if the monks are ready, they shall take Woo Bosch and recite Batiamoka.
5. Yo pana bhikkhu sañcarittaṃ samāpajjeyya itthiyā vā purisamatiṃ purisassa vā itthimatiṃ, jāyattane vā jārattane vā, antamaso taṅkhaṇikāya'pi, saṅghādiseso.
5.若比库从事做媒，[传达]男子情意给女子，或女子情意给男子，而成为妻子或情人，乃至短暂关系，也桑喀地谢思。
5. ruò bǐ kù cóng shì zuò méi，[ chuán dá ] nán zi qíng yì gěi nǚ zǐ， huò nǚ zǐ qíng yì gěi nán zi， ér chéng wéi qī zǐ huò qíng rén， nǎi zhì duǎn zàn guān xì， yě sāng kā dì xiè sī。
If a monk acts as a matchmaker, conveying a man’s intention to a woman or a woman’s intention to a man, for marriage or for an affair, even if just a brief one, he commits an offense entailing suspension.
6. Saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatridaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ sattantarā, bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya, tehi bhikkhūhi vatthu desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ. Sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane saññācikāya kuṭiṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, pamāṇaṃ vā atikkāmeyya, saṅghādiseso.
6.比库指定为自己建造自行乞求的无[施]主孤邸时，应适量而造。对此其量是：长为善至张手的十二张手，内部宽为七张。应带领比库们指示地点，应由那些比库指示无侵害、有环绕空间的地点。假如比库在有侵害、无环绕空间的地点建造自行乞求的孤邸，或未带领比库们指示地点，或超过量者，桑喀地谢思。
6. bǐ kù zhǐ dìng wèi zì jǐ jiàn zào zì xíng qǐ qiú de wú [ shī ] zhǔ gū dǐ shí， yīng shì liàng ér zào。 duì cǐ qí liàng shì： zhǎng wèi shàn zhì zhāng shǒu de shí èr zhāng shǒu， nèi bù kuān wèi qī zhāng。 yīng dài lǐng bǐ kù men zhǐ shì dì diǎn， yīng yóu nà xiē bǐ kù zhǐ shì wú qīn hài、 yǒu huán rào kōng jiān de dì diǎn。 jiǎ rú bǐ kù zài yǒu qīn hài、 wú huán rào kōng jiān de dì diǎn jiàn zào zì xíng qǐ qiú de gū dǐ， huò wèi dài lǐng bǐ kù men zhǐ shì dì diǎn， huò chāo guò liàng zhě， sāng kā dì xiè sī。
What is the missionary's pre-work? Please inform the rest of your life that I will recite Batiamocca. Please listen to this and give it to all present!
7. Mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena sassāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya, tehi bhikkhūhi vatthu desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ. Sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane mahallakaṃ vihāraṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, saṅghādiseso.
7.比库在为自己建造有[施]主的大住所时，应带领比库们指示地点，应由那些比库指示无侵害、有环绕空间的地点。假如比库在有侵害、无环绕空间的地点建造大住所，或未带领比库们指示地点者，桑喀地谢思。
7. bǐ kù zài wèi zì jǐ jiàn zào yǒu [ shī ] zhǔ de dà zhù suǒ shí， yīng dài lǐng bǐ kù men zhǐ shì dì diǎn， yīng yóu nà xiē bǐ kù zhǐ shì wú qīn hài、 yǒu huán rào kōng jiān de dì diǎn。 jiǎ rú bǐ kù zài yǒu qīn hài、 wú huán rào kōng jiān de dì diǎn jiàn zào dà zhù suǒ， huò wèi dài lǐng bǐ kù men zhǐ shì dì diǎn zhě， sāng kā dì xiè sī。
And whoever is guilty, he confesses; and whoever is not guilty shall remain silent; and in silence, I shall know that the life is pure. Just as there is an answer to a single question, and so there is a declaration in such a crowd, even a third time. And if Bicou remembers guilt when he does not confess, and when he does do so for the third time, it is a deliberate lie to him. And in life, Zhu Gueva says that false words are the law of obstruction. So remember that he who has broken the law and wished that he should confess his guilt, and that he should confess to him because he confessed.
8. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya “appeva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan”ti. tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā amūlakañceva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅghādiseso.
8.若比库恶意、瞋恨、不满，用无根据的巴拉基格法诽谤比库:“或许能使他从梵行退堕。”从那之後的时间，[无论]被检问或没被检问，那案情只是毫无根据的，且比库基于瞋恨，桑喀地谢思。
8. ruò bǐ kù è yì、 chēn hèn、 bù mǎn， yòng wú gēn jù de bā lā jī gé fǎ fěi bàng bǐ kù :“ huò xǔ néng shǐ tā cóng fàn xíng tuì duò。” cóng nà zhī hòu de shí jiān，[ wú lùn ] bèi jiǎn wèn huò méi bèi jiǎn wèn， nà àn qíng zhǐ shì háo wú gēn jù de， qiě bǐ kù jī yú chēn hèn， sāng kā dì xiè sī。
Life, [abolition] has been recited.
9. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassa kiñcidesaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāya pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya “appeva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan”ti. tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā aññabhāgiyañceva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti kocideso lesamatto upādinno, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅghādiseso.
9.若比库恶意、瞋恨、不满，取其它事情的某些部分类似之处，用巴拉基格法诽谤比库:“或许能使他从此梵行退堕。”从那之後的时间，[无论]被检问或没被检问，那案情只是取了其它部分的某些类似之处，且比库基于瞋恨，桑喀地谢思。
9. ruò bǐ kù è yì、 chēn hèn、 bù mǎn， qǔ qí tā shì qíng de mǒu xiē bù fèn lèi sì zhī chù， yòng bā lā jī gé fǎ fěi bàng bǐ kù :“ huò xǔ néng shǐ tā cóng cǐ fàn xíng tuì duò。” cóng nà zhī hòu de shí jiān，[ wú lùn ] bèi jiǎn wèn huò méi bèi jiǎn wèn， nà àn qíng zhǐ shì qǔ le qí tā bù fèn de mǒu xiē lèi sì zhī chù， qiě bǐ kù jī yú chēn hèn， sāng kā dì xiè sī。
Let me ask you, is the birthdays clean?
10. Yo pana bhikkhu samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkameyya, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha tiṭṭheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evamassa vacanīyo “mā āyasmā samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkami, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi, sametāyasmā saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatī”ti, evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya, yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce paṭinissajjeyya, saṅghādiseso.
10.若比库致力于和合僧团的分裂，或受持、坚持导致分裂之事而住。比库们要如此劝告那个比库:“请具寿不要致力于和合僧团的分裂，或受持、坚持导致分裂之事而住。请具寿与僧团和合，和合的僧团确实欢喜、无争、同一诵[戒]而安乐住！”那个比库被比库们如此劝告时，仍然那样坚持，比库们为了使那比库捨弃它，应乃至第三次劝谏。在乃至第三次劝谏时如果捨弃了它，这样很好。假如不捨弃，桑喀地谢思。
10. ruò bǐ kù zhì lì yú hé hé sēng tuán de fēn liè， huò shòu chí、 jiān chí dǎo zhì fēn liè zhī shì ér zhù。 bǐ kù men yào rú cǐ quàn gào nà ge bǐ kù :“ qǐng jù shòu bú yào zhì lì yú hé hé sēng tuán de fēn liè， huò shòu chí、 jiān chí dǎo zhì fēn liè zhī shì ér zhù。 qǐng jù shòu yǔ sēng tuán hé hé， hé hé de sēng tuán què shí huān xǐ、 wú zhēng、 tóng yī sòng [ jiè ] ér ān lè zhù！” nà ge bǐ kù bèi bǐ kù men rú cǐ quàn gào shí， réng rán nà yàng jiān chí， bǐ kù men wèi le shǐ nà bǐ kù shě qì tā， yīng nǎi zhì dì sān cì quàn jiàn。 zài nǎi zhì dì sān cì quàn jiàn shí rú guǒ shě qì le tā， zhè yàng hěn hǎo。 jiǎ rú bù shě qì， sāng kā dì xiè sī。
The second time I asked if it was clean?
11. Tasseva kho pana bhikkhussa bhikkhū honti anuvattakā vaggavādakā eko vā dve vā tayo vā, te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ “mā āyasmanto etaṃ bhikkhuṃ kiñci avacuttha, dhammavādī ceso bhikkhu, vinayavādī ceso bhikkhu, amhākañceso bhikkhu chandañca ruciñca ādāya voharati, jānāti no bhāsati, amhākampetaṃ khamatī”ti, te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi evamassu vacanīyā “mā āyasmanto evaṃ avacuttha, na ceso bhikkhu dhammavādī, na ceso bhikkhu vinayavādī, mā āyasmantānampi saṅghabhedo ruccittha, sametāyasmantānaṃ saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatī”ti evañca te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vuccamānā tatheva paggaṇheyyuṃ, te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya, yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyyuṃ, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce paṭinissajjeyyuṃ, saṅghādiseso.
11.就那个比库的追随者、别众说者有一个、两个或三个比库，若他们如此说:“诸具寿，请不要说那位比库的任何事。那位比库是依法说者，那位比库是依律说者，那位比库取我们所欲和所喜乐的而说，知道我们而说，那是我们认可的。”比库们要如此劝告那些比库:“请具寿们不要如此说，那个比库不是依法说者，那个比库也不是依律说者。诸具寿，不要喜欢分裂僧团。诸具寿，请与僧团和合，和合的僧团确实是欢喜、无争、同一诵[戒]、安乐而住的！”当比库们在如此劝告那些比库时，他们仍然坚持，比库们为了使那些比库捨弃它，应乃至第三次劝谏。在乃至第三次劝谏时如果捨弃了它，这样很好。假如不捨弃，桑喀地谢思。
11. jiù nà ge bǐ kù de zhuī suí zhě、 bié zhòng shuō zhě yǒu yí gè、 liǎng gè huò sān gè bǐ kù， ruò tā men rú cǐ shuō :“ zhū jù shòu， qǐng bú yào shuō nà wèi bǐ kù de rèn hé shì。 nà wèi bǐ kù shì yī fǎ shuō zhě， nà wèi bǐ kù shì yī lǜ shuō zhě， nà wèi bǐ kù qǔ wǒ men suǒ yù hé suǒ xǐ lè de ér shuō， zhī dào wǒ men ér shuō， nà shì wǒ men rèn kě de。” bǐ kù men yào rú cǐ quàn gào nà xiē bǐ kù :“ qǐng jù shòu men bú yào rú cǐ shuō， nà ge bǐ kù bú shì yī fǎ shuō zhě， nà ge bǐ kù yě bú shì yī lǜ shuō zhě。 zhū jù shòu， bú yào xǐ huān fēn liè sēng tuán。 zhū jù shòu， qǐng yǔ sēng tuán hé hé， hé hé de sēng tuán què shí shì huān xǐ、 wú zhēng、 tóng yī sòng [ jiè ]、 ān lè ér zhù de！” dāng bǐ kù men zài rú cǐ quàn gào nà xiē bǐ kù shí， tā men réng rán jiān chí， bǐ kù men wèi le shǐ nà xiē bǐ kù shě qì tā， yīng nǎi zhì dì sān cì quàn jiàn。 zài nǎi zhì dì sān cì quàn jiàn shí rú guǒ shě qì le tā， zhè yàng hěn hǎo。 jiǎ rú bù shě qì， sāng kā dì xiè sī。
The third time I asked if it was clean?
12. Bhikkhu paneva dubbacajātiko hoti uddesa- pariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti “mā maṃ āyasmanto kiñci avacuttha kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, ahampāyasmante na kiñci vakkhāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, viramathāyasmanto mama vacanāyā”ti, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evamassa vacanīyo “mā āyasmā attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ akāsi, vacanīyamev'āyasmā attānaṃ karotu, āyasmāpi bhikkhū vadetu sahadhammena, bhikkhūpi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena, evaṃ saṃvaddhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yadidaṃ aññamaññavacanena aññamañña-
vuṭṭhāpanenā”ti, evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce paṭinissajjeyya, saṅghādiseso.
12.有生性难教的比库，被比库们在属于所诵的学处内如法地劝告时，使自己不受劝告:“请具寿们不要劝告我任何善的或恶的，我也不会劝说具寿们任何善的或恶的，请具寿们停止劝告我！”比库们要如此劝告那个比库:“请具寿不要使自己不受劝告，请具寿使自己接受劝告，请具寿如法地劝告比库们，比库们也如法地劝说具寿。由于互相劝告，互相出罪，如此那位跋葛瓦之众即增长。”那个比库被比库们如此劝告时，仍然那样坚持，比库们为了使那比库捨弃它，应乃至第三次劝谏。在乃至第三次劝谏时如果捨弃了它，这样很好。假如不捨弃，桑喀地谢思。
12. yǒu shēng xìng nán jiào de bǐ kù， bèi bǐ kù men zài shǔ yú suǒ sòng de xué chù nèi rú fǎ dì quàn gào shí， shǐ zì jǐ bù shòu quàn gào :“ qǐng jù shòu men bú yào quàn gào wǒ rèn hé shàn de huò è de， wǒ yě bú huì quàn shuō jù shòu men rèn hé shàn de huò è de， qǐng jù shòu men tíng zhǐ quàn gào wǒ！” bǐ kù men yào rú cǐ quàn gào nà ge bǐ kù :“ qǐng jù shòu bú yào shǐ zì jǐ bù shòu quàn gào， qǐng jù shòu shǐ zì jǐ jiē shòu quàn gào， qǐng jù shòu rú fǎ dì quàn gào bǐ kù men， bǐ kù men yě rú fǎ dì quàn shuō jù shòu。 yóu yú hù xiāng quàn gào， hù xiāng chū zuì， rú cǐ nà wèi bá gé wǎ zhī zhòng jí zēng zhǎng。” nà ge bǐ kù bèi bǐ kù men rú cǐ quàn gào shí， réng rán nà yàng jiān chí， bǐ kù men wèi le shǐ nà bǐ kù shě qì tā， yīng nǎi zhì dì sān cì quàn jiàn。 zài nǎi zhì dì sān cì quàn jiàn shí rú guǒ shě qì le tā， zhè yàng hěn hǎo。 jiǎ rú bù shě qì， sāng kā dì xiè sī。

ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, pakkamatāyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alan'te idha vāsenā”ti, evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno te bhikkhū evaṃ vadeyya “chandagāmino ca bhikkhū, dosagāmino ca bhikkhū, mohagāmino ca bhikkhū, bhayagāmino ca bhikkhū tādisikāya āpattiyā ekaccaṃ pabbājenti, ekaccaṃ na pabbājentī”ti, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evamassa vacanīyo “mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca, na ca bhikkhū chandagāmino, na ca bhikkhū dosagāmino, na ca bhikkhū mohagāmino, na ca bhikkhū bhayagāmino, āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, pakkamatāyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alan'te idha vāsenā”ti, evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya, yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce paṭinissajjeyya, saṅghādiseso.

Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto terasa saṅghādisesā dhammā. nava paṭhamāpattikā, cattāro yāvatatiyakā. Yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā yāvatihaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādeti, tāvatihaṃ tena bhikkhunā akāmā parivatthabbaṃ. Parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttariṃ chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ, ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo. Ekenapi ce ūno vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho taṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheyya, so ca bhikkhu anabbhito, te ca bhikkhū gārayhā, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
诸具寿，已诵出首犯即犯的九条、乃至第三次[劝谏才犯]的四条之十三桑喀地谢思法。若比库犯了其中任何一条後，明知而隐瞒多少天，[即使]该比库不愿意，[也]应别住多少天。住了别住的比库还应再履行六夜的敬悦比库。行了敬悦的比库，哪里有二十众的比库僧团，该比库即应在那里出罪。二十众的比库僧团假如缺少哪怕一位给该比库出罪，该比库也不能出罪，而且那些比库应受指责。这于此是随适的。
zhū jù shòu， yǐ sòng chū shǒu fàn jí fàn de jiǔ tiáo、 nǎi zhì dì sān cì [ quàn jiàn cái fàn ] de sì tiáo zhī shí sān sāng kā dì xiè sī fǎ。 ruò bǐ kù fàn le qí zhōng rèn hé yī tiáo hòu， míng zhī ér yǐn mán duō shǎo tiān，[ jí shǐ ] gāi bǐ kù bù yuàn yì，[ yě ] yīng bié zhù duō shǎo tiān。 zhù le bié zhù de bǐ kù hái yīng zài lǚ xíng liù yè de jìng yuè bǐ kù。 xíng le jìng yuè de bǐ kù， nǎ lǐ yǒu èr shí zhòng de bǐ kù sēng tuán， gāi bǐ kù jí yīng zài nà lǐ chū zuì。 èr shí zhòng de bǐ kù sēng tuán jiǎ rú quē shǎo nǎ pà yī wèi gěi gāi bǐ kù chū zuì， gāi bǐ kù yě bù néng chū zuì， ér qiě nà xiē bǐ kù yīng shòu zhǐ zé。 zhè yú cǐ shì suí shì de。

zài cǐ wǒ wèn jù shòu men shì fǒu qīng jìng？

dì èr cì wǒ zài wèn shì fǒu qīng jìng？

dì sān cì wǒ zài wèn shì fǒu qīng jìng？

jù shòu men duì cǐ shì qīng jìng de， yīn cǐ chén mò。 cǐ shì wǒ rú shì chí。

不定诵

Ime kho panāyasmanto dve aniyatā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
诸具寿，诵出此二不定法来。
zhū jù shòu， sòng chū cǐ èr bù dìng fǎ lái。
Venerables, these two undetermined rules come up for recitation.
1. Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane alaṃkammaniye nisajjaṃ kappeyya, tamenaṃ saddheyyavacasā upāsikā disvā tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena vadeyya pārājikena vā saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā, nisajjaṃ bhikkhu paṭijānamāno tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena kāretabbo pārājikena vā saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā, yena vā sā saddheyyavacasā upāsikā vadeyya, tena so bhikkhu kāretabbo, ayaṃ dhammo aniyato.
1.若比库单独和一女人在秘密隐蔽适合行[淫]的座位共坐，有说话可信的近事女看见他後，以巴拉基格、桑喀地谢思或巴吉帝亚三法中的其中一种指控。承认坐的比库应依巴拉基格、桑喀地谢思或巴吉帝亚三法的其中一种作惩治，或依那位说话可信的近事女所说的那样来惩治该比库。这是不定法。
1. ruò bǐ kù dān dú hé yī nǚ rén zài mì mì yǐn bì shì hé xíng [ yín ] de zuò wèi gòng zuò， yǒu shuō huà kě xìn de jìn shì nǚ kàn jiàn tā hòu， yǐ bā lā jī gé、 sāng kā dì xiè sī huò bā jí dì yà sān fǎ zhōng de qí zhōng yī zhǒng zhǐ kòng。 chéng rèn zuò de bǐ kù yīng yī bā lā jī gé、 sāng kā dì xiè sī huò bā jí dì yà sān fǎ de qí zhōng yī zhǒng zuò chéng zhì， huò yī nà wèi shuō huà kě xìn de jìn shì nǚ suǒ shuō de nà yàng lái chéng zhì gāi bǐ kù。 zhè shì bù dìng fǎ。

Na heva kho pana paṭicchannaṃ āsanaṃ hoti nālaṃkammaniyaṃ, alañca kho hoti mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāsituṃ, yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpe āsane mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho nisajjaṃ kappeyya, tamenaṃ saddheyyavacasā upāsikā disvā dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena vadeyya saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā, nisajjaṃ bhikkhu paṭijānamāno dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena kāretabbo saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā, yena vā sā saddheyyavacasā upāsikā vadeyya, tena so bhikkhu kāretabbo, ayampi dhammo aniyato.
2.有并非隐蔽、不适合行[淫]但是却适合对女人说粗俗语的座位。若比库在这样的座位单独和一女人秘密共坐，有说话可信的近事女看见他後，以桑喀地谢思或巴吉帝亚二法的其中一种指控。承认坐的比库应依桑喀地谢思或巴吉帝亚二法的其中一种作惩治，或依那位说话可信的近事女所说的那样来惩治该比库。这也是不定法。
2. yǒu bìng fēi yǐn bì、 bú shì hé xíng [ yín ] dàn shì què shì hé duì nǚ rén shuō cū sú yǔ de zuò wèi。 ruò bǐ kù zài zhè yàng de zuò wèi dān dú hé yī nǚ rén mì mì gòng zuò， yǒu shuō huà kě xìn de jìn shì nǚ kàn jiàn tā hòu， yǐ sāng kā dì xiè sī huò bā jí dì yà èr fǎ de qí zhōng yī zhǒng zhǐ kòng。 chéng rèn zuò de bǐ kù yīng yī sāng kā dì xiè sī huò bā jí dì yà èr fǎ de qí zhōng yī zhǒng zuò chéng zhì， huò yī nà wèi shuō huà kě xìn de jìn shì nǚ suǒ shuō de nà yàng lái chéng zhì gāi bǐ kù。 zhè yě shì bù dìng fǎ。
4. If Bicco claims to be unproven and capable of being sanctified
Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto dve aniyatā dhammā.
诸具寿，已诵出二不定法。
zhū jù shòu， yǐ sòng chū èr bù dìng fǎ。
Venerables, the two undetermined rules have been recited.
Tatthāyasmante pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
在此我问具寿们是否清净？
zài cǐ wǒ wèn jù shòu men shì fǒu qīng jìng？
In regard to this I ask you, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Dutiyampi pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
第二次我再问是否清净？
dì èr cì wǒ zài wèn shì fǒu qīng jìng？
A second time I ask, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Tatiyampi pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
第三次我再问是否清净？
dì sān cì wǒ zài wèn shì fǒu qīng jìng？
A third time I ask, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Parisuddhetthāyasmanto, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmi.
具寿们对此是清净的，因此沉默。此事我如是持。
jù shòu men duì cǐ shì qīng jìng de， yīn cǐ chén mò。 cǐ shì wǒ rú shì chí。
You are pure in this and therefore silent. I will remember it thus.
Aniyatuddeso catuttho.
——不定诵第四——
—— bù dìng sòng dì sì ——
The supreme law of man, “If I know, I see it.” From then on, [whether] questioned or unexamined, the crime was committed, and said, “I know, I don't know, I don't know, I don't know, I see, I've said empty lies.” Apart from slow growth, this is Barakig, who doesn't live together.

尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚

Ime kho panāyasmanto tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
诸具寿，诵出此三十尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚法来。
zhū jù shòu， sòng chū cǐ sān shí ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà fǎ lái。
Venerables, these thirty rules on relinquishment and confession come up for recitation.
1. Niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kaṭhine dasāhaparamaṃ atirekacīvaraṃ dhāretabbaṃ, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
1.比库衣已完成、咖提那已捨出时，多馀的衣最多可持有十天。超过此者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
1. bǐ kù yī yǐ wán chéng、 kā tí nà yǐ shě chū shí， duō yú de yī zuì duō kě chí yǒu shí tiān。 chāo guò cǐ zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
When his robe is finished and the robe season has ended, a monk should keep an extra robe for ten days at the most. If he keeps it longer than that, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
2. Niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kaṭhine ekarattampi ce bhikkhu ticīvarena vippavaseyya, aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
2.比库之衣已完成、咖提那已捨出时，假如比库离开三衣即使一夜，除了比库共许外，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
2. bǐ kù zhī yī yǐ wán chéng、 kā tí nà yǐ shě chū shí， jiǎ rú bǐ kù lí kāi sān yī jí shǐ yī yè， chú le bǐ kù gòng xǔ wài， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
When his robe is finished and the robe season has ended, if a monk stays apart from his three robes even for a single day, except if the monks have agreed, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
3. Niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kaṭhine bhikkhuno paneva akālacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭiggahetvā khippameva kāretabbaṃ, no cassa pāripūri, māsaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā taṃ cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ ūnassa pāripūriyā satiyā paccāsāya. Tato ce uttariṃ nikkhipeyya satiyāpi paccāsāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
3.比库之衣已完成、咖提那已捨出时，比库仍得到非时衣，想要的比库可以接受，接受後应尽快地做。如果不足，存有为补足不足的期望时，那位比库可存放该衣最多一个月。假如存放超过此者，即使存有期望，也尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
3. bǐ kù zhī yī yǐ wán chéng、 kā tí nà yǐ shě chū shí， bǐ kù réng dé dào fēi shí yī， xiǎng yào de bǐ kù kě yǐ jiē shòu， jiē shòu hòu yīng jǐn kuài dì zuò。 rú guǒ bù zú， cún yǒu wéi bǔ zú bù zú de qī wàng shí， nà wèi bǐ kù kě cún fàng gāi yī zuì duō yí gè yuè。 jiǎ rú cún fàng chāo guò cǐ zhě， jí shǐ cún yǒu qī wàng， yě ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
The four barakigs have been recited. If bhikkhu has committed any of them, he will not live with them. Then, as before, it will be Barakig.
4. Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā purāṇacīvaraṃ dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā ākoṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
4.若比库使非亲戚的比库尼洗、染或打旧衣者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
4. ruò bǐ kù shǐ fēi qīn qī de bǐ kù ní xǐ、 rǎn huò dǎ jiù yī zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If a monk has an unrelated nun wash, dye, or beat a used robe, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
5. Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya aññatra pārivaṭṭakā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
5.若比库从非亲戚的比库尼手中接受衣，除了交换外，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
