5. ruò bǐ kù cóng fēi qīn qī de bǐ kù ní shǒu zhōng jiē shòu yī， chú le jiāo huàn wài， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If a monk receives a robe directly from an unrelated nun, except in exchange, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
6. Yo pana bhikkhu aññātakaṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatāniṃ vā cīvaraṃ viññāpeyya aññatra samayā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Tatthāyaṃ samayo, acchinnacīvaro vā hoti bhikkhu, naṭṭhacīvaro vā, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
6.若比库向非亲戚的家主或女家主乞衣，除了适时外，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。这是于此的适时：比库被夺衣或丢失衣。这是于此的适时。
6. ruò bǐ kù xiàng fēi qīn qī de jiā zhǔ huò nǚ jiā zhǔ qǐ yī， chú le shì shí wài， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。 zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí： bǐ kù bèi duó yī huò diū shī yī。 zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí。
Let me ask you, is the birthdays clean?
7. Tañce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santaruttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. Tato ce uttariṃ sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
7.如果非亲戚的家主或女家主以许多衣邀请他拿取，那位比库可从其中最多接受上、下衣。假如接受超过此者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
7. rú guǒ fēi qīn qī de jiā zhǔ huò nǚ jiā zhǔ yǐ xǔ duō yī yāo qǐng tā ná qǔ， nà wèi bǐ kù kě cóng qí zhōng zuì duō jiē shòu shàng、 xià yī。 jiǎ rú jiē shòu chāo guò cǐ zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If an unrelated male or female householder invites that monk to take many robes, he should accept at most one sarong and one upper robe. If he accepts more than that, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
8. Bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa aññātakassa gahapatissa vā gahapatāniyā vā cīvaracetāpannaṃ upakkhaṭaṃ hoti “iminā cīvaracetāpannena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādessāmī”ti, tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya “sādhu vata maṃ āyasmā iminā cīvaracetāpannena evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā acchādehī”ti kalyāṇakamyataṃ upādāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
8.非亲戚的家主或女家主指定给比库准备衣资:“我将以此衣资交换衣後，用衣给某某比库披着。”假如那位比库事先未受邀请即前往那里对衣作指示:“具寿，唯请以此衣资交换这样或那样的衣给我披着。”出于欲求好者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
8. fēi qīn qī de jiā zhǔ huò nǚ jiā zhǔ zhǐ dìng gěi bǐ kù zhǔn bèi yī zī :“ wǒ jiāng yǐ cǐ yī zī jiāo huàn yī hòu， yòng yī gěi mǒu mǒu bǐ kù pī zhe。” jiǎ rú nà wèi bǐ kù shì xiān wèi shòu yāo qǐng jí qián wǎng nà lǐ duì yī zuò zhǐ shì :“ jù shòu， wéi qǐng yǐ cǐ yī zī jiāo huàn zhè yàng huò nà yàng de yī gěi wǒ pī zhe。” chū yú yù qiú hǎo zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
The second time I asked if it was clean?
9. Bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa ubhinnaṃ aññātakānaṃ gahapatīnaṃ vā gahapatānīnaṃ vā paccekacīvara- cetāpannāni upakkhaṭāni honti “imehi mayaṃ paccekacīvaracetāpannehi paccekacīvarāni cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarehi acchādessāmā”ti, tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya “sādhu vata maṃ āyasmanto imehi paccekacīvaracetāpannehi evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā acchādetha ubhova santā ekenā”ti kalyāṇakamyataṃ upādāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
9.两位非亲戚的家主或女家主指定给比库准备各别的衣资:“我们将用这些各别的衣资交换各别的衣後，送衣给某某比库披着。”假如那位比库事先未受到邀请即前往那里对衣作指示:“诸具寿，唯请以这些各别的衣资合二为一，交换这样或那样的衣给我披着。”出于欲求好者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
9. liǎng wèi fēi qīn qī de jiā zhǔ huò nǚ jiā zhǔ zhǐ dìng gěi bǐ kù zhǔn bèi gè bié de yī zī :“ wǒ men jiāng yòng zhè xiē gè bié de yī zī jiāo huàn gè bié de yī hòu， sòng yī gěi mǒu mǒu bǐ kù pī zhe。” jiǎ rú nà wèi bǐ kù shì xiān wèi shòu dào yāo qǐng jí qián wǎng nà lǐ duì yī zuò zhǐ shì :“ zhū jù shòu， wéi qǐng yǐ zhè xiē gè bié de yī zī hé èr wéi yī， jiāo huàn zhè yàng huò nà yàng de yī gěi wǒ pī zhe。” chū yú yù qiú hǎo zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
The third time I asked if it was clean?
10. Bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa rājā vā rājabhoggo vā brāhmaṇo vā gahapatiko vā dūtena cīvaracetāpannaṃ pahiṇeyya “iminā cīvaracetāpannena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādehī”ti. So ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya “idaṃ kho, bhante, āyasmantaṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpannaṃ ābhataṃ, paṭigaṇhātu āyasmā cīvaracetāpannan”ti. Tena bhikkhunā so dūto evamassa vacanīyo “na kho mayaṃ, āvuso, cīvaracetāpannaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma, cīvarañca kho mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma kālena kappiyan”ti.
10.若王、王臣、婆罗门或家主派使者指定给比库送衣资:“请你以此衣资交换衣後，用衣给某某比库披着!”如果该使者前往那位比库处後如此说:“尊者，这是指定为具寿带来的衣资，请具寿接受衣资吧!”该比库宜对那位使者如此说:“贤友，我们不接受衣资，我们在适时接受许可之衣。”
10. ruò wáng、 wáng chén、 pó luó mén huò jiā zhǔ pài shǐ zhě zhǐ dìng gěi bǐ kù sòng yī zī :“ qǐng nǐ yǐ cǐ yī zī jiāo huàn yī hòu， yòng yī gěi mǒu mǒu bǐ kù pī zhe !” rú guǒ gāi shǐ zhě qián wǎng nà wèi bǐ kù chù hòu rú cǐ shuō :“ zūn zhě， zhè shì zhǐ dìng wèi jù shòu dài lái de yī zī， qǐng jù shòu jiē shòu yī zī ba !” gāi bǐ kù yí duì nà wèi shǐ zhě rú cǐ shuō :“ xián yǒu， wǒ men bù jiē shòu yī zī， wǒ men zài shì shí jiē shòu xǔ kě zhī yī。”
Life is clean and silent. I'll take care of it.
So ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadeyya “atthi panāyasmato koci veyyāvaccakaro”ti. Cīvaratthikena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro niddisitabbo ārāmiko vā upāsako vā “eso kho, āvuso, bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccakaro”ti. So ce dūto taṃ veyyāvaccakaraṃ saññāpetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya “yaṃ kho, bhante, āyasmā veyyāvaccakaraṃ niddisi, saññatto so mayā, upasaṅkamatu āyasmā kālena, cīvarena taṃ acchādessatī”ti.
如果该使者对那位比库如此说:“有哪位是具寿的服务者吗?”诸比库，需要衣的比库可指出园民或近事男为服务者:“贤友，这位就是比库们的服务者。”如果该使者交代那位服务者後，前往那位比库处如此说:“尊者，具寿所指出的服务者我已经交代他了，请具寿在适时前往，他将送衣给您披着。”
rú guǒ gāi shǐ zhě duì nà wèi bǐ kù rú cǐ shuō :“ yǒu nǎ wèi shì jù shòu de fú wù zhě ma ?” zhū bǐ kù， xū yào yī de bǐ kù kě zhǐ chū yuán mín huò jìn shì nán wèi fú wù zhě :“ xián yǒu， zhè wèi jiù shì bǐ kù men de fú wù zhě。” rú guǒ gāi shǐ zhě jiāo dài nà wèi fú wù zhě hòu， qián wǎng nà wèi bǐ kù chù rú cǐ shuō :“ zūn zhě， jù shòu suǒ zhǐ chū de fú wù zhě wǒ yǐ jīng jiāo dài tā le， qǐng jù shòu zài shì shí qián wǎng， tā jiāng sòng yī gěi nín pī zhe。”
–Balakig is second –
Cīvaratthikena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro upasaṅkamitvā dvattikkhattuṃ codetabbo sāretabbo “attho me, āvuso, cīvarenā”ti, dvattikkhattuṃ codayamāno sārayamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce abhinipphādeyya, catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattuparamaṃ tuṇhībhūtena uddissa ṭhātabbaṃ, catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattu- paramaṃ tuṇhībhūto uddissa tiṭṭhamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ
诸比库，需要衣的比库前往服务者之处後，可催促、提醒两、三次:“贤友，我需要衣。”若催促、提醒两、三次时获得该衣，这样很好。假如没有获得，可四次、五次，最多六次为此而静默地站着。若在四次、五次，最多六次为此而静默地站着时获
zhū bǐ kù， xū yào yī de bǐ kù qián wǎng fú wù zhě zhī chù hòu， kě cuī cù、 tí xǐng liǎng、 sān cì :“ xián yǒu， wǒ xū yào yī。” ruò cuī cù、 tí xǐng liǎng、 sān cì shí huò dé gāi yī， zhè yàng hěn hǎo。 jiǎ rú méi yǒu huò dé， kě sì cì、 wǔ cì， zuì duō liù cì wèi cǐ ér jìng mò dì zhàn zhe。 ruò zài sì cì、 wǔ cì， zuì duō liù cì wèi cǐ ér jìng mò dì zhàn zhe shí huò
The 13th Sandishesphasy is written on the birthday of each other.
abhinipphādeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, tato ce uttariṃ vāyamamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
得该衣，这样很好。假如[没有获得，]由此更作努力时才获得该衣者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
dé gāi yī， zhè yàng hěn hǎo。 jiǎ rú [ méi yǒu huò dé，] yóu cǐ gèng zuò nǔ lì shí cái huò dé gāi yī zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
1. Deliberately emancipated, other than in a dream, Sankadesh.
No ce abhinipphādeyya, yatassa cīvaracetāpannaṃ ābhataṃ, tattha sāmaṃ vā gantabbaṃ, dūto vā pāhetabbo “yaṃ kho tumhe āyasmanto bhikkhuṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpannaṃ pahiṇittha, na taṃ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṃ anubhoti, yuñjantāyasmanto sakaṃ, mā vo sakaṃ vinassā”ti, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
如果没有获得，则须自己去或派遣使者到为他送来衣资之处:“诸具寿，你们曾指定给比库所送去的衣资，它不曾达成那比库的任何利益。诸具寿，努力要回自己的，不要失去你们自己的!”这于此是随适的。
rú guǒ méi yǒu huò dé， zé xū zì jǐ qù huò pài qiǎn shǐ zhě dào wèi tā sòng lái yī zī zhī chù :“ zhū jù shòu， nǐ men céng zhǐ dìng gěi bǐ kù suǒ sòng qù de yī zī， tā bù céng dá chéng nà bǐ kù de rèn hé lì yì。 zhū jù shòu， nǔ lì yào huí zì jǐ de， bú yào shī qù nǐ men zì jǐ de !” zhè yú cǐ shì suí shì de。
2. Sankadishas, if Bicco is in contact with a woman by means of greed, ease of heart, or if he grabs hands, or has a hair, or touches any part of it.
Cīvaravaggo paṭhamo.
第一 衣品
dì yī yī pǐn
3. If Bicco speaks vulgarly to women with greed and ease, just as young men say to young girls [speak] and those associated with lust, Sankadesh.
11. Yo pana bhikkhu kosiyamissakaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
11.若比库做混有蚕丝的敷具者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
11. ruò bǐ kù zuò hùn yǒu cán sī de fū jù zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If a monk has a blanket made that contains silk, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
12. Yo pana bhikkhu suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
12.若比库做纯黑色的羊毛敷具者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
12. ruò bǐ kù zuò chún hēi sè de yáng máo fū jù zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If a monk has a blanket made entirely of black wool, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
13. Navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārayamānena dve bhāgā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ ādātabbā, tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ, catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ. Anādā ce bhikkhu dve bhāge suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ, tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ, catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ, navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
13.比库在做新敷具时，应取两部分纯黑色的羊毛，第三为白色，第四为褐色。假如比库不取两部分纯黑色的羊毛，第三为白色，第四为褐色而做新敷具者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
13. bǐ kù zài zuò xīn fū jù shí， yīng qǔ liǎng bù fèn chún hēi sè de yáng máo， dì sān wèi bái sè， dì sì wèi hè sè。 jiǎ rú bǐ kù bù qǔ liǎng bù fèn chún hēi sè de yáng máo， dì sān wèi bái sè， dì sì wèi hè sè ér zuò xīn fū jù zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If he is corrupted and made easy to serve himself in the presence of a woman, he lamented his desire: “Sisters, if they serve those like me who keep the commandments, those who do good and those who walk, that is the highest of them.” Sankadesh, a person associated with lust.
14. Navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārāpetvā chabbassāni dhāretabbaṃ, orena ce channaṃ vassānaṃ taṃ santhataṃ vissajjetvā vā avissajjetvā vā aññaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
14.比库做新敷具後应持用六年。在六年之内无论捨弃或未捨该敷具，假如再做其它新敷具者，除了比库共许外，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
14. bǐ kù zuò xīn fū jù hòu yīng chí yòng liù nián。 zài liù nián zhī nèi wú lùn shě qì huò wèi shě gāi fū jù， jiǎ rú zài zuò qí tā xīn fū jù zhě， chú le bǐ kù gòng xǔ wài， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
5. If Bicco acts as a medium, [transmits] a man ' s love to a woman, or a woman ' s love to a man, and becomes a wife or lover, or even a brief relationship, Sankadesh.
15. Nisīdanasanthataṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāya. Anādā ce bhikkhu purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthiṃ, navaṃ nisīdanasanthataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
15.比库在做坐垫时，应从旧敷具的周边取善至的一张手以作坏色。假如比库不从旧敷具的周边取善至的一张手而做新坐垫者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
15. bǐ kù zài zuò zuò diàn shí， yìng cóng jiù fū jù de zhōu biān qǔ shàn zhì de yī zhāng shǒu yǐ zuò huài sè。 jiǎ rú bǐ kù bù cóng jiù fū jù de zhōu biān qǔ shàn zhì de yī zhāng shǒu ér zuò xīn zuò diàn zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
When Biku designates itself to build a no-or-no-or-no-or-no-no-or-no-no-or-no-no-or-no-no-or-no-no-or-no-no-or-no-no-no-or-no-no-no-or-no-no-no-no-no-or-no-no-no-no-no-no-no-no-or-no-no-no-no-no-or-no-no-no-no-no-no-no-no, no-no-no-no, no-no, no-no-no, no-no-no-no, no-no, no-no, no-no-no, no.
16. Bhikkhuno paneva addhānamaggappaṭipannassa eḷakalomāni uppajjeyyuṃ, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbāni, paṭiggahetvā tiyojanaparamaṃ sahatthā haritabbāni asante hārake. Tato ce uttariṃ hareyya, asantepi hārake, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
16.在旅行途中的比库若获得羊毛，想要的比库可以接受。接受後，在没有人拿时，最多可亲手拿三由旬。假如拿超过此者，即使没有人拿，也尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
16. zài lǚ xíng tú zhōng de bǐ kù ruò huò dé yáng máo， xiǎng yào de bǐ kù kě yǐ jiē shòu。 jiē shòu hòu， zài méi yǒu rén ná shí， zuì duō kě qīn shǒu ná sān yóu xún。 jiǎ rú ná chāo guò cǐ zhě， jí shǐ méi yǒu rén ná， yě ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
7. Biku, when building for himself a large home with [the] master, shall lead the location of the Bikus, who shall be instructed by Biku to be free of aggression and surrounded by space. If Biku is to build a large house in an area with an abusive, unencircled space, or if he does not lead Bikus to point out the place, Sankadesh.
17. Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā eḷakalomāni dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā vijaṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
17.若比库使非亲戚的比库尼洗、染或梳羊毛者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
17. ruò bǐ kù shǐ fēi qīn qī de bǐ kù ní xǐ、 rǎn huò shū yáng máo zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If a monk has an unrelated nun wash, dye, or comb wool, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
18. Yo pana bhikkhu jātarūparajataṃ uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
18.若比库捉取金银，或令捉取，或同意放在近处者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
18. ruò bǐ kù zhuō qǔ jīn yín， huò lìng zhuō qǔ， huò tóng yì fàng zài jìn chù zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If a monk takes, has someone else take, or consents to gold, silver, or money being deposited for him, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
19. Yo pana bhikkhu nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
19.若比库从事各种金钱交易者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
19. ruò bǐ kù cóng shì gè zhǒng jīn qián jiāo yì zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If a monk engages in various kinds of trades involving money, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
20. Yo pana bhikkhu nānappakārakaṃ kayavikkayaṃ samāpajjeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
20.若比库从事各种买卖者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
20. ruò bǐ kù cóng shì gè zhǒng mǎi mài zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If a monk engages in various kinds of barter, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
Kosiyavaggo dutiyo.
第二 蚕丝品
dì èr cán sī pǐn
The second subchapter on silk is finished.
21. Dasāhaparamaṃ atirekapatto dhāretabbo, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
21.多馀的钵最多可持有十天。超过此者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
21. duō yú de bō zuì duō kě chí yǒu shí tiān。 chāo guò cǐ zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
A monk should keep an extra almsbowl for ten days at the most. If he keeps it longer than that, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
22. Yo pana bhikkhu ūnapañcabandhanena pattena aññaṃ navaṃ pattaṃ cetāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Tena bhikkhunā so patto bhikkhuparisāya nissajjitabbo, yo ca tassā bhikkhuparisāya pattapariyanto so tassa bhikkhuno padātabbo “ayaṃ te bhikkhu patto yāva bhedanāya dhāretabbo”ti, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
22.若比库以不到五补缀的钵索要其它新钵者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。该钵应由那位比库在比库众中捨，而该比库众中最後的钵应给与那位比库:“比库，这是你的钵，应持用至破为止。”这于此是随适的。
22. ruò bǐ kù yǐ bú dào wǔ bǔ zhuì de bō suǒ yào qí tā xīn bō zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。 gāi bō yīng yóu nà wèi bǐ kù zài bǐ kù zhòng zhōng shě， ér gāi bǐ kù zhòng zhōng zuì hòu de bō yīng jǐ yǔ nà wèi bǐ kù :“ bǐ kù， zhè shì nǐ de bō， yīng chí yòng zhì pò wéi zhǐ。” zhè yú cǐ shì suí shì de。
If Bicco's malice, hatred, resentment and the use of the unfounded Barakig Law to denigrate bhikkhu: “may have enabled him to retreat from the Brahma.” From then on, [whether] he was questioned or not, the case was simply unfounded and based on hatred, Sankadesh.
23. Yāni kho pana tāni gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisāyanīyāni bhesajjāni, seyyath'īdaṃ Ý sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, tāni paṭiggahetvā sattāhaparamaṃ sannidhikārakaṃ paribhuñjitabbāni, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
23.有那些生病比库所服用的药，诸如：熟酥、生酥、油、蜂蜜、糖，接受它们後，最多可储存七日食用。超过此者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
23. yǒu nà xiē shēng bìng bǐ kù suǒ fú yòng de yào， zhū rú： shú sū、 shēng sū、 yóu、 fēng mì、 táng， jiē shòu tā men hòu， zuì duō kě chǔ cún qī rì shí yòng。 chāo guò cǐ zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
After being received, the tonics allowable for sick monks—that is, ghee, butter, oil, honey, and syrup—should be used from storage for at most seven days.
24. “Māso seso gimhānan”ti bhikkhunā vassikasāṭika- cīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ, “addhamāso seso gimhānan”ti katvā nivāsetabbaṃ. Orena ce “māso seso gimhānan”ti vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyeseyya, orena'ddhamāso seso gimhānan”ti katvā nivāseyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
24.在热季剩下一个月比库可寻求雨浴衣，热季剩下半个月做好後可穿着。假如还未到热季剩下一个月即寻求雨浴衣，还未到热季剩下半个月即做好并穿着者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
24. zài rè jì shèng xià yí gè yuè bǐ kù kě xún qiú yǔ yù yī， rè jì shèng xià bàn gè yuè zuò hǎo hòu kě chuān zhe。 jiǎ rú hái wèi dào rè jì shèng xià yí gè yuè jí xún qiú yǔ yù yī， hái wèi dào rè jì shèng xià bàn gè yuè jí zuò hǎo bìng chuān zhe zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If Bicco's malice, resentment, resentment, and the similarity of certain parts of other things, using the Barakig Law, denigrate bhikkhu: “may have enabled him to retreat from the Brahma.” From then on, [whether] he was questioned or not, the case only took some similarities in other parts, and Bico was based on hatred, Sankadesh.
25. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindeyya vā acchindāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
25.若比库自己施衣给比库後，动怒、不满而夺取或令夺取者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
25. ruò bǐ kù zì jǐ shī yī gěi bǐ kù hòu， dòng nù、 bù mǎn ér duó qǔ huò lìng duó qǔ zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If a monk himself gives a robe to a monk, but then, in anger, takes it back or has it taken back, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
26. Yo pana bhikkhu sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
26.若比库自己乞线後，请织匠们织衣者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
26. ruò bǐ kù zì jǐ qǐ xiàn hòu， qǐng zhī jiàng men zhī yī zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If a monk himself asks for thread, and then has weavers weave him robe-cloth, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
27. Bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya, tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya “idaṃ kho, āvuso, cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa vīyati, āyatañca karotha, vitthatañca, appitañca, suvītañca, suppavāyitañca, suvilekhitañca, suvitacchitañca karotha, appeva nāma mayampi āyasmantānaṃ kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyyāmā”ti. Evañca so bhikkhu vatvā kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyya antamaso piṇḍapātamattampi, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
27.非亲戚的家主或女家主请织匠们指定给比库织衣。假如那位比库事先未受到邀请即前往那里的织匠处对衣作指示:“贤友们，这件衣是指定织给我的，请你们做得长、宽、坚固、善织、善编织、善刮平，并做得善平滑，或许我们也会给具寿们送些东西。”若该比库如此说後送了某些东西，乃至是钵食之量，也尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
27. fēi qīn qī de jiā zhǔ huò nǚ jiā zhǔ qǐng zhī jiàng men zhǐ dìng gěi bǐ kù zhī yī。 jiǎ rú nà wèi bǐ kù shì xiān wèi shòu dào yāo qǐng jí qián wǎng nà lǐ de zhī jiàng chù duì yī zuò zhǐ shì :“ xián yǒu men， zhè jiàn yī shì zhǐ dìng zhī gěi wǒ de， qǐng nǐ men zuò dé zhǎng、 kuān、 jiān gù、 shàn zhī、 shàn biān zhī、 shàn guā píng， bìng zuò dé shàn píng huá， huò xǔ wǒ men yě huì gěi jù shòu men sòng xiē dōng xī。” ruò gāi bǐ kù rú cǐ shuō hòu sòng le mǒu xiē dōng xī， nǎi zhì shì bō shí zhī liàng， yě ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If bhikkhu is committed to the division of the monks, or is held up and persists in what led to the division, Bicou is advised to do so: “Please live not in the division of the monks, or in the division of the monks, or in the holding, or in the holding that led to the division.” And it is true that bhikkhu is happy, unchallenged, and he recites [the commandments] together.” And when Bico was so advised, the Bickus were held to do so, in order that it should be abandoned, even for the third time. If they abandon it, it is good if they do not abandon it, then it is good if they do not abandon the Sankadesh.
28. Dasāhānāgataṃ kattikatemāsikapuṇṇamaṃ bhikkhuno paneva accekacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭiggahetvā yāva cīvarakālasamayaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ. Tato ce uttariṃ nikkhipeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
28.在未到咖帝咖第三个月满月的十日内，若比库得到特施衣，知道特施衣的比库应接受，接受後可存放直到衣时。假如存放超过此者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
28. zài wèi dào kā dì kā dì sān gè yuè mǎn yuè de shí rì nèi， ruò bǐ kù dé dào tè shī yī， zhī dào tè shī yī de bǐ kù yìng jiē shòu， jiē shòu hòu kě cún fàng zhí dào yī shí。 jiǎ rú cún fàng chāo guò cǐ zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
And if one, two or three of the Biku followers, or the other, say, “Deaths, do not say anything about that Biku. The Biku is the legal sayinger, the Biku is the Lawist, and the Biku is the sayinger, who knows what we want and what we like, and says that we agree.” And the Bikus say, “Do not say, the Bikus are not legal sayings, the Biku is not a Law Sayer, and the Biku is not a Law Sayer. Lives, do not like the divided monks. Indeed, the Biku is the happy, uncontroversial, and the same recited [caution], and happy to live." And when Bikus so advise the Bikus, they insist that the Bikus do not give up the Bikus, and the Bikus are not a Law Sayer. If this is good, they do not abandon it, but the third, if it is the third.
29. Upavassaṃ kho pana kattikapuṇṇamaṃ yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni senāsanāni sāsaṅkasammatāni sappaṭibhayāni, tathārūpesu bhikkhu senāsanesu viharanto ākaṅkhamāno tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipeyya, siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocideva paccayo tena cīvarena vippavāsāya, chārattaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tena cīvarena vippavasitabbaṃ. Tato ce uttariṃ vippavaseyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
29.出雨安居後至咖帝咖满月时，有那些公认有疑惧、有危险的林野坐卧处，住在如此般坐卧处的比库希望时可把三衣中的一件衣放置于俗家间。那位比库若有任何因缘与该衣分离，那位比库最多可离开该衣六夜。假如离开超过此者，除了比库共许外，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
29. chū yǔ ān jū hòu zhì kā dì kā mǎn yuè shí， yǒu nà xiē gōng rèn yǒu yí jù、 yǒu wēi xiǎn de lín yě zuò wò chù， zhù zài rú cǐ bān zuò wò chù de bǐ kù xī wàng shí kě bǎ sān yī zhōng de yī jiàn yī fàng zhì yú sú jiā jiān。 nà wèi bǐ kù ruò yǒu rèn hé yīn yuán yǔ gāi yī fēn lí， nà wèi bǐ kù zuì duō kě lí kāi gāi yī liù yè。 jiǎ rú lí kāi chāo guò cǐ zhě， chú le bǐ kù gòng xǔ wài， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
bhikkhu, who is in a difficult position to teach himself, is advised in a place where he is recited, in the same way, that he will not be advised: “Older, do not advise me of any good or evil, nor will I persuade me of any good or evil, nor of any evil of them!” bhikkhu, who advises me, “Beloved, do not let himself be unprovoked, give life to himself, and advise him in the same way, as is done in the same way as the Quéku, if it is good to leave it, then so will they not abandon it, even for the third time.
30. Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
30.若比库明知已施向僧团的所得却令转给自己者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
30. ruò bǐ kù míng zhī yǐ shī xiàng sēng tuán de suǒ de què lìng zhuǎn gěi zì jǐ zhě， ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà。
If a monk diverts to himself material support that he knows was intended for the Sangha, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.
Pattavaggo tatiyo.
第三 钵品
dì sān bō pǐn
The third subchapter on almsbowls is finished.
Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā.
诸具寿，已诵出三十尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚法。
zhū jù shòu， yǐ sòng chū sān shí ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà fǎ。
Venerables, the thirty rules on relinquishment and confession have been recited.
Tatthāyasmante pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
对此我问具寿们是否清净？
duì cǐ wǒ wèn jù shòu men shì fǒu qīng jìng？
In regard to this I ask you, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Dutiyampi pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
第二次我再问是否清净？
dì èr cì wǒ zài wèn shì fǒu qīng jìng？
A second time I ask, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Tatiyampi pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
第三次我再问是否清净？
dì sān cì wǒ zài wèn shì fǒu qīng jìng？
A third time I ask, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Parisuddhetthāyasmanto, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmi.
具寿们对此是清净的，因此沉默。此事我如是持。
jù shòu men duì cǐ shì qīng jìng de， yīn cǐ chén mò。 cǐ shì wǒ rú shì chí。
You are pure in this and therefore silent. I will remember it thus.
Tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā niṭṭhitā.
——三十尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚法已结束——
—— sān shí ní sà qí yà bā jí dì yà fǎ yǐ jié shù ——
If there is a village or town that lives in a village or a town of scavengers or evils, his evil deeds are seen and heard, and the families that he has polluted are seen and heard. Bicos should advise the Bico: “Scavengers and evils. Lifeless evils are seen.

巴吉帝亚

Ime kho panāyasmanto dvenavuti pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
诸具寿，诵出此九十二巴吉帝亚法来。
zhū jù shòu， sòng chū cǐ jiǔ shí èr bā jí dì yà fǎ lái。
Venerables, these ninety-two rules on confession come up for recitation.
1. Sampajānamusāvāde pācittiyaṃ.
故意虚妄语者，巴吉帝亚。
gù yì xū wàng yǔ zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk lies in full awareness, he commits an offense entailing confession.
2. Omasavāde pācittiyaṃ.
辱骂语者，巴吉帝亚。
rǔ mà yǔ zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk speaks abusively, he commits an offense entailing confession.
3. Bhikkhupesuññe pācittiyaṃ.
离间比库者，巴吉帝亚。
lí jiàn bǐ kù zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk engages in malicious talebearing between monks, he commits an offense entailing confession.
4. Yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannaṃ padaso dhammaṃ vāceyya, pācittiyaṃ.
若比库给未达上者逐句教诵法者，巴吉帝亚。
ruò bǐ kù gěi wèi dá shàng zhě zhú jù jiào sòng fǎ zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk instructs a person who is not fully ordained to memorize the Teaching, he commits an offense entailing confession.
5. Yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena uttariṃ diratta-tirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
若比库和未达上者同宿超过两、三夜者，巴吉帝亚。
ruò bǐ kù hé wèi dá shàng zhě tóng sù chāo guò liǎng、 sān yè zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk lies down more than two or three nights in the same sleeping place as a person who is not fully ordained, he commits an offense entailing confession.
6. Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
若比库和女人同宿者，巴吉帝亚。
ruò bǐ kù hé nǚ rén tóng sù zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk lies down in the same sleeping place as a woman, he commits an offense entailing confession.
7. Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmassa uttariṃ chappañcavācāhi dhammaṃ deseyya aññatra viññunā purisaviggahena, pācittiyaṃ.
若比库对女人说法超过五、六语，除了有智男子外，巴吉帝亚。
ruò bǐ kù duì nǚ rén shuō fǎ chāo guò wǔ、 liù yǔ， chú le yǒu zhì nán zi wài， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk gives a teaching of more than five or six sentences to a woman, except in the presence of a man who understands, he commits an offense entailing confession.
8. Yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannassa uttarimanussa- dhammaṃ āroceyya, bhūtasmiṃ pācittiyaṃ.
若比库向未达上者告知上人法，对实得者，巴吉帝亚。
ruò bǐ kù xiàng wèi dá shàng zhě gào zhī shàng rén fǎ， duì shí dé zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk truthfully tells a person who is not fully ordained of a superhuman quality, he commits an offense entailing confession.
9. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ anupasampannassa āroceyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, pācittiyaṃ.
若比库把比库的粗重罪告知未达上者，除了比库共许外，巴吉帝亚。
ruò bǐ kù bǎ bǐ kù de cū zhòng zuì gào zhī wèi dá shàng zhě， chú le bǐ kù gòng xǔ wài， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk tells a person who is not fully ordained about a monk’s grave offense, except if the monks have agreed, he commits an offense entailing confession.
10. Yo pana bhikkhu paṭhaviṃ khaṇeyya vā khaṇāpeyya vā pācittiyaṃ.
10.若比库挖掘或令掘地者，巴吉帝亚。
10. ruò bǐ kù wā jué huò lìng jué dì zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk digs the earth or has it dug, he commits an offense entailing confession.
Musāvādavaggo paṭhamo.
第一 虚妄语品
dì yī xū wàng yǔ pǐn
The first subchapter on lying is finished.
11. Bhūtagāmapātavyatāya pācittiyaṃ.
11.损坏生物类者，巴吉帝亚。
11. sǔn huài shēng wù lèi zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk destroys a plant, he commits an offense entailing confession.
12. Aññavādake, vihesake pācittiyaṃ.
12.异语、恼乱者，巴吉帝亚。
12. yì yǔ、 nǎo luàn zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk speaks evasively or harasses, he commits an offense entailing confession.
13. Ujjhāpanake khīyanake pācittiyaṃ.
13.轻毁、嫌责者，巴吉帝亚。
13. qīng huǐ、 xián zé zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk complains or criticizes, he commits an offense entailing confession.
14. Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghikaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā bhisiṃ vā kocchaṃ vā ajjhokāse santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto neva uddhareyya, na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchā vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.
14.若比库在露地敷设或令敷设僧团的床、椅、褥垫、草席後，离开时既不收起它，也不令收起来，或不嘱咐而离去者，巴吉帝亚。
14. ruò bǐ kù zài lù dì fū shè huò lìng fū shè sēng tuán de chuáng、 yǐ、 rù diàn、 cǎo xí hòu， lí kāi shí jì bù shōu qǐ tā， yě bù lìng shōu qǐ lái， huò bù zhǔ fù ér lí qù zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk takes a bed, a bench, a mattress, or a stool belonging to the Sangha and puts it out in the open or has it put out in the open, and he then departs without putting it away, having it put away, or informing anyone, he commits an offense entailing confession.
15. Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre seyyaṃ santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto neva uddhareyya, na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.
15.若比库在僧团的住处敷设或令敷设卧具後，离开时既不收起它，也不令收起来，或不嘱咐而离去者，巴吉帝亚。
15. ruò bǐ kù zài sēng tuán de zhù chù fū shè huò lìng fū shè wò jù hòu， lí kāi shí jì bù shōu qǐ tā， yě bù lìng shōu qǐ lái， huò bù zhǔ fù ér lí qù zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk puts out bedding in a dwelling belonging to the Sangha, or has it put out, and he then departs without putting it away, having it put away, or informing anyone, he commits an offense entailing confession.
16. Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre jānaṃ pubbūpagataṃ bhikkhuṃ anupakhajja seyyaṃ kappeyya “yassa sambādho bhavissati, so pakkamissatī”ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
16.若比库在僧团的住处明知有先到的比库，强入而设卧具:“谁要是拥挤，他就会离开。”仅此作为理由，而非其它者，巴吉帝亚。
16. ruò bǐ kù zài sēng tuán de zhù chù míng zhī yǒu xiān dào de bǐ kù， qiáng rù ér shè wò jù :“ shuí yào shì yōng jǐ， tā jiù huì lí kāi。” jǐn cǐ zuò wéi lǐ yóu， ér fēi qí tā zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If, in a dwelling belonging to the Sangha, a monk arranges his sleeping place in a way that encroaches on a monk that he knows arrived there before him, with the intention that anyone who feels crowded will leave, and he does so only for this reason and no other, he commits an offense entailing confession.
17. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ kupito anattamano saṅghikā vihārā nikkaḍḍheyya vā nikkaḍḍhāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
17.若比库动怒、不满而把比库从僧团的住处赶出，或令赶出者，巴吉帝亚。
17. ruò bǐ kù dòng nù、 bù mǎn ér bǎ bǐ kù cóng sēng tuán de zhù chù gǎn chū， huò lìng gǎn chū zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk, in anger, throws a monk out of a dwelling belonging to the Sangha, or has him thrown out, he commits an offense entailing confession.
18. Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre uparivehāsakuṭiyā āhaccapādakaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā abhinisīdeyya vā abhinipajjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
18.若比库在僧团住所上层空敞的阁楼上，坐或卧脚可拆卸之床或椅者，巴吉帝亚。
18. ruò bǐ kù zài sēng tuán zhù suǒ shàng céng kōng chǎng de gé lóu shàng， zuò huò wò jiǎo kě chāi xiè zhī chuáng huò yǐ zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk sits down or lies down on a bed or a bench with detachable legs on an upper story in a dwelling belonging to the Sangha, he commits an offense entailing confession.
19. Mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena yāva dvārakosā aggalaṭṭhapanāya ālokasandhi- parikammāya dvatticchadanassa pariyāyaṃ appaharite ṭhitena adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ, tato ce uttariṃ appaharitepi ṭhito adhiṭṭhaheyya, pācittiyaṃ.
19.在建造大住所的比库，于门周范围内，为了固定门框，为了安置窗户，[可一再地涂抹或令涂抹。]应站在没有农作物处指示[盖]屋顶的两、三层。假如超过此者，即使站在没有农作物处指示，也巴吉帝亚。
19. zài jiàn zào dà zhù suǒ de bǐ kù， yú mén zhōu fàn wéi nèi， wèi le gù dìng mén kuāng， wèi le ān zhì chuāng hù，[ kě yī zài dì tú mǒ huò lìng tú mǒ。] yīng zhàn zài méi yǒu nóng zuò wù chù zhǐ shì [ gài ] wū dǐng de liǎng、 sān céng。 jiǎ rú chāo guò cǐ zhě， jí shǐ zhàn zài méi yǒu nóng zuò wù chù zhǐ shì， yě bā jí dì yà。
And when the Bickus were so counseled, the Bickus were so willing, and the Bickus were entangled, and the Bickus were enthusiasts, and the Bickus were such as to say to him: “The Bickus are free-minded, and the Bickus are followers, and the Bickus are followers, and the Bickus are followers of fear.” By the same sin, the Bickus are ejected from some, and they are not ejected from others.” Becos are so exhorted: “Students are not enough here.” And the Bickus were so advised, and the Cocos were not entious, and the Cocos were not to abandon it, but the Scouters were not, but the third time. And if it was good, then the Scouters should be reminded, and the third time.
20. Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ sappāṇakaṃ udakaṃ tiṇaṃ vā mattikaṃ vā siñceyya vā siñcāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
20.若比库明知有生物之水而浇草或土，或令浇者，巴吉帝亚。
20. ruò bǐ kù míng zhī yǒu shēng wù zhī shuǐ ér jiāo cǎo huò tǔ， huò lìng jiāo zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk pours water that he knows contains living beings onto grass or clay, or has it poured, he commits an offense entailing confession.
Bhūtagāmavaggo dutiyo.
第二 生物类品
dì èr shēng wù lèi pǐn
The second subchapter on plants is finished.
21. Yo pana bhikkhu asammato bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
21.若比库未经选派而教诲诸比库尼者，巴吉帝亚。
21. ruò bǐ kù wèi jīng xuǎn pài ér jiào huì zhū bǐ kù ní zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk who has not been appointed instructs the nuns, he commits an offense entailing confession.
22. Sammatopi ce bhikkhu atthaṅgate suriye bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
22.即使被选派的比库，假如在日落时教诲诸比库尼者，巴吉帝亚。
22. jí shǐ bèi xuǎn pài de bǐ kù， jiǎ rú zài rì luò shí jiào huì zhū bǐ kù ní zhě， bā jí dì yà。
Even if he has been appointed, if a monk instructs the nuns after sunset, he commits an offense entailing confession.
23. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ. Tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānā hoti bhikkhunī, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
23.若比库前往比库尼的住处教诲诸比库尼者，除了适时外，巴吉帝亚。这是于此的适时：比库尼生病，这是于此的适时。
23. ruò bǐ kù qián wǎng bǐ kù ní de zhù chù jiào huì zhū bǐ kù ní zhě， chú le shì shí wài， bā jí dì yà。 zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí： bǐ kù ní shēng bìng， zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí。
On the first day of life, nine of the first sinners, or even the third [prosecution of the guilty] of the first sin, are said to be nine of the first sinners, and the third [prosecution of the guilty] of the first sinners. If any of the two-hundred monks had committed any of the crimes, they would have known and concealed any of them, [even if] they had been unwilling to live for many days, [even] they should not have lived for six more nights. They should have lived in a different house, and they should have performed six more evenings of joy. And where there are twenty more Biku monks, they should have committed a crime there. If any one of the 20 Biku monks had committed a crime against it, it would not have been more than one of them, and they should have been blamed. That is appropriate.
24. Yo pana bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya “āmisahetu bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadantī”ti, pācittiyaṃ.
24.若比库如此说“长老比库们因为利养而教诲诸比库尼”者，巴吉帝亚。
24. ruò bǐ kù rú cǐ shuō “ zhǎng lǎo bǐ kù men yīn wèi lì yǎng ér jiào huì zhū bǐ kù ní ” zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk says that the senior monks are instructing the nuns for the sake of worldly gain, he commits an offense entailing confession.
25. Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā cīvaraṃ dadeyya aññatra pārivaṭṭakā, pācittiyaṃ.
25.若比库送衣给非亲戚的比库尼，除了交换外，巴吉帝亚。
25. ruò bǐ kù sòng yī gěi fēi qīn qī de bǐ kù ní， chú le jiāo huàn wài， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk gives robe-cloth to an unrelated nun, except in exchange, he commits an offense entailing confession.
26. Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā cīvaraṃ sibbeyya vā sibbāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
26.若比库为非亲戚的比库尼缝衣，或令缝者，巴吉帝亚。
26. ruò bǐ kù wèi fēi qīn qī de bǐ kù ní féng yī， huò lìng fèng zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk sews a robe for an unrelated nun, or has one sewn, he commits an offense entailing confession.
27. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gāmantarampi aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ. Tatthāyaṃ samayo, satthagamanīyo hoti maggo, sāsaṅkasammato, sappaṭibhayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
27.若比库和比库尼相约同行于一旅途者，乃至村落间，除了适时外，也巴吉帝亚。这是于此的适时：应和商旅同行的、公认有疑惧、有危险的道路，这是于此的适时。
27. ruò bǐ kù hé bǐ kù ní xiāng yuē tóng háng yú yī lǚ tú zhě， nǎi zhì cūn luò jiān， chú le shì shí wài， yě bā jí dì yà。 zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí： yìng hè shāng lǚ tóng háng de、 gōng rèn yǒu yí jù、 yǒu wēi xiǎn de dào lù， zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí。
I'm asking if I'm clean.
28. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūheyya uddhagāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā aññatra tiriyaṃ taraṇāya, pācittiyaṃ.
28.若比库和比库尼相约同乘一条船往上游或往下游者，除了横渡外，巴吉帝亚。
28. ruò bǐ kù hé bǐ kù ní xiāng yuē tóng chéng yī tiáo chuán wǎng shàng yóu huò wǎng xià yóu zhě， chú le héng dù wài， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk boards a boat by arrangement with a nun, either to go upstream or downstream, except for the purpose of crossing, he commits an offense entailing confession.
29. Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ bhikkhunīparipācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjeyya aññatra pubbe gihīsamārambhā, pācittiyaṃ.
29.若比库明知而食用比库尼所促成的食物者，除了事先由在家人准备的之外，巴吉帝亚。
29. ruò bǐ kù míng zhī ér shí yòng bǐ kù ní suǒ cù chéng de shí wù zhě， chú le shì xiān yóu zài jiā rén zhǔn bèi de zhī wài， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk eats almsfood knowing that a nun had it prepared, except if the householder had intended to prepare it anyway, he commits an offense entailing confession.
30. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
30.若比库单独和一比库尼在秘密处共坐者，巴吉帝亚。
30. ruò bǐ kù dān dú hé yī bǐ kù ní zài mì mì chù gòng zuò zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk sits down in private alone with a nun, he commits an offense entailing confession.
Bhikkhunovādavaggo tatiyo.
第三 教诲比库尼品
dì sān jiào huì bǐ kù ní pǐn
The second time I asked if it was clean?
31. Agilānena bhikkhunā eko āvasathapiṇḍo bhuñjitabbo. Tato ce uttariṃ bhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
31.无病的比库可以食用施处食一次。假如食用超过此者，巴吉帝亚。
31. wú bìng de bǐ kù kě yǐ shí yòng shī chù shí yī cì。 jiǎ rú shí yòng chāo guò cǐ zhě， bā jí dì yà。
The third time I asked if it was clean?
32. Gaṇabhojane aññatra samayā pācittiyaṃ. Tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakāra- samayo, addhānagamanasamayo, nāvābhirūhanasamayo, mahāsamayo, samaṇabhattasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
32.结众食者，除了适时外，巴吉帝亚。这是于此的适时：生病时，施衣时，做衣时，旅行时，乘船时，大众会时，沙门食时，这是于此的适时。
32. jié zhòng shí zhě， chú le shì shí wài， bā jí dì yà。 zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí： shēng bìng shí， shī yī shí， zuò yī shí， lǚ xíng shí， chéng chuán shí， dà zhòng huì shí， shā mén shí shí， zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí。
These are the appropriate occasions: he is sick; it is the robe-giving season; it is a time of making robes; he is traveling; he is on a boat; it is a big occasion; it is a meal given by a monastic.
33. Paramparabhojane aññatra samayā pācittiyaṃ. Tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
33.辗转食者，除了适时外，巴吉帝亚。这是于此的适时：生病时，施衣时，做衣时，这是于此的适时。
33. zhǎn zhuǎn shí zhě， chú le shì shí wài， bā jí dì yà。 zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí： shēng bìng shí， shī yī shí， zuò yī shí， zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí。
Life is clean and silent. I'll take care of it.
34. Bhikkhuṃ paneva kulaṃ upagataṃ pūvehi vā manthehi vā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahetabbā. Tato ce uttariṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, pācittiyaṃ. Dvattipattapūre paṭiggahetvā tato nīharitvā bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvibhajitabbaṃ, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
34.若用饼或干粮邀请去到俗家的比库拿取，想要的比库可接受两、三满钵。假如接受超过此者，巴吉帝亚。接受两、三满钵後，应从那里带回与比库们分享，这于此是随适的。
34. ruò yòng bǐng huò gān liáng yāo qǐng qù dào sú jiā de bǐ kù ná qǔ， xiǎng yào de bǐ kù kě jiē shòu liǎng、 sān mǎn bō。 jiǎ rú jiē shòu chāo guò cǐ zhě， bā jí dì yà。 jiē shòu liǎng、 sān mǎn bō hòu， yìng cóng nà lǐ dài huí yǔ bǐ kù men fēn xiǎng， zhè yú cǐ shì suí shì de。
– Sankadzes, third verse –
35. Yo pana bhikkhu bhuttāvī pavārito anatirittaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
35.若比库已足食，咀嚼或食用非剩馀的副食或主食者，巴吉帝亚。
35. ruò bǐ kù yǐ zú shí， jǔ jué huò shí yòng fēi shèng yú de fù shí huò zhǔ shí zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk has finished his meal and refused an invitation to eat more, and then eats fresh or cooked food that is not left over, he commits an offense entailing confession.
36. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ bhuttāviṃ pavāritaṃ anatirittena khādanīyena vā bhojanīyena vā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya “handa bhikkhu khāda vā bhuñja vā”ti jānaṃ āsādanāpekkho, bhuttasmiṃ pācittiyaṃ.
36.若比库意图攻讦而用非剩馀的副食或主食邀请明知已足食的比库拿取:“比库，来咀嚼或食用吧!”在食用时，巴吉帝亚。
36. ruò bǐ kù yì tú gōng jié ér yòng fēi shèng yú de fù shí huò zhǔ shí yāo qǐng míng zhī yǐ zú shí de bǐ kù ná qǔ :“ bǐ kù， lái jǔ jué huò shí yòng ba !” zài shí yòng shí， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk invites a monk, whom he knows has finished his meal and refused an invitation to eat more, to eat fresh or cooked food that is not left over, saying, ‘Here, monk, eat,’ aiming to criticize him, then when the other has eaten, he commits an offense entailing confession.
37. Yo pana bhikkhu vikāle khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
37.若比库在非时咀嚼或食用副食或主食者，巴吉帝亚。
37. ruò bǐ kù zài fēi shí jǔ jué huò shí yòng fù shí huò zhǔ shí zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk eats fresh or cooked food at the wrong time, he commits an offense entailing confession.
38. Yo pana bhikkhu sannidhikārakaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
38.若比库咀嚼或食用储存的副食或主食者，巴吉帝亚。
38. ruò bǐ kù jǔ jué huò shí yòng chǔ cún de fù shí huò zhǔ shí zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk eats fresh or cooked food that he has stored, he commits an offense entailing confession.
39. Yāni kho pana tāni paṇītabhojanāni, seyyathidaṃ Ý sappi, navanītaṃ, telaṃ, madhu, phāṇitaṃ, maccho, maṃsaṃ, khīraṃ, dadhi. Yo pana bhikkhu evarūpāni paṇītabhojanāni agilāno attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
39.有那些美味食物，诸如：熟酥、生酥、油、蜂蜜、糖、鱼、肉、乳、酪。若比库无病而为自己乞求如此诸美味食物而食用者，巴吉帝亚。
39. yǒu nà xiē měi wèi shí wù， zhū rú： shú sū、 shēng sū、 yóu、 fēng mì、 táng、 yú、 ròu、 rǔ、 lào。 ruò bǐ kù wú bìng ér wèi zì jǐ qǐ qiú rú cǐ zhū měi wèi shí wù ér shí yòng zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk who is not sick asks for any of these kinds of fine foods for himself—that is, ghee, butter, oil, honey, syrup, fish, meat, milk, and curd—and then eats it, he commits an offense entailing confession.
40. Yo pana bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āhareyya aññatra udakadantaponā, pācittiyaṃ.
40.若比库把未授与的食物持入口中者，除了水、齿木外，巴吉帝亚。
40. ruò bǐ kù bǎ wèi shòu yǔ de shí wù chí rù kǒu zhōng zhě， chú le shuǐ、 chǐ mù wài， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk eats food that has not been given, except for water and tooth cleaners, he commits an offense entailing confession.
Bhojanavaggo catuttho.
第四 食物品
dì sì shí wù pǐn
The fourth subchapter on eating is finished.
41. Yo pana bhikkhu acelakassa vā paribbājakassa vā paribbājikāya vā sahatthā khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā dadeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
41.若比库亲手把副食或主食给与裸行者、游方僧或游方尼者，巴吉帝亚。
41. ruò bǐ kù qīn shǒu bǎ fù shí huò zhǔ shí jǐ yǔ luǒ xíng zhě、 yóu fāng sēng huò yóu fāng ní zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk personally gives fresh or cooked food to a naked ascetic, to a male wanderer, or to a female wanderer, he commits an offense entailing confession.
42. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadeyya “ehāvuso, gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisissāmā”ti tassa dāpetvā vā adāpetvā vā uyyojeyya “gacchāvuso, na me tayā saddhiṃ kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hoti, ekakassa me kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hotī”ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
42.若比库对比库如此说:“来，贤友，我们入村或镇集食吧!”[无论]给与或未给而赶走他:“贤友，走！我和你一起说话或坐着不安乐，我独自说话或坐着才安乐。”仅此作为理由，而非其它者，巴吉帝亚。
42. ruò bǐ kù duì bǐ kù rú cǐ shuō :“ lái， xián yǒu， wǒ men rù cūn huò zhèn jí shí ba !”[ wú lùn ] jǐ yǔ huò wèi gěi ér gǎn zǒu tā :“ xián yǒu， zǒu！ wǒ hé nǐ yì qǐ shuō huà huò zuò zhe bù ān lè， wǒ dú zì shuō huà huò zuò zhe cái ān lè。” jǐn cǐ zuò wéi lǐ yóu， ér fēi qí tā zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk says to a monk, ‘Come, let’s go to the village or town for alms,’ and then, whether he has had food given to him or not, sends him away, saying, ‘Go away! I’m not comfortable talking or sitting with you, but only if I talk and sit by myself,’ and he does so only for this reason and no other, he commits an offense entailing confession.
43. Yo pana bhikkhu sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
43.若比库强入有两人之家而坐者，巴吉帝亚。
43. ruò bǐ kù qiáng rù yǒu liǎng rén zhī jiā ér zuò zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk sits down intruding on a lustful couple, he commits an offense entailing confession.
44. Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ raho paṭicchanne āsane nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
44.若比库和女人在秘密的隐蔽座位共坐者，巴吉帝亚。
44. ruò bǐ kù hé nǚ rén zài mì mì de yǐn bì zuò wèi gòng zuò zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk sits down in private on a concealed seat with a woman, he commits an offense entailing confession.
45. Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
45.若比库单独和一女人秘密共坐者，巴吉帝亚。
45. ruò bǐ kù dān dú hé yī nǚ rén mì mì gòng zuò zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk sits down in private alone with a woman, he commits an offense entailing confession.
46. Yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ. Tatthāyaṃ samayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
46.若比库已受餐食邀请时，有比库却不嘱咐，在食前或食後进行走访俗家，除了适时外，巴吉帝亚。这是于此的适时：施衣时，做衣时，这是于此的适时。
46. ruò bǐ kù yǐ shòu cān shí yāo qǐng shí， yǒu bǐ kù què bù zhǔ fù， zài shí qián huò shí hòu jìn xíng zǒu fǎng sú jiā， chú le shì shí wài， bā jí dì yà。 zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí： shī yī shí， zuò yī shí， zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí。
Let's live and read this uncertainty.
47. Agilānena bhikkhunā cātumāsappaccayapavāraṇā sāditabbā aññatra punapavāraṇāya, aññatra niccapavāraṇāya. Tato ce uttariṃ sādiyeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
47.无病比库可以接受四个月资具的邀请，除了再邀请，除了常邀请外。假如接受超过此者，巴吉帝亚。
47. wú bìng bǐ kù kě yǐ jiē shòu sì gè yuè zī jù de yāo qǐng， chú le zài yāo qǐng， chú le cháng yāo qǐng wài。 jiǎ rú jiē shòu chāo guò cǐ zhě， bā jí dì yà。
A monk who is not sick may accept an invitation to ask for requisites for four months. If he accepts one beyond that limit, except if it is a further invitation or a permanent invitation, he commits an offense entailing confession.
48. Yo pana bhikkhu uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gaccheyya aññatra tathārūpappaccayā, pācittiyaṃ.
48.若比库去观看出征的军队者，除了适当的因缘外，巴吉帝亚。
48. ruò bǐ kù qù guān kàn chū zhēng de jūn duì zhě， chú le shì dàng de yīn yuán wài， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk goes to see an army, except if there is a suitable reason, he commits an offense entailing confession.
49. Siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocideva paccayo senaṃ gamanāya, dirattatirattaṃ tena bhikkhunā senāya vasitabbaṃ. Tato ce uttariṃ vaseyya, pācittiyaṃ.
49.那比库若有某种因缘需去到军中，那位比库可在军中住两、三夜。若住超过此者，巴吉帝亚。
49. nà bǐ kù ruò yǒu mǒu zhǒng yīn yuán xū qù dào jūn zhōng， nà wèi bǐ kù kě zài jūn zhōng zhù liǎng、 sān yè。 ruò zhù chāo guò cǐ zhě， bā jí dì yà。
It is not certain that he will be punished by one of the three laws of Barakig, Sankardesh or Bagitia, which admits that he should be punished by one of the three laws of Barakig, Sankardesh or Bagitia, or that he will be punished by the woman who speaks to him.
50. Dirattatirattaṃ ce bhikkhu senāya vasamāno uyyodhikaṃ vā balaggaṃ vā senābyūhaṃ vā anīkadassanaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.
50.当比库住在军中两、三夜时，假如去观看军演、列兵、布阵或兵种者，巴吉帝亚。
50. dāng bǐ kù zhù zài jūn zhōng liǎng、 sān yè shí， jiǎ rú qù guān kàn jūn yǎn、 liè bīng、 bù zhèn huò bīng zhǒng zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk who is staying with an army for two or three nights goes to a battle, a troop review, a massing of the army, or a troop inspection, he commits an offense entailing confession.
Acelakavaggo pañcamo.
第五 裸行者品
dì wǔ luǒ xíng zhě pǐn
The fifth subchapter on naked ascetics is finished.
51. Surāmerayapāne pācittiyaṃ.
51.饮谷酒、花果酒者，巴吉帝亚。
51. yǐn gǔ jiǔ、 huā guǒ jiǔ zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk drinks this or that kind of alcoholic drink, he commits an offense entailing confession.
52. Aṅgulipatodake pācittiyaṃ.
52.搔痒者，巴吉帝亚。
52. sāo yǎng zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk tickles someone, he commits an offense entailing confession.
53. Udake hassadhamme pācittiyaṃ.
53.水中嬉戏者，巴吉帝亚。
53. shuǐ zhōng xī xì zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk plays in water, he commits an offense entailing confession.
54. Anādariye pācittiyaṃ.
54.不恭敬者，巴吉帝亚。
54. bù gōng jìng zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk is disrespectful, he commits an offense entailing confession.
55. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ bhiṃsāpeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
55.若比库恐吓比库者，巴吉帝亚。
55. ruò bǐ kù kǒng hè bǐ kù zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk scares a monk, he commits an offense entailing confession.
56. Yo pana bhikkhu agilāno visibbanāpekkho jotiṃ samādaheyya vā samādahāpeyya vā aññatra tathārūpappaccayā, pācittiyaṃ.
56.若无病比库想要取暖而燃火或令燃者，除了适当的因缘外，巴吉帝亚。
56. ruò wú bìng bǐ kù xiǎng yào qǔ nuǎn ér rán huǒ huò lìng rán zhě， chú le shì dàng de yīn yuán wài， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk who is not sick lights a fire to warm himself, or has one lit, except if there is a suitable reason, he commits an offense entailing confession.
57. Yo pana bhikkhu orenaddhamāsaṃ nahāyeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ. Tatthāyaṃ samayo “diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānan”ti “vassānassa paṭhamo māso” iccete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo, pariḷāhasamayo, gilānasamayo, kammasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, vātavuṭṭhisamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
57.若比库在半月之内洗浴，除了适时外，巴吉帝亚。这是于此的适时：热季末後的一个半月、雨季的第一个月，如此这两个半月为暑时、热时，生病时，工作时，旅行时，风雨时，这是于此的适时。
57. ruò bǐ kù zài bàn yuè zhī nèi xǐ yù， chú le shì shí wài， bā jí dì yà。 zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí： rè jì mò hòu de yí gè bàn yuè、 yǔ jì de dì yí gè yuè， rú cǐ zhè liǎng gè bàn yuè wèi shǔ shí、 rè shí， shēng bìng shí， gōng zuò shí， lǚ xíng shí， fēng yǔ shí， zhè shì yú cǐ de shì shí。
2. There are seats that are not hidden and are not suitable for the [prosecute] but that are suitable for the obscurity of women. Jobiku sits in such a seat alone with a woman in secret, and when he is seen by a woman who speaks crediblely, he uses one of the charges of the Sankadisha or the Bagitia II. It is also uncertain that bhikkhu should be punished for one of the two acts of the Sándistas or Bagitia II, or for that of the woman who speaks crediblely.
58. Navaṃ pana bhikkhunā cīvaralābhena tiṇṇaṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇānaṃ aññataraṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇaṃ ādātabbaṃ nīlaṃ vā kaddamaṃ vā kāḷasāmaṃ vā. Anādā ce bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇānaṃ aññataraṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇaṃ navaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
58.获得新衣的比库应取青色、泥色或黑褐色三种坏色之一作坏色。假如比库未取三种坏色之一对新衣作坏色而穿用者，巴吉帝亚。
58. huò dé xīn yī de bǐ kù yīng qǔ qīng sè、 ní sè huò hēi hè sè sān zhǒng huài sè zhī yī zuò huài sè。 jiǎ rú bǐ kù wèi qǔ sān zhǒng huài sè zhī yī duì xīn yī zuò huài sè ér chuān yòng zhě， bā jí dì yà。
The life of the Queens, the law of uncertainty has been recited.
59. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā sikkhamānāya vā sāmaṇerassa vā sāmaṇeriyā vā sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ vikappetvā appaccuddhārakaṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
59.若比库把自己的衣给比库、比库尼、在学尼、沙马内勒或沙马内莉作共有後，未经捨出即穿用者，巴吉帝亚。
59. ruò bǐ kù bǎ zì jǐ de yī gěi bǐ kù、 bǐ kù ní、 zài xué ní、 shā mǎ nèi lēi huò shā mǎ nèi lì zuò gòng yǒu hòu， wèi jīng shě chū jí chuān yòng zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk himself assigns the ownership of a robe to a monk, a nun, a trainee nun, a novice monk, or a novice nun, and he then uses it without the other first relinquishing it, he commits an offense entailing confession.
60. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā nisīdanaṃ vā sūcigharaṃ vā kāyabandhanaṃ vā apanidheyya vā apanidhāpeyya vā antamaso hassāpekkhopi, pācittiyaṃ.
60.若比库藏匿或令藏匿比库的钵、衣、坐具、针筒或腰带者，乃至想要开玩笑，也巴吉帝亚。
60. ruò bǐ kù cáng nì huò lìng cáng nì bǐ kù de bō、 yī、 zuò jù、 zhēn tǒng huò yāo dài zhě， nǎi zhì xiǎng yào kāi wán xiào， yě bā jí dì yà。
If a monk hides a monk’s bowl, robe, sitting mat, needle case, or belt, or he has it hidden, even just for a laugh, he commits an offense entailing confession.
Surāpānavaggo chaṭṭho.
第六 饮谷酒品
dì liù yǐn gǔ jiǔ pǐn
The sixth subchapter on drinking alcohol is finished.
61. Yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
61.若比库故意夺取生物的生命者，巴吉帝亚。
61. ruò bǐ kù gù yì duó qǔ shēng wù de shēng mìng zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk intentionally kills a living being, he commits an offense entailing confession.
62. Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ sappāṇakaṃ udakaṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
62.若比库明知而使用有生物之水者，巴吉帝亚。
62. ruò bǐ kù míng zhī ér shǐ yòng yǒu shēng wù zhī shuǐ zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk uses water that he knows contains living beings, he commits an offense entailing confession.
63. Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
63.若比库明知已依法裁决的案件，为了再度甘马而翻案者，巴吉帝亚。
63. ruò bǐ kù míng zhī yǐ yī fǎ cái jué de àn jiàn， wèi le zài dù gān mǎ ér fān àn zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk reopens a legal issue that he knows has been legitimately settled, he commits an offense entailing confession.
64. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa jānaṃ duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
64.若比库明知而隐瞒比库的粗重罪者，巴吉帝亚。
64. ruò bǐ kù míng zhī ér yǐn mán bǐ kù de cū zhòng zuì zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk knowingly conceals a monk’s grave offense, he commits an offense entailing confession.
65. Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādeyya, so ca puggalo anupasampanno, te ca bhikkhū gārayhā, idaṃ tasmiṃ pācittiyaṃ.
65.若比库明知而给未满二十岁之人达上，那个人不成达上，且那些比库应受指责，对他（亲教师）是此巴吉帝亚。
65. ruò bǐ kù míng zhī ér gěi wèi mǎn èr shí suì zhī rén dá shàng， nà ge rén bù chéng dá shàng， qiě nà xiē bǐ kù yīng shòu zhǐ zé， duì tā （qīn jiào shī） shì cǐ bā jí dì yà。
If a monk gives the full ordination to a person he knows is less than twenty years old, he commits an offense entailing confession. Moreover, that person has not received the full ordination and those monks are blameworthy.
66. Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ theyyasatthena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gāmantarampi, pācittiyaṃ.
66.若比库明知而和逃税贼商旅相约同行于一旅途者，乃至村落间，也巴吉帝亚。
66. ruò bǐ kù míng zhī ér hé táo shuì zéi shāng lǚ xiāng yuē tóng háng yú yī lǚ tú zhě， nǎi zhì cūn luò jiān， yě bā jí dì yà。
If a monk knowingly travels by arrangement with a group of thieves, even just to the next inhabited area, he commits an offense entailing confession.
67. Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gāmantarampi, pācittiyaṃ.
67.若比库和女人相约同行于一旅途者，乃至村落间，也巴吉帝亚。
67. ruò bǐ kù hé nǚ rén xiāng yuē tóng háng yú yī lǚ tú zhě， nǎi zhì cūn luò jiān， yě bā jí dì yà。
If a monk travels by arrangement with a woman, even just to the next inhabited area, he commits an offense entailing confession.
68. Yo pana bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya “tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā”ti, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evamassa vacanīyo “mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya, anekapariyāyena āvuso antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, alañca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāyā”ti. Evañca pana so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi
68.若比库如此说:“如我所知跋葛瓦教导之法，若跋葛瓦所说的那些障碍法，对从事它们者并不足以为障碍。”比库们要如此劝告那个比库:“请具寿不要如此说，不要诬蔑跋葛瓦，诬蔑跋葛瓦不好，跋葛瓦不会如此说。贤友，跋葛瓦以种种方式说诸障碍法为障碍，并对从事它们者足以为障碍。”那个比库被比库们如此劝告时，仍然那样坚持，比
68. ruò bǐ kù rú cǐ shuō :“ rú wǒ suǒ zhī bá gé wǎ jiào dǎo zhī fǎ， ruò bá gé wǎ suǒ shuō de nà xiē zhàng ài fǎ， duì cóng shì tā men zhě bìng bù zú yǐ wéi zhàng ài。” bǐ kù men yào rú cǐ quàn gào nà ge bǐ kù :“ qǐng jù shòu bú yào rú cǐ shuō， bú yào wū miè bá gé wǎ， wū miè bá gé wǎ bù hǎo， bá gé wǎ bú huì rú cǐ shuō。 xián yǒu， bá gé wǎ yǐ zhǒng zhǒng fāng shì shuō zhū zhàng ài fǎ wèi zhàng ài， bìng duì cóng shì tā men zhě zú yǐ wéi zhàng ài。” nà ge bǐ kù bèi bǐ kù men rú cǐ quàn gào shí， réng rán nà yàng jiān chí， bǐ
I'm asking if I'm clean.
yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya. Yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ. No ce paṭinissajjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
库们为了使那比库捨弃它，应乃至第三次劝谏。在乃至第三次劝谏时如果捨弃了它，这样很好。假如不捨弃，巴吉帝亚。
kù men wèi le shǐ nà bǐ kù shě qì tā， yīng nǎi zhì dì sān cì quàn jiàn。 zài nǎi zhì dì sān cì quàn jiàn shí rú guǒ shě qì le tā， zhè yàng hěn hǎo。 jiǎ rú bù shě qì， bā jí dì yà。
The second time I asked if it was clean?
69. Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathāvādinā bhikkhunā akaṭānudhammena taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissaṭṭhena saddhiṃ sambhuñjeyya vā, saṃvaseyya vā, saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
69.若比库明知那样主张、未随法作、未捨弃该见的比库，还一起共受用、共住或同宿者，巴吉帝亚。
69. ruò bǐ kù míng zhī nà yàng zhǔ zhāng、 wèi suí fǎ zuò、 wèi shě qì gāi jiàn de bǐ kù， hái yì qǐ gòng shòu yòng、 gòng zhù huò tóng sù zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk lives, does formal meetings, or shares a sleeping place with a monk who he knows is saying such things, who has not made amends according to the rule, and who has not given up that view, he commits an offense entailing confession.
70. Samaṇuddesopi ce evaṃ vadeyya “tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā”ti, so samaṇuddeso bhikkhūhi evamassa vacanīyo “mā, āvuso samaṇuddesa, evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya, anekapariyāyena, āvuso samaṇuddesa, antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, alañca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāyā”ti. evañca pana so samaṇuddeso bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so samaṇuddeso bhikkhūhi evamassa vacanīyo “ajjatagge te, āvuso samaṇuddesa, na ceva so bhagavā satthā apadisitabbo, yampi caññe samaṇuddesā labhanti bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ dirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ, sāpi te natthi, cara pare, vinassā”ti. Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathānāsitaṃ samaṇuddesaṃ upalāpeyya vā, upaṭṭhāpeyya vā, sambhuñjeyya vā, saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
70.假如沙马内勒也如此说:“如我所知跋葛瓦教导之法，若跋葛瓦所说的那些障碍法，对从事它们者并不足以为障碍。”比库们应如此劝告那个沙马内勒:“沙马内勒贤友，请不要如此说，不要诬蔑跋葛瓦，诬蔑跋葛瓦不好，跋葛瓦不会如此说。沙马内勒贤友，跋葛瓦以种种方式说诸障碍法为障碍，并对从事它们者足以为障碍。”那个沙马内勒被比库们如此劝告时，他仍然那样坚持，比库们要对那个沙马内勒如此说:“沙马内勒贤友，从今以後你不能指称那位跋葛瓦为导师，其他沙马内勒得以和比库们一起同宿两、三夜，而你却不得。不讨喜者走吧！消失吧!”若比库明知受那样灭摈的沙马内勒，还抚慰、令服侍、共受用或同宿者，巴吉帝亚。
70. jiǎ rú shā mǎ nèi lēi yě rú cǐ shuō :“ rú wǒ suǒ zhī bá gé wǎ jiào dǎo zhī fǎ， ruò bá gé wǎ suǒ shuō de nà xiē zhàng ài fǎ， duì cóng shì tā men zhě bìng bù zú yǐ wéi zhàng ài。” bǐ kù men yīng rú cǐ quàn gào nà ge shā mǎ nèi lēi :“ shā mǎ nèi lēi xián yǒu， qǐng bú yào rú cǐ shuō， bú yào wū miè bá gé wǎ， wū miè bá gé wǎ bù hǎo， bá gé wǎ bú huì rú cǐ shuō。 shā mǎ nèi lēi xián yǒu， bá gé wǎ yǐ zhǒng zhǒng fāng shì shuō zhū zhàng ài fǎ wèi zhàng ài， bìng duì cóng shì tā men zhě zú yǐ wéi zhàng ài。” nà ge shā mǎ nèi lēi bèi bǐ kù men rú cǐ quàn gào shí， tā réng rán nà yàng jiān chí， bǐ kù men yào duì nà ge shā mǎ nèi lēi rú cǐ shuō :“ shā mǎ nèi lēi xián yǒu， cóng jīn yǐ hòu nǐ bù néng zhǐ chēng nà wèi bá gé wǎ wèi dǎo shī， qí tā shā mǎ nèi lēi dé yǐ hé bǐ kù men yì qǐ tóng sù liǎng、 sān yè， ér nǐ què bù dé。 bù tǎo xǐ zhě zǒu ba！ xiāo shī ba !” ruò bǐ kù míng zhī shòu nà yàng miè bìn de shā mǎ nèi lēi， hái fǔ wèi、 lìng fú shì、 gòng shòu yòng huò tóng sù zhě， bā jí dì yà。
The third time I asked if it was clean?
Sappāṇakavaggo sattamo.
第七 有生物品
dì qī yǒu shēng wù pǐn
The seventh subchapter on containing living beings is finished.
71. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vadeyya “na tāvāhaṃ, āvuso, etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi, yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ vyattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmī”ti, pācittiyaṃ. Sikkhamānena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā aññātabbaṃ paripucchitabbaṃ paripañhitabbaṃ, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
71.若比库被比库们如法劝告时如此说:“贤友们，在我尚未询问其他贤明的持律比库前，我将不学此学处。”巴吉帝亚。诸比库，正在学习的比库应了知、询问、思考，这于此是随适的。
71. ruò bǐ kù bèi bǐ kù men rú fǎ quàn gào shí rú cǐ shuō :“ xián yǒu men， zài wǒ shàng wèi xún wèn qí tā xián míng de chí lǜ bǐ kù qián， wǒ jiāng bù xué cǐ xué chù。” bā jí dì yà。 zhū bǐ kù， zhèng zài xué xí de bǐ kù yīng le zhī、 xún wèn、 sī kǎo， zhè yú cǐ shì suí shì de。
Life is clean and silent. I'll take care of it.
72. Yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya “kiṃ panimehi khuddānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāvadeva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantī”ti, sikkhāpadavivaṇṇanake pācittiyaṃ.
72.若比库在诵巴帝摩卡时如此说:“为什么要诵这些微细又微细学处呢？那只会导致疑悔、烦扰、困惑而已。”诽谤学处者，巴吉帝亚。
72. ruò bǐ kù zài sòng bā dì mó kǎ shí rú cǐ shuō :“ wèi shén me yào sòng zhè xiē wēi xì yòu wēi xì xué chù ne？ nà zhǐ huì dǎo zhì yí huǐ、 fán rǎo、 kùn huò ér yǐ。” fěi bàng xué chù zhě， bā jí dì yà。
When the Monastic Code is being recited, if a monk says, ‘What’s the point of reciting these minor training rules, when they just lead to anxiety, oppression, and annoyance?’ then in disparaging the training rules, he commits an offense entailing confession.
73. Yo pana bhikkhu anvaddhamāsaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya “idāneva kho ahaṃ ājānāmi, ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī”ti. Tañce bhikkhuṃ aññe bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ nisinnapubbaṃ iminā bhikkhunā dvattikkhattuṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne, ko pana vādo bhiyyo'ti, na ca tassa bhikkhuno aññāṇakena mutti atthi, yañca tattha āpattiṃ āpanno, tañca yathādhammo kāretabbo, uttariṃ cassa moho āropetabbo “tassa te, āvuso, alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, yaṃ tvaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasi karosī”ti, idaṃ tasmiṃ mohanake pācittiyaṃ.
73.若比库在每半月诵巴帝摩卡时如此说:“我现在才知道此法收录在经中，系属于经，在每半月诵出来。”假如其他比库知道该比库:“在诵巴帝摩卡时这位比库之前曾坐过两、三次，何况说更多!”那位比库没有因无知免罪，凡对那所犯之罪应依法惩治，更应呵责其愚痴:“贤友，你在诵巴帝摩卡时不好好地专心致志，这对你不利，这对你难以获益。”对这愚痴人是此巴吉帝亚。
73. ruò bǐ kù zài měi bàn yuè sòng bā dì mó kǎ shí rú cǐ shuō :“ wǒ xiàn zài cái zhī dào cǐ fǎ shōu lù zài jīng zhōng， xì shǔ yú jīng， zài měi bàn yuè sòng chū lái。” jiǎ rú qí tā bǐ kù zhī dào gāi bǐ kù :“ zài sòng bā dì mó kǎ shí zhè wèi bǐ kù zhī qián céng zuò guò liǎng、 sān cì， hé kuàng shuō gèng duō !” nà wèi bǐ kù méi yǒu yīn wú zhī miǎn zuì， fán duì nà suǒ fàn zhī zuì yīng yī fǎ chéng zhì， gèng yīng hē zé qí yú chī :“ xián yǒu， nǐ zài sòng bā dì mó kǎ shí bù hǎo hǎo dì zhuān xīn zhì zhì， zhè duì nǐ bù lì， zhè duì nǐ nán yǐ huò yì。” duì zhè yú chī rén shì cǐ bā jí dì yà。
and may not read the fourth,
74. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa kupito anattamano pahāraṃ dadeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
74.若比库动怒、不满而打比库者，巴吉帝亚。
74. ruò bǐ kù dòng nù、 bù mǎn ér dǎ bǐ kù zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk hits a monk in anger, he commits an offense entailing confession.
75. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa kupito anattamano talasattikaṃ uggireyya, pācittiyaṃ.
75.若比库动怒、不满向比库举起手掌面者，巴吉帝亚。
75. ruò bǐ kù dòng nù、 bù mǎn xiàng bǐ kù jǔ qǐ shǒu zhǎng miàn zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk raises a hand in anger against a monk, he commits an offense entailing confession.
76. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ amūlakena saṅghādisesena anuddhaṃseyya, pācittiyaṃ.
76.若比库以无根据的桑喀地谢思毁谤比库者，巴吉帝亚。
76. ruò bǐ kù yǐ wú gēn jù de sāng kā dì xiè sī huǐ bàng bǐ kù zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk groundlessly charges a monk with an offense entailing suspension, he commits an offense entailing confession.
77. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadaheyya “itissa muhuttampi aphāsu bhavissatī”ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
77.若比库故意致使比库疑悔:“由此他将会短暂地不安乐。”仅此作为理由，而非其它者，巴吉帝亚。
77. ruò bǐ kù gù yì zhì shǐ bǐ kù yí huǐ :“ yóu cǐ tā jiāng huì duǎn zàn dì bù ān lè。” jǐn cǐ zuò wéi lǐ yóu， ér fēi qí tā zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk intentionally makes a monk anxious, thinking, ‘In this way he will be ill at ease at least for a moment,’ and he does so only for this reason and no other, he commits an offense entailing confession.
78. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ kalahajātānaṃ vivādāpannānaṃ upassutiṃ tiṭṭheyya “yaṃ ime bhaṇissanti, taṃ sossāmī”ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
78.若比库站在发生争论、争吵、争鬥之比库们的能偷听处:“我要听听这些人所说的。”仅此作为理由，而非其它者，巴吉帝亚。
78. ruò bǐ kù zhàn zài fā shēng zhēng lùn、 zhēng chǎo、 zhēng dòu zhī bǐ kù men de néng tōu tīng chù :“ wǒ yào tīng tīng zhè xiē rén suǒ shuō de。” jǐn cǐ zuò wéi lǐ yóu， ér fēi qí tā zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk eavesdrops on monks who are arguing and disputing, thinking, ‘I’ll hear what they say,’ and he does so only for this reason and no other, he commits an offense entailing confession.
79. Yo pana bhikkhu dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
79.若比库对依法甘马给与意欲，事後却表示谴责者，巴吉帝亚。
79. ruò bǐ kù duì yī fǎ gān mǎ jǐ yǔ yì yù， shì hòu què biǎo shì qiǎn zé zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk gives his consent to legitimate legal procedures, and then criticizes them afterwards, he commits an offense entailing confession.
80. Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghe vinicchayakathāya vattamānāya chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkameyya, pācittiyaṃ.
80.若比库在僧团进行决断论事时，未与意欲而起座离去者，巴吉帝亚。
80. ruò bǐ kù zài sēng tuán jìn xíng jué duàn lùn shì shí， wèi yǔ yì yù ér qǐ zuò lí qù zhě， bā jí dì yà。
When the Sangha is in the middle of a discussion, if a monk gets up from his seat and leaves without first giving his consent, he commits an offense entailing confession.
81. Yo pana bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena cīvaraṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya “yathāsanthutaṃ bhikkhū saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇāmentī”ti, pācittiyaṃ.
81.若比库由和合的僧团给与衣，事後却表示不满“比库们使僧团的所得转给按相熟的”者，巴吉帝亚。
81. ruò bǐ kù yóu hé hé de sēng tuán jǐ yǔ yī， shì hòu què biǎo shì bù mǎn “ bǐ kù men shǐ sēng tuán de suǒ de zhuǎn gěi àn xiāng shú de ” zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk gives out a robe as part of a unanimous Sangha and then criticizes it afterwards, saying, ‘The monks are diverting the Sangha’s material support according to friendship,’ he commits an offense entailing confession.
82. Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ puggalassa pariṇāmeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
82.若比库明知已施向僧团的所得却令转给个人者，巴吉帝亚。
82. ruò bǐ kù míng zhī yǐ shī xiàng sēng tuán de suǒ de què lìng zhuǎn gěi gè rén zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk diverts to an individual material support that he knows was intended for the Sangha, he commits an offense entailing confession.
Sahadhammikavaggo aṭṭhamo.
第八 如法品
dì bā rú fǎ pǐn
The eighth subchapter on legitimate correction is finished.
83. Yo pana bhikkhu rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa anikkhantarājake anībhataratanake pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito indakhīlaṃ atikkāmeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
83.若比库在灌顶的刹帝利王王未出来、宝未出来的[寝宫中]，事先未禀报而越过门槛者，巴吉帝亚。
83. ruò bǐ kù zài guàn dǐng de shā dì lì wáng wáng wèi chū lái、 bǎo wèi chū lái de [ qǐn gōng zhōng ]， shì xiān wèi bǐng bào ér yuè guò mén kǎn zhě， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk, without first being announced, crosses the threshold to the bedroom of a consecrated aristocrat king, when both the king and the queen are present, he commits an offense entailing confession.
84. Yo pana bhikkhu ratanaṃ vā ratanasammataṃ vā aññatra ajjhārāmā vā ajjhāvasathā vā uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ. Ratanaṃ vā pana bhikkhunā ratanasammataṃ vā ajjhārāme vā ajjhāvasathe vā uggahetvā vā uggahāpetvā vā nikkhipitabbaṃ “yassa bhavissati, so harissatī”ti, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
84.若比库捉持或令捉持宝物或视同宝类者，除了在[僧]园或房间内，巴吉帝亚。而比库在[僧]园或房间内捉持或令捉持宝物或视同宝类後应收藏:“属于谁的他将拿回。”这于此是随适的。
84. ruò bǐ kù zhuō chí huò lìng zhuō chí bǎo wù huò shì tóng bǎo lèi zhě， chú le zài [ sēng ] yuán huò fáng jiān nèi， bā jí dì yà。 ér bǐ kù zài [ sēng ] yuán huò fáng jiān nèi zhuō chí huò lìng zhuō chí bǎo wù huò shì tóng bǎo lèi hòu yīng shōu cáng :“ shǔ yú shéi de tā jiāng ná huí。” zhè yú cǐ shì suí shì de。
Lives and recites the 30 Nisadia Bagitia.
85. Yo pana bhikkhu santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā vikāle gāmaṃ paviseyya aññatra tathārūpā accāyikā karaṇīyā, pācittiyaṃ.
85.若比库有比库却不嘱咐，在非时入村者，除了那样般紧急的事情外，巴吉帝亚。
85. ruò bǐ kù yǒu bǐ kù què bù zhǔ fù， zài fēi shí rù cūn zhě， chú le nà yàng bān jǐn jí de shì qíng wài， bā jí dì yà。
If a monk, when another monk is available, enters an inhabited area at the wrong time without informing him, except if there is some appropriate urgent business, he commits an offense entailing confession.
86. Yo pana bhikkhu aṭṭhimayaṃ vā dantamayaṃ vā visāṇamayaṃ vā sūcigharaṃ kārāpeyya, bhedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
86.若比库做骨制、牙制或角制的针筒者，打碎的巴吉帝亚。
86. ruò bǐ kù zuò gǔ zhì、 yá zhì huò jiǎo zhì de zhēn tǒng zhě， dǎ suì de bā jí dì yà。
If a monk has a needle case made from bone, ivory, or horn, it is to be destroyed, and he commits an offense entailing confession.
87. Navaṃ pana bhikkhunā mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā kārayamānena aṭṭhaṅgulapādakaṃ kāretabbaṃ sugataṅgulena aññatra heṭṭhimāya aṭaniyā. Taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
87.比库在做新床或椅时，脚应按善至指宽的八指宽而做，除了底部的木框外。超过此者，锯断的巴吉帝亚。
87. bǐ kù zài zuò xīn chuáng huò yǐ shí， jiǎo yīng àn shàn zhì zhǐ kuān de bā zhǐ kuān ér zuò， chú le dǐ bù de mù kuāng wài。 chāo guò cǐ zhě， jù duàn de bā jí dì yà。
If a monk is having a new bed or bench made, it is to have legs eight standard fingerbreadths long below the lowest frame. If the legs exceed that, they are to be cut down, and he commits an offense entailing confession.
88. Yo pana bhikkhu mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā tūlonaddhaṃ kārāpeyya, uddālanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
88.若比库做装填棉花的床或椅者，取出的巴吉帝亚。
88. ruò bǐ kù zuò zhuāng tián mián huā de chuáng huò yǐ zhě， qǔ chū de bā jí dì yà。
If a monk has a bed or a bench made upholstered with cotton down, it is to be stripped, and he commits an offense entailing confession.
89. Nisīdanaṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena pamāṇikaṃ kāretabbaṃ, tatridaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dve vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ diyaḍḍhaṃ, dasā vidatthi. Taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
89.比库在做坐具时，应适量而做。对此其量是：长为善至张手的两张手，宽一张半，缘一张手。超过此者，裁掉的巴吉帝亚。
89. bǐ kù zài zuò zuò jù shí， yīng shì liàng ér zuò。 duì cǐ qí liàng shì： zhǎng wèi shàn zhì zhāng shǒu de liǎng zhāng shǒu， kuān yī zhāng bàn， yuán yī zhāng shǒu。 chāo guò cǐ zhě， cái diào de bā jí dì yà。
If a monk is having a sitting mat made, it should be made the right size. This is the right size: two standard handspans long and one-and-a-half wide, and a border of one handspan. If it exceeds that, it is to be cut down, and he commits an offense entailing confession.
90. Kaṇḍupaṭicchādiṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatridaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso catasso vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ dve vidatthiyo. Taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
90.比库在做覆疮衣时，应适量而做。对此其量是：长为善至张手的四张手，宽两张手。超过此者，裁掉的巴吉帝亚。
90. bǐ kù zài zuò fù chuāng yī shí， yīng shì liàng ér zuò。 duì cǐ qí liàng shì： zhǎng wèi shàn zhì zhāng shǒu de sì zhāng shǒu， kuān liǎng zhāng shǒu。 chāo guò cǐ zhě， cái diào de bā jí dì yà。
If a monk is having an itch-covering cloth made, it should be made the right size. This is the right size: four standard handspans long and two wide. If it exceeds that, it is to be cut down, and he commits an offense entailing confession.
91. Vassikasāṭikaṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatridaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso cha vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ aḍḍhateyyā. Taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
91.比库在做雨浴衣时，应适量而做。对此其量是：长为善至张手的六张手，宽两张半。超过此者，裁掉的巴吉帝亚。
91. bǐ kù zài zuò yǔ yù yī shí， yīng shì liàng ér zuò。 duì cǐ qí liàng shì： zhǎng wèi shàn zhì zhāng shǒu de liù zhāng shǒu， kuān liǎng zhāng bàn。 chāo guò cǐ zhě， cái diào de bā jí dì yà。
If a monk is having a rainy-season robe made, it should be made the right size. This is the right size: six standard handspans long and two-and-a-half wide. If it exceeds that, it is to be cut down, and he commits an offense entailing confession.
92. Yo pana bhikkhu sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ cīvaraṃ kārāpeyya, atirekaṃ vā, chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Tatridaṃ sugatassa sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ, dīghaso nava vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ cha vidatthiyo, idaṃ sugatassa sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ.
92.若比库做善至衣量之衣或超过者，裁掉的巴吉帝亚。这里善至的善至衣量是：长为善至张手的九张手，宽六张手，这是善至的善至衣量。
92. ruò bǐ kù zuò shàn zhì yī liàng zhī yī huò chāo guò zhě， cái diào de bā jí dì yà。 zhè lǐ shàn zhì de shàn zhì yī liàng shì： zhǎng wèi shàn zhì zhāng shǒu de jiǔ zhāng shǒu， kuān liù zhāng shǒu， zhè shì shàn zhì de shàn zhì yī liàng。
1. If Biku’s garment is completed and Qatina is released, the extra clothes may be held for a maximum of ten days, and if this is more than that, then Nisadi’a Bagitia.
Ratanavaggo navamo.
第九 宝品
dì jiǔ bǎo pǐn
The ninth subchapter on precious things is finished.
Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto dvenavuti pācittiyā dhammā.
诸具寿，已诵出九十二巴吉帝亚法。
zhū jù shòu， yǐ sòng chū jiǔ shí èr bā jí dì yà fǎ。
Venerables, the ninety-two rules on confession have been recited.
Tatthāyasmante pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
在此我问具寿们是否清净？
zài cǐ wǒ wèn jù shòu men shì fǒu qīng jìng？
In regard to this I ask you, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Dutiyampi pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
第二次我再问是否清净？
dì èr cì wǒ zài wèn shì fǒu qīng jìng？
A second time I ask, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Tatiyampi pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
第三次我再问是否清净？
dì sān cì wǒ zài wèn shì fǒu qīng jìng？
A third time I ask, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Parisuddhetthāyasmanto, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmi.
具寿们对此是清净的，因此沉默。此事我如是持。
jù shòu men duì cǐ shì qīng jìng de， yīn cǐ chén mò。 cǐ shì wǒ rú shì chí。
You are pure in this and therefore silent. I will remember it thus.
Dvenavuti pācittiyā dhammā niṭṭhitā.
——九十二巴吉帝亚法已结束——
—— jiǔ shí èr bā jí dì yà fǎ yǐ jié shù ——
2. When the garment of Biku has been completed and Qartina has been released, if Biku had left the clothes even overnight, in addition to Bico, Nisakya Bagitia.

应悔过法

Ime kho panāyasmanto cattāro pāṭidesanīyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
诸具寿，诵出此四应悔过法来。
zhū jù shòu， sòng chū cǐ sì yīng huǐ guò fǎ lái。
Venerables, these four rules on acknowledgment come up for recitation.
1. Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhāya hatthato khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā “gārayhaṃ, āvuso, dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemī”ti.
1.若比库亲手从已进入俗家中的非亲戚比库尼手中接受副食或主食而咀嚼或食用者，那位比库应忏悔:“贤友们，我犯了应受指责、不适当、应悔过之法，我悔过它。”
1. ruò bǐ kù qīn shǒu cóng yǐ jìn rù sú jiā zhōng de fēi qīn qī bǐ kù ní shǒu zhōng jiē shòu fù shí huò zhǔ shí ér jǔ jué huò shí yòng zhě， nà wèi bǐ kù yīng chàn huǐ :“ xián yǒu men， wǒ fàn le yīng shòu zhǐ zé、 bù shì dāng、 yīng huǐ guò zhī fǎ， wǒ huǐ guò tā。”
3. When Biku’s coat is completed and Qatina has given up, bhikkhu will still be given non-temporal clothing, and the desired bhikkhu will be accepted and done as soon as it is accepted. If it is not sufficient, there are expectations to make up the shortfall, the Biku can keep it for up to one month. If there are hopes, Nisakya Bagitia, even if there are expectations.
2. Bhikkhū paneva kulesu nimantitā bhuñjanti, tatra ce sā bhikkhunī vosāsamānarūpā ṭhitā hoti “idha sūpaṃ detha, idha odanaṃ dethā”ti. Tehi bhikkhūhi sā bhikkhunī apasādetabbā “apasakka tāva bhagini, yāva bhikkhū bhuñjantī”ti. Ekassa ce'pi bhikkhuno na paṭibhāseyya taṃ bhikkhuniṃ apasādetuṃ “apasakka tāva bhagini, yāva bhikkhū bhuñjantī”ti, paṭidesetabbaṃ tehi bhikkhūhi “gārayhaṃ, āvuso, dhammaṃ āpajjimhā asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemā”ti.
2.若比库们受邀请在俗家中用餐，那里假如有比库尼站着指点安排:“这里给羹，这里给饭。”那些比库应斥责该比库尼:“贤妹，在比库们用餐期间请回避!”假如连一位比库都不开口斥责该比库尼:“贤妹，在比库们用餐期间请回避!”那些比库应忏悔:“贤友们，我们犯了应受指责、不适当、应悔过之法，我们悔过它。”
2. ruò bǐ kù men shòu yāo qǐng zài sú jiā zhōng yòng cān， nà lǐ jiǎ rú yǒu bǐ kù ní zhàn zhe zhǐ diǎn ān pái :“ zhè lǐ gěi gēng， zhè lǐ gěi fàn。” nà xiē bǐ kù yīng chì zé gāi bǐ kù ní :“ xián mèi， zài bǐ kù men yòng cān qī jiān qǐng huí bì !” jiǎ rú lián yī wèi bǐ kù dōu bù kāi kǒu chì zé gāi bǐ kù ní :“ xián mèi， zài bǐ kù men yòng cān qī jiān qǐng huí bì !” nà xiē bǐ kù yīng chàn huǐ :“ xián yǒu men， wǒ men fàn le yīng shòu zhǐ zé、 bù shì dāng、 yīng huǐ guò zhī fǎ， wǒ men huǐ guò tā。”
4. Nisadia Bagitia, who washes, dyes or beats a non-relative of Bikuni.
3. Yāni kho pana tāni sekkhasammatāni kulāni, yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpesu sekkhasammatesu kulesu pubbe animantito agilāno khādanīyaṃ vā, bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā, bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā “gārayhaṃ, āvuso, dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemī”ti.
3.有被认定为学人的那些家庭，若比库事先未受邀请且无病，在如此般被认定为学人的家中亲手接受副食或主食而咀嚼或食用者，那位比库应忏悔:“贤友们，我犯了应受指责、不适当、应悔过之法，我悔过它。”
3. yǒu bèi rèn dìng wèi xué rén de nà xiē jiā tíng， ruò bǐ kù shì xiān wèi shòu yāo qǐng qiě wú bìng， zài rú cǐ bān bèi rèn dìng wèi xué rén de jiā zhōng qīn shǒu jiē shòu fù shí huò zhǔ shí ér jǔ jué huò shí yòng zhě， nà wèi bǐ kù yīng chàn huǐ :“ xián yǒu men， wǒ fàn le yīng shòu zhǐ zé、 bù shì dāng、 yīng huǐ guò zhī fǎ， wǒ huǐ guò tā。”
5. José Bécou received clothes from a non-relative of Bicouni, and, in addition to exchange, Nisadia Bagitia.
4. Yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni senāsanāni sāsaṅkasammatāni sappaṭibhayāni, yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpesu senāsanesu viharanto pubbe appaṭisaṃviditaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā, bhojanīyaṃ vā ajjhārāme sahatthā paṭiggahetvā agilāno khādeyya vā, bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā “gārayhaṃ, āvuso, dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemī”ti.
4.有那些公认有疑惧、有危险的林野坐卧处，若比库在如此般的坐卧处中，事先未告知而在[僧]园中亲手接受副食或主食，无病而咀嚼或食用者，那位比库应忏悔:“贤友们，我犯了应受指责、不适当、应悔过之法，我悔过它。”
4. yǒu nà xiē gōng rèn yǒu yí jù、 yǒu wēi xiǎn de lín yě zuò wò chù， ruò bǐ kù zài rú cǐ bān de zuò wò chù zhōng， shì xiān wèi gào zhī ér zài [ sēng ] yuán zhōng qīn shǒu jiē shòu fù shí huò zhǔ shí， wú bìng ér jǔ jué huò shí yòng zhě， nà wèi bǐ kù yīng chàn huǐ :“ xián yǒu men， wǒ fàn le yīng shòu zhǐ zé、 bù shì dāng、 yīng huǐ guò zhī fǎ， wǒ huǐ guò tā。”
6. It is a timely occasion for him to beg for clothes from the non-relatives ' owners or women ' s owners of the houses of Nisazhu Babagitia: Biku was taken away or her clothes were lost.
Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto cattāro pāṭidesanīyā dhammā.
诸具寿，已诵出四应悔过法。
zhū jù shòu， yǐ sòng chū sì yīng huǐ guò fǎ。
Venerables, the four rules on acknowledgment have been recited.
Tatthāyasmante pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
在此我问具寿们是否清净？
zài cǐ wǒ wèn jù shòu men shì fǒu qīng jìng？
In regard to this I ask you, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Dutiyampi pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
第二次我再问是否清净？
dì èr cì wǒ zài wèn shì fǒu qīng jìng？
A second time I ask, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Tatiyampi pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
第三次我再问是否清净？
dì sān cì wǒ zài wèn shì fǒu qīng jìng？
A third time I ask, ‘Are you pure in this?’
Parisuddhetthāyasmanto, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmi.
具寿们对此是清净的，因此沉默。此事我如是持。
jù shòu men duì cǐ shì qīng jìng de， yīn cǐ chén mò。 cǐ shì wǒ rú shì chí。
You are pure in this and therefore silent. I will remember it thus.
Cattāro pāṭidesanīyā dhammā niṭṭhitā.
——四应悔过法已结束——
—— sì yīng huǐ guò fǎ yǐ jié shù ——
7. If the non-relative ' s owner or the woman ' s owner invites him with many clothes, he may receive the most from them, and the more he wears them, and if he does so, Nisadia Bagitia.
